title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国结束英语核心地位的呼吁引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI. The debate highlights the tension between traditional academic priorities and the perceived needs of a rapidly evolving, technologically advanced society.
summary.zh: 在中国，一项旨在降低英语在中国学校核心地位的呼吁，正引发关于英语对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。这场辩论凸显了传统学术优先事项与一个快速发展、技术先进的社会之需求之间的紧张关系。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in fields like AI, presents both opportunities and challenges. As China debates the role of English in its education system, it grapples with how best to equip its students for a future where information and communication are constantly evolving. This reflects Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing,...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速增长，尤其是在人工智能等领域，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。中国在辩论英语在其教育体系中的作用时，正努力思考如何最好地为学生在一个信息和沟通不断发展的未来做好准备。这呼应了但以理关于知识增长的预言，敦促我们在获取信息的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: EU unveils ‘buy European’ public procurement rules to counter China
title.zh: 欧盟公布“购买欧洲”公共采购规则以对抗中国

summary.en: European authorities and public bodies will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when spending public money, as part of the EU's latest effort to counter China's economic might. The European Commission has proposed a significant overhaul of EU public procurement rules, aiming to boost European...
summary.zh: 作为欧盟最新对抗中国经济实力的举措的一部分，欧洲当局和公共机构在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。欧盟委员会已提议对欧盟公共采购规则进行重大改革，旨在提振欧洲产业。

body.en: Authorities and public bodies to be urged to buy goods and services from Europe, but without binding quotas European authorities will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when they spend public money under the EU latest effort to counter China’s economic might. In a further “Buy European” plan, the European Commission published proposals on Wednesday for a sweeping overhaul of EU public procurement rules. Continue reading...
body.zh: 敦促当局和公共机构从欧洲购买商品和服务，但没有约束性配额。根据欧盟对抗中国经济实力的最新举措，欧洲当局在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。在进一步的“购买欧洲”计划中，欧盟委员会周三公布了对欧盟公共采购规则进行全面改革的提案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often seek to bolster their own economies through trade policies. The EU's new 'Buy European' initiative aims to strengthen domestic industries by directing public spending towards European goods and services. This highlights the complex interplay of national economies and the desire for self-sufficiency, a dynamic that calls for wisdom and fairness...
reflection.zh: 各国常常试图通过贸易政策来支撑本国经济。欧盟新的“购买欧洲”倡议旨在通过将公共支出导向欧洲商品和服务来加强国内产业。这凸显了国家经济之间复杂的相互作用，以及对自给自足的渴望，这种动态呼吁在所有交易中都要有智慧和公平。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: A 16-hour flight, 100,000 fans and an upset: The NFL makes its Australian debut
title.zh: 一场16小时的飞行，10万粉丝和一场意外：NFL首次亮相澳大利亚

summary.en: For some Americans, the long trek to see their teams clash on the other side of the world was well worth the journey.
summary.zh: 对于一些美国人来说，长途跋涉到世界的另一边观看他们支持的球队比赛是值得的。

body.en:
More than 100,000 fans from across Australia and abroad flooded the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday to watch the San Francisco 49ers thrash the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 in the NFL's first-ever regular-season game in Australia.

With the match kicking off at 10am to line up with US prime time, one Rams fan at the MCG described it as the earliest he'd ever been up for a game.

"The atmosphere, I love it, but it's kind of quiet," he told SBS News. "You know, back home it would usually be a bit crazier, with both teams going at it."

Another fan was adding Melbourne to a list of 43 overseas stadiums he'd visited. His white jersey was embroidered with patches representing each country, with a small green patch featuring a cluster of koalas to represent Melbourne on the bottom left.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I've been to every stadium in the world where the NFL plays," he told SBS News. "It's my first time in Australia, and I love it, everyone is so nice and inviting and helpful."

"I flew all the way in from Miami, Florida, two days ago, and I'm going home tonight. I just came to witness this amazing stadium and the great people of Melbourne."

Friday's game was the first of a four-year deal between Australia and the NFL , but with no guarantee a game will be played here every year, thousands of overseas fans made the pilgrimage.

A sea of red, white, blue and yellow filled the MCG, with a sold-out crowd of 100,022 fans, including thousands of visitors from the US. Almost half of spectators were expected to be from interstate or overseas, according to the state government.

Los Angeles resident Nancy Gakere took advantage of the opportunity for a holiday, stopping over in Fiji on the way to and from Melbourne to break up what could have been a 16-hour direct flight.

She said the journey was more than worth it, especially as the 49ers, pegged as the underdogs, pulled off a surprise rout.

"Everything was just great; honestly, we couldn't have planned it any better," she told SBS News.

"When this away game happened to be in Australia, we thought, why not? And we booked the trip as soon as tickets came out in April, so we have been excited about it for a while."

"And being 49ers fans, we were not the favourites, so we came in with low expectations, and winning was a nice surprise."

Gakere said that staying in Brunswick, in Melbourne's north, had made the trip economical.

"Other than the Uber from the airport, we have just been taking the tram in and out of the city to sight-see, trying food, the bars, walking around and exploring," she told SBS News. "And we went to the Great Ocean Road, which was our main tourism activity."

body.zh: 周五，来自澳大利亚各地和国外的超过 100,000 名球迷涌入墨尔本板球场 (MCG)，观看旧金山 49 人队以 27-7 击败洛杉矶公羊队，这是 NFL 在澳大利亚的首场常规赛比赛。 比赛于上午 10 点开始，与美国黄金时间一致，MCG 的一位公羊队球迷称这是他参加比赛最早的一场比赛。 “我喜欢这里的气氛，但有点安静，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “你知道，回到主场通常会有点疯狂，两支球队都在努力。” 另一位球迷将墨尔本添加到了他参观过的 43 个海外体育场的名单中。他的白色球衣上绣有代表各个国家的补丁，左下角有一小块绿色补丁，上面有一群考拉，代表墨尔本。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我去过世界上 NFL 比赛的每一个体育场，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “这是我第一次来澳大利亚，我很喜欢这里，每个人都那么友善、热情、乐于助人。” “两天前我从佛罗里达州迈阿密一路飞来，今晚我就要回家了。我只是来见证这个令人惊叹的体育场和墨尔本伟大的人民。” 周五的比赛是澳大利亚与 NFL 之间四年协议中的第一场，但由于不能保证每年都会在这里举行比赛，因此成千上万的海外球迷前来朝圣。 MCG 充满了红、白、蓝、黄的海洋，100,022 名粉丝的门票全部售罄，其中包括数千名来自美国的游客。据州政府称，预计近一半观众来自州际或海外。 洛杉矶居民南希·加凯尔(Nancy Gakere)利用假期的机会，在往返墨尔本的途中经停斐济，中断了原本16小时的直飞航班。 她表示这段旅程非常值得，特别是当 49 人队被视为失败者时，却意外地惨败。 “一切都很棒；说实话，我们计划得再好不过了，”她告诉 SBS 新闻。 “当这场客场比赛恰好在澳大利亚举行时，我们想，为什么不呢？而且我们在四月份门票一出来就预订了行程，所以我们兴奋了一段时间。” “作为 49 人队的球迷，我们并不是最受欢迎的球队，所以我们的期望很低，但获胜是一个很大的惊喜。” 加凯雷说，住在墨尔本北部的布伦瑞克让这次旅行很经济。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“除了机场的 Uber 之外，我们只是乘坐电车进出城市观光、尝试美食、酒吧、四处走走和探索。” “我们去了大洋路，这是我们的主要旅游活动。” SBS新闻...

reflection.en: The NFL's debut in Melbourne drew over 100,000 fans, many undertaking significant journeys to witness the event. This dedication to a sporting spectacle, with its intense training and striving for victory, echoes the Apostle Paul's analogy of athletes competing for a perishable crown. While the earthly prize fades, the discipline and commitment can reflect...
reflection.zh: NFL首次在墨尔本亮相吸引了超过10万名粉丝，许多人为此进行了长途跋涉。这种对体育盛事的奉献精神，以及其中包含的艰苦训练和对胜利的追求，呼应了使徒保罗将运动员为易朽的冠冕而奋斗的比喻。虽然地上的奖赏会消逝，但其中的纪律和投入可以折射出更深层次的追求。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Card surcharges are ending soon. But the shake-up could come at a cost
title.zh: 信用卡附加费即将取消。但改革可能要付出代价

summary.en: Credit and debit card surcharges are ending from October in a move that's expected to save consumers $1.6 billion a year. However, because surcharges cover some merchants' banking costs, prices are expected to rise.
summary.zh: 从10月起，信用卡和借记卡的附加费将取消，预计每年为消费者节省16亿澳元。然而，由于附加费涵盖了部分商家的银行成本，预计价格将会上涨。

body.en:
Those irritating and often uneven percentages added to bills when you tap to pay will disappear next month, but the cost of using plastic won’t vanish, and prices are set to rise.

Eftpos, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, and UnionPay purchases will be free from card surcharges from 1 October, saving consumers an estimated $1.6 billion per year. However, because surcharges cover some merchants' banking costs, prices are expected to rise.

Surcharge fees are just one of three changes starting next month. Interchange fees, which banks charge when they process domestic card transactions, will be capped at 0.3 per cent on each payment, down from 0.8 per cent.

Merchants typically absorb these costs, so small businesses are expected to save $910 million when credit and debit card surcharging ends in October, according to Treasury.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

And because those fees subsidise frequent flyer and rewards points programs, banks have already started raising annual fees and offering fewer perks.

Finder personal finance specialist Taylor Blackburn told SBS news that some deals at Westpac, ANZ, HSBC, MyCard, and BOQ have either changed or are slated to change from 30 September.

"Sign-up bonus offers have already changed at ANZ, for example, they used to do a $200 credit on your first annual fee, but they're getting rid of that," Blackburn said.

Other frequent flyer bonus offer cards have dropped by 50,000 bonus points, but some banks are improving their offers, so shop around for a better deal now before you get stung by shifting offers, he suggested.

Westpac is lifting interest rates on some of its credit cards and will increase annual fees. NAB credit card interest rates will rise 1.5 per cent too.

Commonwealth Bank announced its Commbank Awards program is changing how consumers earn points in a new loyalty and points scheme.

St George Bank is also lifting interest rates on its Amplify Qantas Platinum credit card and introducing an annual fee of $125. The bank has also dropped the interest-free period on purchases by 10 days.

"We agree with the RBA’s concerns about fairness for small businesses, but there are better, more targeted ways to address this without destabilising the broader payments system — such as a small business interchange rate."

The European Union caps fees for debit cards at 0.2 per cent and consumer credit cards at 0.3 per cent.

title.en: The hidden $140 billion economy helping some Australians get ahead

summary.en: Older Australians are providing more than $140 billion in everyday support to younger family members each year, covering costs from childcare to home deposits and groceries.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的老年人每年为年轻家庭成员提供超过1400亿澳元的日常支持，涵盖从育儿到购房首付和食品杂货等各项开销。

body.en:
From free childcare to home deposits, groceries and holidays, billions of dollars are flowing between Australian generations long before an inheritance is handed down.

For Shane and Catherine, being grandparents to 10 children can sometimes resemble a full-time job.

A busy week can involve seeing one or more of their grandchildren almost every day, from picking them up from school, taking them to sport, helping with homework and cooking for them.

The couple, who have both worked as educators for 45 years, made a conscious decision to become active grandparents.

Catherine even reduced her working hours so she could help care for their grandchildren while their parents worked full-time.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"They couldn't have managed five days a week childcare. It's so expensive today," Catherine told SBS's Insight.

"So to look after the children, that's a saving in hundreds of dollars for them."

There may be no money changing hands, but the arrangement has significant financial value.

And Shane and Catherine are part of a much bigger, and often largely invisible, flow of support between Australian generations.

New research from SBS CulturalConnect estimates older Australians provide more than $140 billion worth of everyday financial support to younger family members each year.

The research involved in-depth interviews with 50 parents and grandparents providing support, followed by a survey of around 2,500 Australians.

More than 12 million Australians were found to support younger adult family members in some way.

Researchers have dubbed it the "Booster Economy", or the wealth and financial support flowing between generations while parents and grandparents are still alive.

And it extends far beyond the familiar "Bank of Mum and Dad" helping children into the housing market.

Among those providing support, 34 per cent had bought groceries for younger family members, 33 per cent had paid for restaurant meals and 30 per cent had bought clothes.

Almost one in five had paid for travel, while 14 per cent had bought a car and the same proportion had purchased appliances or electronics.

Forty-two per cent had provided cash, while 19 per cent had helped pay off debt.

The $140 billion estimate excludes cash transfers, debt repayments, homes and home deposits, capturing instead the scale of everyday purchases being made by older Australians for younger family members.

Finder personal finance expert Sarah Megginson said its research suggests reliance on family wealth is already growing significantly in one of the biggest areas of household finances: housing.

body.en:
Twenty-five years ago, the world watched with horror as two hijacked airliners plunged into the Twin Towers at the World Trade Centre in New York, part of a catastrophic attack that would kill 2,977 people and change the world forever.

A quarter-century on from the disaster that claimed lives from more than 90 countries — including ten Australians — tributes have poured in from Australian leaders and agencies.

In a video posted on social media, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called for a pause to reflect on "that darkest of days", and for Australians to think of the people across the world whose lives were changed forever "in scenes so confronting that they remain seared into our collective memory".

Albanese said that while it was a day that changed the world, the bravery seen amid the horror showed "the greater side of humanity".

"From New York to Washington, to Pennsylvania, so many people responded to terror with extraordinary courage, compassion and defiance," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"And together, they defined the spirit of a nation. We hold on to that, and we remember everyone who never came home from what should've been just an ordinary day in September."

Coinciding with the historic date is a new event in the relationship between Australia and the United States : the first NFL game played in Australia, held at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday.

During the game, the Australian Defence Force teamed up with its US counterparts in a flyover to commemorate the lives lost 25 years ago.

"In a powerful display of unity and skill, the Royal Australian Air Force Roulettes will fly with the US Marine Corps Ospreys, in a mixed formation above the MCG for this historic event," the ADF said in a statement, adding that the defence force would provide additional ceremonial support at the NFL match, including a Flag Party.

Leader of the Opposition Angus Taylor said it was "hard to believe" that the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks had arrived.

"It is hard to fathom that an entire generation of young Australians have reached adulthood who were not born on 9/11. And yet, they have grown up in a post 9/11 world — a darker world. My four children are among them," Taylor said in a statement.

"We all remember where we were, and how we received the shocking news ... Of course, this was the pre-smartphone age, and many Australians would not see the news until the following morning. I was one of them ... The entire situation was unfathomable and surreal."

Taylor went on to describe his appreciation for then-prime minister John Howard's actions.

reflection.en: Twenty-five years after the horrific attacks of September 11, 2001, Australia joins the world in remembrance. The tragedy claimed the lives of ten Australians and countless others, leaving an indelible mark on global history. As leaders call for a reckoning on terrorism, we are reminded of the enduring challenge to overcome evil not with more violence, but...
reflection.zh: 2001年9月11日恐怖袭击事件发生二十五年后，澳大利亚与世界一同缅怀。这场悲剧夺去了十名澳大利亚人以及无数其他人的生命，给全球历史留下了不可磨灭的印记。当领导人呼吁对恐怖主义进行清算时，我们被提醒要面对一个持久的挑战：以坚定的良善和对和平的承诺来克服邪恶，而非以更多的暴力回应。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: NSW police settle trespass case after visiting Indigenous children’s home 150 times in 20 months

summary.en: A trespass case brought by two Indigenous mothers against New South Wales police has been settled on confidential terms. The case stemmed from officers visiting one mother's home 150 times in 20 months, often between midnight and 4 am, to conduct bail checks on her sons.

Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for everyone who is silenced is a child of God." These mothers, by pursuing a legal case, are acting as...
reflection.zh: 警方对这些原住民母亲及其儿子住所进行持续不断的深夜拜访，引发了关于权力平衡及其对家庭影响的疑问。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们：“为不能说话的辩护，为所有被遗弃者伸张正义。”这两位母亲通过提起法律诉讼，正在为她们的孩子以及她们社区享有安宁和尊严的权利而发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Molly Ticehurst's killer sentenced to 28 years in prison
title.zh: 杀害莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特的凶手被判处28年监禁

summary.en: A judge found the murder was an act of revenge after Ticehurst reported previous abuse to police. Molly Ticehurst's ex-boyfriend will spend at least 20 years in jail for her murder, which was revenge for her reporting allegations of sexual assault to police.
summary.zh: 法官认定此案是蒂斯赫斯特举报先前遭受的虐待后，出于报复而犯下的谋杀罪。莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特的前男友因谋杀罪将被判处至少20年监禁，此罪行源于她举报了性侵指控。

body.en:
Molly Ticehurst's ex-boyfriend will spend at least 20 years in jail for her murder, which was revenge for her reporting allegations of sexual assault to police.

Daniel Billings stood calm and expressionless when the sentence was handed down in the NSW Supreme Court in Orange on Friday morning.

Ticehurst, a 28-year-old childcare worker, was found dead in her pyjamas at her home at Forbes, in the state's central west, in the early hours of 22 April 2024.

Billings, her former boyfriend, broke into her bedroom and used a hunting knife to stab her 15 times in an attack that lasted less than a minute.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Justice Natalie Adams found Billings' offending was in the high range of seriousness, given he murdered her in the exact way he had long threatened to do.

"It must have been absolutely terrifying for Ticehurst to die knowing her worst fears were realised," Adams said.

The 31-year-old former mine worker had repeatedly threatened to break into Ticehurst's bedroom and kill her in the months after she ended their on-and-off relationship in December 2023, according to police documents.

Ticehurst reported this abuse to the police, who charged him with several counts of sexual assault and a series of domestic violence stalking and intimidation charges.

He was also charged with killing Ticehurst's dachshund puppy with a hammer after an earlier break-up.

Police took out a provisional apprehended violence order against Billings, barring him from entering Forbes.

Billings, who previously lived in Dalby, Queensland, spent one night in police custody, but was freed on bail by a local court registrar a fortnight before the murder as there was no judge on duty that weekend.

Upon his conditional release, Billings believed he had been wrongfully accused of rape.

In a series of videos Billings recorded on his phone in the hours before the murder, he detailed his plans of harming Ticehurst in revenge.

"Molly Jean Ticehurst, well, you've done it, you've succeeded in whatever you wanted out of all of this, whether I get to you tonight or not," Billings said in one of the recordings made on the afternoon of 21 April.

Adams sentenced Billings to a maximum term of 28 years   for what she described as a brutal attack.

She found Billings acted out of retribution, revenge and "extreme hatred" for Ticehurst, angry after she reported the rape allegations.

The murder was also a serious public justice offence, as Billings killed the only witness in his potential rape trial, the judge said.

"It is clear that Molly's senseless death has had a significant impact on those who loved her."

Gaby Shepherd held up a large image of her slain...
body.zh: 莫莉·泰斯赫斯特 (Molly Ticehurst) 的前男友将因谋杀而入狱至少 20 年，这是对她向警方举报性侵犯指控的报复。 周五上午，当丹尼尔·比林斯在位于奥兰治的新南威尔士州最高法院宣判时，他平静地站着，面无表情。 2024 年 4 月 22 日凌晨，28 岁的儿童保育员泰斯赫斯特被发现穿着睡衣死在该州中西部福布斯的家中。 她的前男友比林斯闯入她的卧室，用一把猎刀刺了她 15 刀，袭击持续了不到一分钟。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 法官娜塔莉·亚当斯认为比林斯的罪行非常严重，因为他按照他长期以来威胁要采取的方式谋杀了她。 亚当斯说：“对于泰斯赫斯特来说，当她知道她最担心的事情已经成为现实时，她的死一定是非常可怕的。” 警方文件显示，在泰斯赫斯特于 2023 年 12 月结束与泰斯赫斯特断断续续的关系后的几个月里，这名 31 岁的前矿工曾多次威胁要闯入泰斯赫斯特的卧室并杀死她。 泰斯赫斯特向警方报告了这一虐待行为，警方指控他犯有多项性侵犯罪以及一系列家庭暴力跟踪和恐吓指控。 他还被指控在早些时候与泰斯赫斯特分手后用锤子杀死了泰斯赫斯特的腊肠犬小狗。 警方对比林斯颁发了临时逮捕暴力令，禁止他进入福布斯。 比林斯此前住在昆士兰州多尔比，曾被警方拘留一晚，但在谋杀案发生前两周被当地法院登记员保释，因为那个周末没有法官值班。 在有条件释放后，比林斯认为自己被错误地指控强奸。 在谋杀发生前几个小时，比林斯在手机上录制了一系列视频，他详细介绍了他伤害泰斯赫斯特以报复的计划。 比林斯在 4 月 21 日下午录制的一份录音中说道：“莫莉·简·泰斯赫斯特，好吧，你已经做到了，你已经成功地从这一切中得到了你想要的一切，无论我今晚是否能找到你。” 亚当斯因比林斯所说的野蛮袭击而判处最高 28 年徒刑。 她发现比林斯的行为是出于对泰斯赫斯特的报应、报复和“极度仇恨”，在她举报强奸指控后感到愤怒。 法官表示，这起谋杀案也是严重的公共司法犯罪，因为比林斯在他可能的强奸案审判中杀死了唯一的证人。 “很明显，莫莉的无谓死亡对那些爱她的人产生了重大影响。” 盖比·谢泼德举着一张她被杀的大照片……

reflection.en: Molly Ticehurst's life was tragically cut short because she sought justice for past abuse. Her story echoes the cry of the oppressed, reminding us of the ongoing need to defend those who speak out against injustice, even when it carries great personal risk. May we, like the prophet Isaiah, be moved to defend the vulnerable and ensure that those who suffer...
reflection.zh: 莫莉·蒂斯赫斯特因寻求伸张过去遭受虐待的公义而生命惨遭不幸。她的故事呼应了受压迫者的呐喊，提醒我们即使会带来巨大的个人风险，也要继续为那些敢于发声反对不公义的人辩护。 愿我们效法先知以赛亚，被感动去保护弱者，确保那些遭受苦难的人的声音被听见并受到保护，而不是被暴力所压制。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: In need of the warm and fuzzies? Joyous exhibition celebrates 70 years of the Muppets and the genius of Jim Henson
title.zh: 需要温暖和毛茸茸的感觉吗？欢乐展览庆祝木偶奇遇记 70 周年以及吉姆·汉森的才华

summary.en: The Make, Believe, Magic show at Goma features beloved characters like Elmo, Big Bird, and Mr. Snuffleupagus, offering visitors an interactive experience with puppeteering, celebrating the legacy of Jim Henson.
summary.zh: 在 Goma 举办的“制作、相信、魔法”展览展出了 Elmo、Big Bird 和 Mr. Snuffleupagus 等深受喜爱的角色，并为游客提供了木偶表演的互动体验，以庆祝 Jim Henson 的传奇。

body.en: Make, Believe, Magic show at Goma stars Elmo, Big Bird and the massive Mr Snuffleupagus – and gives visitors the chance to try their hand at puppeteering It’s said that celebrities are often shorter than you might expect when you encounter them in person. The opposite is true of the Muppets. “That’s the quote of this show,” says Amanda Slack-Smith, curator at Queensland’s Gallery of Modern Art (Goma), where “Oh, it’s bigger than I thought it would be!” has become a catchcry among the Goma crew installing Make, Believe, Magic: The Worlds of the Jim Henson Company. Continue reading...
body.zh: 戈马的“创造、相信、魔术”表演由埃尔莫、大鸟和巨大的史纳鲁帕格斯先生主演，让游客有机会尝试木偶戏。据说，当你见到名人时，他们的个子通常比你想象的要矮。布偶的情况正好相反。昆士兰现代艺术画廊（戈马）策展人阿曼达·斯莱克·史密斯 (Amanda Slack-Smith) 说：“这就是这场展览的引言。哦，它比我想象的要大！”已成为安装“创造、相信、魔法：吉姆·汉森公司的世界”的戈马团队的热门话题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This exhibition celebrates the imaginative world of Jim Henson and the Muppets, inviting visitors to engage with the art of puppeteering. It reminds us that even playful and creative endeavors can be undertaken with dedication and skill, reflecting a commitment to excellence in all our tasks.
reflection.zh: 本次展览庆祝了吉姆·汉森和木偶奇遇记的想象世界，并邀请游客参与木偶表演的艺术。它提醒我们，即使是充满乐趣和创意的努力，也可以通过奉献和技巧来完成，体现了在所有任务中追求卓越的精神。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

The cartoon video labeling Andrew Hastie a 'traitor' demonstrates how language can be weaponized to sow division and incite animosity. This situation calls us to consider the impact of our own words, whether spoken or shared online, and to choose speech that fosters understanding rather than...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建造也能摧毁。将安德鲁·哈斯蒂称为“叛徒”的漫画视频表明，语言可以被武器化以播下不和的种子并煽动敌意。这种情况促使我们反思自己言语的影响，无论是口头还是在线分享，并选择能促进理解而非延续冲突的言论。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Former Carlton president apologises to ex-wife as lewd photo defamation case settles
title.zh: 前卡尔顿主席就猥亵照片诽谤案向 ex-妻子道歉，案件已和解

title.en: Death of the auction? Sellers move to private sales in softening market
title.zh: 拍卖的终结？卖家转向私人销售以应对市场降温

summary.en: Property sellers are increasingly moving away from the traditional auction in response to a softening housing market, new data from Domain suggests, with experts arguing that Australia has firmly entered a "buyer's market".
summary.zh: 根据Domain的最新数据，由于住房市场趋于疲软，房地产卖家正越来越多地放弃传统的拍卖方式，专家认为澳大利亚已明确进入“买方市场”。

body.en:
Property sellers are increasingly moving away from the traditional auction in response to a softening housing market, new data from Domain suggests, with experts arguing that Australia has firmly entered a "buyer's market".

The online property platform has found a sharp rise in listings initially slated for auction being converted to private treaty in capital cities. Across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Canberra, the average proportion sales that are auctions has more than doubled from 29.6 per cent in February to 60.8 per cent in July.

Listings starting as private treaty also increased at the same time, highlighting a substantial move away from reliance on auction-day results as sellers seek the best price for their asset.

Domain's chief of economics and research, Nicola Powell, told SBS News that this shift in seller behaviour reflects the softening market conditions "unravelling across the nation".

"Many sellers are testing the market and realising that there just isn't that buyer depth there anymore," she said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

After major post-pandemic growth and following decades of steady increases, the Australian property market has seen a broad downturn over winter .

Data from property analyst Cotality shows that, while Sydney and Melbourne began to slow at the start of the year, national house price values peaked in March and have declined 3.6 per cent since.

Powell argued spring will likely be slower than usual, with Domain predicting property prices will continue to fall through the rest of the year.

"I think what we're going to see from buyers is they are going to want to get that greater value for money," she said.

The second quarter of 2026 saw the first sustained decline in national housing stock value since 2022, with Australian Bureau of Statistics figures showing a 0.3 per cent drop or $34.1 billion.

Shannan Whitney, co-founder of prominent Sydney property group BresicWhitney, told SBS News that shying away from auction sales could be the wrong move for sellers.

"Pricing tends to be more in line with where the market needs to be in an auction process than it does in a for sale process," he said.

"I think more vendors will be more comfortable with auction in Sydney over the next three or four months, but it just takes a little bit of time for everyone to work through the cycle."

Whitney expects the property cycle is now through its "first third" after months of price adjustments. It's "natural", he said, for sellers to want to retreat into non-auction sales where they feel safer or more in control during such a period, which he believes is now levelling off in Sydney.

title.en: 'Disfiguring': Behind the growing spread of a flesh-eating ulcer
title.zh: “毁容性”：食肉溃疡蔓延的背后

summary.en: A growing number of Buruli ulcer cases is prompting fresh research into prevention.
summary.zh: 日益增多的布鲁里溃疡病例正促使人们对预防措施进行新的研究。

body.en:
Warmer weather has arrived, and mosquitoes will be buzzing about before you know it. As El Niño is expected to bring an early start to summer heat, it’s likely mosquitoes will make their presence felt earlier than usual.

The threat of mosquitoes depositing flesh-eating bacteria has been restricted to a few parts of the country. But while rare, research shows it is now showing up in more areas — including in backyards in Melbourne’s inner city.

So what exactly is Buruli ulcer, where is it now found, and how can you prevent it? Here’s what we know so far, and what researchers are currently developing to protect against the bacteria in future.

Buruli ulcer is a skin infection resulting from the bacterium Mycobacterium ulcerans.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It starts as small and often painless inflammation after a mosquito bite, which may not be seen until months after initial infection. It transforms into a disfiguring ulcer after many weeks.

If left untreated, it can continue increasing in size with a loss of skin and muscle.

A buruli ulcer is treated with an eight-week course of antibiotics. Recovery can be much slower than expected for other common skin infections, with healing time highly dependent on the condition of the ulcer when first treated. It may take more than four months for ulcers to heal.

Mycobacterium ulcerans can infect urban wildlife, such as possums, which suffer symptoms similar to those in humans.

The mosquito most closely associated with areas at risk of Mycobacterium ulcerans is Aedes notoscriptus. Commonly known as the Australian backyard mosquito, it is widespread in Australia and commonly found in water-holding containers in suburban areas.

There may be other pathways of infection, but health authorities have strongly encouraged people to prevent mosquito bites as the best way to avoid Buruli ulcer.

Buruli ulcer has been reported in more than 30 countries around the world, including in Africa, South America and the Western Pacific.

In Australia, it has been reported in several states, territories and regions, including Victoria, Far North Queensland, the Northern Territory and New South Wales.

Victoria has been hit hardest, with 426 cases reported in the state in 2025 alone.

Victorian cases have mostly been reported from coastal regions, but Melbourne’s suburbs have also seen an increase in activity. Inner north-west suburbs such as Essendon, Brunswick West and Moonee Ponds are part of the new cluster.

With the potential for more cases, and in more locations, surveillance beyond known areas of activity is needed.

body.zh: 天气转暖，不知不觉间蚊子就开始嗡嗡作响。由于厄尔尼诺现象预计将提早进入夏季，因此蚊子可能会比平常更早出现。 蚊子传播食肉细菌的威胁仅限于该国的少数地区。尽管罕见，但研究表明它现在出现在更多地区——包括墨尔本内城区的后院。 那么布鲁里溃疡到底是什么，它现在在哪里发现，以及如何预防它？以下是我们迄今为止所了解的情况，以及研究人员目前正在开发的预防未来细菌感染的方法。 布鲁里溃疡是由溃疡分枝杆菌引起的皮肤感染。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 被蚊子叮咬后，它开始为小且通常无痛的炎症，可能要到初次感染几个月后才会出现。几周后它会转变为毁容性溃疡。 如果不及时治疗，它会继续增大，并导致皮肤和肌肉损失。 布鲁里溃疡需接受为期八周的抗生素治疗。其他常见皮肤感染的恢复速度可能比预期慢得多，愈合时间很大程度上取决于首次治疗时溃疡的状况。溃疡可能需要四个多月才能愈合。 溃疡分枝杆菌可以感染城市野生动物，例如负鼠，它们会出现与人类相似的症状。 与溃疡分枝杆菌风险区域关系最密切的蚊子是伊蚊。它通常被称为澳大利亚后院蚊子，在澳大利亚广泛分布，常见于郊区的盛水容器中。 可能还有其他感染途径，但卫生当局强烈鼓励人们预防蚊虫叮咬，这是避免布鲁里溃疡的最佳方法。 全球有 30 多个国家报告了布鲁里溃疡，包括非洲、南美洲和西太平洋地区。 在澳大利亚，包括维多利亚州、远北昆士兰州、北领地和新南威尔士州在内的多个州、领地和地区均报告了这种情况。 维多利亚州受到的打击最为严重，仅 2025 年该州就报告了 426 例病例。 维多利亚州的病例主要来自沿海地区，但墨尔本郊区的病例也有所增加。埃森登 (Essendon)、布伦瑞克西 (Brunswick West) 和穆尼池塘 (Moonee Ponds) 等内西北郊区是新集群的一部分。 由于可能会在更多地点出现更多病例，因此需要在已知活动区域之外进行监测。 自从布鲁里溃疡成为法定传染病以来...

title.en: Aged care giant refunds $200,000 to residents over disputed living fees
title.zh: 大型养老公司因争议性生活费向居民退还20万澳元

summary.en: Opal Healthcare, which manages nearly 150 facilities across Australia, has been compelled to refund senior residents almost $200,000 following regulatory action concerning its Higher Everyday Living Fee (HELF) arrangements.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚最大的养老护理提供商之一 Opal Healthcare，在监管机构的介入下，被迫向近 350 名养老居民退还或抵扣了近 20 万澳元，原因是其“更高日常生活费”（HELF）安排存在争议。

body.en:
One of Australia's largest aged care providers has been forced to refund almost $200,000 to residents after regulatory action from the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission.

The provider, which SBS News can reveal is Opal Healthcare, refunded and credited almost 350 aged care residents following the commission's review of its Higher Everyday Living Fee (HELF) arrangements.

HELF was introduced by the Australian government in November. It is an optional fee Australians in residential aged care can pay for a higher standard of everyday lifestyle and food and beverage service.

SBS understands that the commission has found examples from a number of providers in addition to Opal for products that take advantage of the scheme.

These services, which have been reported by Australian media and have not been tied to Opal, include bundling services of Foxtel, newspapers, and wifi in a package for a resident who couldn't read, and charging residents to attend a volunteer choir that was coming to the aged care residential home.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The commission's review also forced Opal Healthcare to reform charging practices and agreements and restore or provide services it had been charging residents for, at no additional fee.

"Our regulatory and complaints work is focused on protecting residents, ensuring the standard service offer meets the requirements of residents and ensuring providers meet their obligations," commissioner Liz Hefren-Webb said.

She said providers must take "proactive steps" to ensure those impacted "receive appropriate remediation".

Opal Healthcare manages 148 residential aged care facilities across Australia, which are home to more than 13,000 residents.  

A spokesperson for the aged provider said that following Opal Healthcare's introduction of the HELF program in February, there were changes to the program guidelines.

"As a result, we identified that charges to approximately 2 per cent of residents required reversal to comply with the updated guidelines. We voluntarily reversed the relevant fees for all affected residents," the spokesperson told SBS News in a statement.

The spokesperson said the service "notified the regulator" in March and "ensured the correct billing" of all residents.

In a statement to SBS News, Hefren-Webb said her office has "seen examples" of providers requiring residents to pay for services that "should already be included as part of standard residential aged care, charging for services residents cannot or do not use, or presenting optional fees as though they are mandatory".

"We expect all providers to ensure fees are charged in accordance with the rules and their...
body.zh: 在老年护理质量和安全委员会采取监管行动后，澳大利亚最大的老年护理提供商之一被迫向居民退还近 20 万澳元。 SBS 新闻透露，该提供商是 Opal Healthcare，在委员会对其较高日常生活费 (HELF) 安排进行审查后，该提供商已向近 350 名老年护理居民退款并记入贷方。 HELF 由澳大利亚政府于 11 月推出。这是一项可选费用，居住在住宅老年护理机构的澳大利亚人可以支付更高标准的日常生活方式和餐饮服务。 SBS 了解到，除了 Opal 之外，委员会还从许多供应商处找到了利用该计划的产品示例。 这些服务已被澳大利亚媒体报道过，但并未与 Opal 挂钩，其中包括为无法阅读的居民提供 Foxtel、报纸和 WiFi 捆绑服务，以及向居民收取参加即将来到老年护理院的志愿者合唱团的费用。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该委员会的审查还迫使 Opal Healthcare 改革收费做法和协议，恢复或提供向居民收费的服务，不收取额外费用。 “我们的监管和投诉工作的重点是保护居民，确保标准服务满足居民的要求，并确保提供商履行其义务，”专员利兹·赫夫伦-韦伯（Liz Hefren-Webb）说。 她表示，医疗服务提供者必须采取“积极主动的措施”，确保受影响的人“得到适当的补救”。 Opal Healthcare 管理着澳大利亚各地的 148 个住宅老年护理机构，居住着 13,000 多名居民。 老年医疗服务提供者的一位发言人表示，继 Opal Healthcare 在 2 月份推出 HELF 计划后，计划指南发生了变化。 该发言人在一份声明中告诉 SBS 新闻：“因此，我们发现大约 2% 的居民需要撤销收费，以符合更新后的指导方针。我们自愿撤销所有受影响居民的相关费用。” 该发言人表示，该服务于三月份“通知了监管机构”，并“确保了所有居民的正确账单”。 赫夫伦-韦伯在给 SBS 新闻的一份声明中表示，她的办公室“看到了一些例子”，一些提供商要求居民为“本应纳入标准住宅老年护理一部分的服务付费，对居民不能或不使用的服务收费，或者将可选费用视为强制性费用”。 “我们希望所有提供商确保按照规则和他们的规定收取费用......

reflection.en: The news that Opal Healthcare is refunding nearly $200,000 to residents underscores the importance of accountability in caregiving. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy.' This situation, where regulatory action prompted a refund, reflects a step toward that justice, ensuring that residents receive fair treatment and that providers are held to...
reflection.zh: Opal Healthcare 将向居民退还近 20 万澳元的消息，凸显了在护理行业中问责制的重要性。弥迦书 6:8 呼吁我们“施行公平，喜爱慈爱”。这一事件，在监管机构的介入下促使了退款，体现了迈向公平的一步，确保居民得到公正对待，并追究提供商在其财务行为上的责任。

title.en: Want to reduce your dementia risk? Lifestyle changes are only part of the picture
title.zh: 您真的可以通过生活方式来摆脱痴呆症的风险吗？

summary.en: Australians have been focused on lifestyle changes for dementia prevention. New research says other factors are being ignored.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚人一直专注于通过改变生活方式来预防痴呆症。新的研究表明，其他因素被忽视了。

body.en:
Exercise, healthy eating and blood pressure management are the most common pieces of advice for those at risk of dementia. But new research suggests Australia is ignoring crucial factors.

Dr Jennifer Dunne, an epidemiologist who was the research lead on the Curtin University paper, said dementia prevention is focused heavily "on the individual".

She said the study, published in the peer-reviewed Lancet journal, was a "broader look" at dementia risk factors, mapping them to identify where "the evidence already was".

It builds off a "large systematic review and meta-analysis" previously conducted by co-author professor Blossom Stephan, Curtin's enAble Institute Dementia chair, which identified 61 risk factors — surpassing the previously identified 14.

The research, the first of its kind, categorised the 61 risk factors using a socioecological model.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It found a lack of knowledge on how social and environmental conditions affect dementia — information crucial for dementia prevention.

Dunne, a Curtin University Dementia Centre of Excellence research fellow, said the report identifies "gaps" where researchers "should be looking".

"There's so much focus on preventing dementia, but we need to think more broadly about how we work together to prevent it," Dunne said.

"We need to move away from the message of telling people you need to do all these [lifestyle] things because they can only be successful if the environment around them is supportive."

Dementia is an umbrella term for more than 100 conditions — the most common being vascular dementia and Alzheimer's disease.

Alzheimer's accounts for up to 80 per cent of dementia cases, and impacts a person's memory, thinking and behaviour.

Dementia is caused by neurodegeneration — damage or death of the brain's neurons.

Uncorrected vision or hearing loss, social isolation and early childhood education are among the study's 61 risk factors.

"You start thinking about dementia prevention in mid-life ... but you can't go back and do your childhood education again — you can't change that risk factor," Dunne explained.

"We need to ensure that the broader society in which we live supports high-quality education that is accessible to everybody."

She noted that employed adults face a higher risk of social isolation as they approach retirement age.

Social isolation is enmeshed with other risk factors including loss of vision, loss of hearing, physical inactivity and depression.

"We know that when people sometimes become socially isolated, they become depressed. Then they tend to withdraw and stop exercising. They might start smoking, or...
body.zh: 对于患有痴呆症的人来说，锻炼、健康饮食和血压管理是最常见的建议。但新的研究表明澳大利亚忽视了关键因素。 科廷大学论文的研究负责人、流行病学家詹妮弗·邓恩博士表示，痴呆症的预防主要关注“个人”。 她说，这项发表在同行评审的《柳叶刀》杂志上的研究是对痴呆症风险因素的“更广泛的审视”，将它们绘制出来以确定“证据已经在哪里”。 它建立在之前由合著者、科廷大学 enAble 痴呆症研究所主席 Blossom Stephan 教授进行的“大型系统回顾和荟萃分析”的基础上，该分析确定了 61 个风险因素，超过了之前确定的 14 个。 该研究利用社会生态学模型对 61 种风险因素进行了分类，这在同类研究中尚属首次。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 研究发现，人们缺乏关于社会和环境条件如何影响痴呆症的知识，而这些信息对于预防痴呆症至关重要。 科廷大学痴呆症卓越中心研究员邓恩表示，该报告指出了研究人员“应该关注”的“差距”。 邓恩说：“人们非常关注预防痴呆症，但我们需要更广泛地思考如何共同努力预防痴呆症。” “我们需要摆脱告诉人们你需要做所有这些[生活方式]事情的信息，因为只有周围的环境给予支持，他们才能成功。” 痴呆症是 100 多种疾病的总称，其中最常见的是血管性痴呆和阿尔茨海默病。 阿尔茨海默病占痴呆症病例的 80%，它会影响一个人的记忆、思维和行为。 痴呆症是由神经退行性病变（大脑神经元损伤或死亡）引起的。 未矫正的视力或听力损失、社会孤立和幼儿教育是该研究的 61 个风险因素之一。 “你在中年时开始考虑预防痴呆症……但你不能回去重新接受童年教育——你无法改变这个风险因素，”邓恩解释道。 “我们需要确保我们生活的更广泛的社会支持每个人都能获得的高质量教育。” 她指出，在职成年人在接近退休年龄时面临着更高的社会孤立风险。 社会孤立与其他风险因素交织在一起，包括视力丧失、听力丧失、缺乏身体活动和抑郁。 “我们知道，当人们有时变得与社会隔绝时，他们就会变得抑郁。然后他们往往会退缩并停止锻炼。他们可能会开始吸烟，或者......

reflection.en: The pursuit of health often centers on individual actions like diet and exercise. However, this research from Curtin University suggests that a broader perspective is needed for dementia prevention, pointing to factors beyond personal control. It reminds us that true wisdom in addressing complex issues like public health requires listening to diverse...
reflection.zh: 追求健康常常以饮食和运动等个人行为为中心。然而，科廷大学的这项研究表明，在预防痴呆症方面需要更广泛的视角，指出了个人控制之外的因素。它提醒我们，在解决公共卫生等复杂问题时，真正的智慧需要倾听各种意见，并考虑系统性影响，而不仅仅是个人选择。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Violators of national security won't be tolerated: CE

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee stated that the sentencing of three former leaders of the group behind the June 4th vigils on Friday demonstrates that anyone intending to incite subversion and endanger national security will face legal consequences. The three former leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，周五对六四晚会主办团体三名前领导人的判决表明，任何意图煽动颠覆国家安全的人都将依法受到惩处。已解散的“香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会”的三名前领导人——李卓人、何俊仁和邹幸彤——被判处五年零两个月至七年零三个月不等的监禁，该团体被罚款150万港元。李家超补充说，法律不允许任何人公开伤害自己的国家和同...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said the sentencing of three former leaders of the group behind the June 4th vigils on Friday showed that anyone who intends to incite subversion and endanger national security will be punished in accordance with the law. Three former leaders of the now‑defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China – Albert Ho, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang‑tung – received prison terms ranging from five years and two months to seven years and three months, and the group was fined HK$1.5 million. In a statement, the chief executive said the law never allows anyone to openly harm one's own country and compatriots by employing confounding tactics under the pretext of human rights, democracy and freedom. He noted that the court pointed out that what the defendants did in this case had gone beyond the scope of lawful freedom of expression, and constituted acts of inciting others to subvert state power by unlawful means. The CE added that the sentences demonstrated the court's confirmation that the offences committed by the defendants were extremely serious and warranted severe punishment to uphold the rule of law. "The court has pointed out clearly in its reasons for the verdict of conviction handed down earlier that the very aim of the Alliance's agendas was to overthrow and undermine the leadership by the Communist Party of China (CPC) under the Constitution," he said. "The defendants intended to cause others to lose confidence in the CPC by stirring up hostility and causing division, so as to achieve the objective of undermining the fundamental system of the People's Republic of China (PRC). "After the implementation of the Hong Kong National Security Law, the defendants refused to pull back from the brink and were bent on acting wilfully, attempting to make use of the Alliance to subvert state power." A government spokesman, meanwhile, dismissed "malicious attacks and smears" on this and other cases by various western countries and anti-China organisations, among others, adding the defendants in this case were put on trial not because of their political beliefs and they received a fair trial. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，周五对6月4日守夜活动背后组织的三名前领导人的判刑表明，任何意图煽动颠覆和危害国家安全的人都将依法受到惩罚。现已解散的香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的三位前领导人——何俊仁、李卓人和周恒东——被判处五年零两个月至七年零三个月不等的徒刑，并被罚款港币一百五十万元。行政长官在一份声明中表示，法律决不允许任何人打着人权、民主、自由的幌子，公然采取混淆视听的手段，伤害自己的国家和同胞。他指出，法院指出，本案被告人的行为超出了合法言论自由的范围，构成煽动他人以非法手段颠覆国家政权的行为。行政长官补充，刑罚显示法庭确认被告所犯罪行极其严重，应予以严厉处罚，以维护法治。他说：“法院在早前作出的定罪理由中已明确指出，‘联盟’的目的就是推翻和破坏中国共产党依据宪法的领导。” “被告人意图通过煽动敌意、制造分裂，使他人对中国共产党失去信心，以达到破坏中华人民共和国根本制度的目的。”西方国家和反华组织等提出的其他案件，并补充说，本案被告并不是因为政治信仰而受到审判，他们受到了公正的审判。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Chief Executive's remarks underscore a government's commitment to enforcing laws it deems essential for national security. This situation highlights the tension between state authority and individual freedoms, a recurring theme throughout history. Proverbs 29:2 speaks to the consequences when governance falters: 'When the righteous increase,...
reflection.zh: 香港行政长官的言论强调了政府维护其认为对国家安全至关重要的法律的决心。这种情况凸显了国家权威与个人自由之间的紧张关系，这是历史上反复出现的主题。《箴言》29章2节谈到了治理不善的后果：“义人增多，民就喜乐；暴君掌权，民就叹息。”法律的适用，无论被视为公正还是压迫，都深刻地影响着民众。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

The movie also...

reflection.en: The story of Deanie Ip winning best actress for her role as an ageing domestic servant reminds us that every task, no matter how humble, can be performed with excellence and dignity. Colossians 3:23 calls us to do all our work heartily, as unto Yahweh, recognizing that our efforts have value beyond the immediate task. This recognition for Ip's performance...
reflection.zh: 叶德娴因饰演一位年迈的家政服务人员而荣获影后，这个故事提醒我们，无论多么卑微的任务，都可以被出色和有尊严地完成。歌罗西书3:23劝勉我们要全心全意地去做一切工作，如同为主而做，认识到我们的努力具有超越眼前任务的价值。...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

He joined Alibaba Group’s board as an independent...

reflection.en: Alibaba remembers Tung Chee-hwa, noting his global vision that helped the company balance national roots with international growth. This echoes the call in Micah 6:8 for leaders to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Such principles guide leaders to serve their organizations and communities with integrity and foresight.
reflection.zh: 阿里巴巴悼念董建华，指出他帮助公司平衡本土根基与国际增长的全球视野。这呼应了《弥迦书》6:8 中对领袖的要求——当行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与雅伟同行。这些原则指导领袖以正直和远见服务于他们的组织和社区。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

title.en: European innovators like what GBA has to offer
title.zh: 欧洲创新者看好大湾区前景

summary.en: A delegation of 20 European entrepreneurs and innovators concluded a five-day tour of the Greater Bay Area, deeming it a productive trip with potential for business expansion. The group, comprising winners of a tech competition and representatives from the EuroTech Federation, visited key technology hubs in Hong Kong,...
summary.zh: 一个由20名欧洲企业家和创新者组成的代表团结束了对大湾区的为期五天考察，称这是一次富有成效的旅程，并暗示了潜在的商机。该代表团包括一项科技竞赛的获奖者以及德国欧洲科技联合会的代表，他们参观了香港、深圳和广州的主要科技中心，包括香港的北部都会区和当地的研究机构。

body.en: European entrepreneurs and innovators on a government-led tour of the Greater Bay Area wrapped up their five-day trip on Friday, calling it a fruitful journey and hinting at potential business opportunities. The 20-strong delegation included winners of a tech competition co-organised by Hong Kong Talent Engage and the EuroTech Federation in Germany in June, along with representatives from the federation. The delegation toured major tech hubs in Hong Kong, Shenzhen and Guangzhou. During their stay in the SAR, they visited the Northern Metropolis and met with local research institutions. Cem Deniz Araz, a German physician and CEO of a startup developing an AI medical assistant, said he was impressed by the business opportunities and technology on offer in the GBA. “My impression was that it's really not just finance. I believe Hong Kong is mainly about finance, but there's also so many opportunities in healthcare,” he said. “In Germany, I also never have seen self-driving cars until now. In the Greater Bay Area, we just drove with one. That was really amazing, or a drone that has delivered us donuts. That was also a really cool experience.” Araz said he might establish a business presence in Hong Kong down the line. “Because we are at a really early stage that we just focus on Germany first, but as a subsidiary, maybe in the future also because Hong Kong has also an ageing population, this could be very valuable and also an opportunity to seek for.” Aleksandr Gorbunov from Russia, co-founder of an AI startup that automates clinical documentation and administrative workflows for medical practices, said the region's robotics sector has a strong appeal. “I think biotech and medicine, and robotics, these are the two things that we saw the most... the scale of it and also how advanced this is. “Like when we visited one of the robotics companies, they showed what their robots can do, like they can dance and behave almost as humans. That was really impressive.” He said he plans to launch robotics projects in Europe and would consider shifting manufacturing to the GBA in future. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun joined part of the delegation's visit to Cyberport, where he tried out workout bikes alongside participants. He said members of the delegation gave positive feedback about the tour. “They can see for themselves: the latest environment and the opportunities to develop here in the GBA. So I just had a brief chat with some of the members. They are very very impressed by what they saw,” he said. “So I'm sure with this short tour, a lot of them, I think when they're planning for the future, surely they will have the GBA in mind.” Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 周五，由政府主导的欧洲企业家和创新者结束了为期五天的大湾区之旅，称这是一次富有成果的旅程，并暗示了潜在的商机。该代表团由20人组成，其中包括香港人才参与与德国欧洲科技联合会于六月合办的科技竞赛的优胜者，以及该联合会的代表。代表团参观了香港、深圳和广州的主要科技中心。在特区期间，他们参观了北方都市并会见了当地的研究机构。德国医生、一家开发人工智能医疗助理的初创公司首席执行官杰姆·德尼兹·阿拉兹 (Cem Deniz Araz) 表示，大湾区提供的商机和技术给他留下了深刻的印象。 “我的印象是，这真的不仅仅是金融。我相信香港主要是金融，但医疗保健领域也有很多机会，”他说。 “在德国，我到现在为止也从未见过自动驾驶汽车。在大湾区，我们只开着一辆。这真是太棒了，或者是一架无人机给我们送了甜甜圈。这也是一次非常酷的体验。”阿拉兹表示，他可能会在香港建立业务。 “因为我们处于非常早期的阶段，我们首先只关注德国，但作为子公司，也许将来也因为香港人口老龄化，这可能非常有价值，也是一个值得寻求的机会。”来自俄罗斯的 Aleksandr Gorbunov 是一家人工智能初创公司的联合创始人，该公司致力于自动化医疗实践的临床文档和管理工作流程，他表示该地区的机器人行业具有强大的吸引力。 “我认为生物技术、医学和机器人技术是我们看到最多的两件事......它的规模以及它的先进性。“就像当我们参观一家机器人公司时，他们展示了他们的机器人可以做什么，就像它们可以像人类一样跳舞和表现。这真是令人印象深刻。”他表示，计划在欧洲启动机器人项目，并考虑未来将制造转移到大湾区。劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯参与代表团访问数码港的活动，并与参加者一起试用健身车。他表示，代表团成员对此次访问给予了积极评价。 “他们可以亲眼看到：大湾区最新的环境和发展机会。所以我只是和一些成员进行了简短的交谈。他们对所看到的印象非常深刻，”他说。“所以我确信，通过这次短暂的旅行，他们中的很多人在规划未来时，肯定会想到大湾区。”埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: This delegation's five-day tour of the Greater Bay Area was described as a 'fruitful journey' with 'potential business opportunities.' It's a reminder that human endeavors, from technological innovation to global business, are best undertaken with a commitment to a higher purpose. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to entrust our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our...
reflection.zh: 这个代表团对大湾区的五天考察被形容为一次“富有成效的旅程”，并暗示了“潜在的商机”。这提醒我们，从技术创新到全球商业，人类的努力最好是在致力于更高目标的情况下进行。《箴言》16:3鼓励我们将计划托付给雅伟，相信我们的努力将在祂的指引下得以建立和成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 2 men arrested at airport hours after allegedly breaking into MTR depot to graffiti trains
title.zh: 两名男子在涂鸦火车后数小时在机场被捕

summary.en: Two men have been arrested at Hong Kong's airport while waiting to board flights, hours after they allegedly broke into an MTR depot and spray-painted graffiti on a train. Police found cut barbed wire and graffiti on a train, with staff reporting two suspicious men fleeing the scene.
summary.zh: 两名男子在据称闯入港铁车厂并在一列火车上喷涂鸦数小时后，在香港机场候机时被捕。警方发现了被割断的铁丝网和火车上的涂鸦，工作人员报告称有两名可疑男子逃离现场。

body.en: Two men who allegedly broke into an MTR depot and spray-painted graffiti on a parked train have been arrested at the airport while waiting to board flights out of Hong Kong. Photos released by police showed a section of the barbed wire around Chai Wan MTR depot cut (left) and the graffiti spray-painted on a parked train (right). Photo: Hong Kong Police Force. Officers received a report from staff at the Chai Wan MTR depot at around 2pm on Wednesday that a train had been sprayed with two murals measuring one metre by five metres each, police said during a press briefing on Thursday. Staff also spotted two suspicious men fleeing the scene, they said. Police arrived at the scene and discovered that a section of barbed wire around the depot had been damaged. They also found tools believed to have been left behind by the suspects, including nine spray paint cans, a wooden ladder, and two high-visibility vests. Investigations suggested that the men had entered the depot through the section where the barbed wire had been cut. “MTR train depots are very critical infrastructure,” chief inspector Chan Chi-leung said in Cantonese. The MTR Corporation logo. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “The case involves destroying fencing around the depot, trespassing into the railway network, and spray-painting graffiti. Police are very concerned about this case,” he added. After reviewing CCTV footage, the two men were arrested for alleged criminal damage in the departure hall of Hong Kong International Airport at 8pm on Wednesday. The two men, both in their 30s, were bound for the US and Australia. Clothing they wore while committing the alleged offence was found in their luggage. Inspector Tse Hiu-wing said at the same press briefing that criminal damage is an extremely serious crime punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment. Besides endangering personal safety, trespassing into railway networks could also affect train services and facilities, she said. HKFP has reached out to MTR Corporation for comment.
body.zh: 两名男子涉嫌闯入港铁车站并在停放的火车上涂鸦，他们在等待登机离开香港时在机场被捕。警方公布的照片显示，柴湾港铁车厂周围的一段铁丝网被割断（左），以及停泊的列车上喷有涂鸦（右）。相片：香港警务处。警方在周四的新闻发布会上表示，周三下午2点左右，警方接到柴湾港铁车厂工作人员的报告，称一列火车被喷洒了两幅一米乘五米的壁画。他们说，工作人员还发现两名可疑男子逃离现场。警方赶到现场后发现，车站周围的一段铁丝网已被损坏。他们还发现了据信是嫌疑人留下的工具，包括九个喷漆罐、一个木梯和两件高可见度背心。调查显示，这些人是通过铁丝网被剪断的部分进入仓库的。 “港铁车厂是非常重要的基础设施，”总督察陈志良用粤语说。香港铁路公司标志。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “该案涉及破坏车厂周围围栏、侵入铁路网以及喷漆涂鸦。警方对此案非常关注，”他补充道。经过审查闭路电视录像后，两名男子于周三晚上 8 点在香港国际机场离境大厅因涉嫌刑事毁坏罪被捕。这两名男子都是 30 多岁，目的地是美国和澳大利亚。在他们的行李中发现了他们犯罪时穿的衣服。督察谢晓荣在同一场新闻发布会上表示，刑事毁坏是一项极其严重的罪行，最高可判处十年监禁。她说，除了危及人身安全外，侵入铁路网络还可能影响列车服务和设施。 HKFP 已联系港铁公司征求意见。

reflection.en: These two men, caught in the act of vandalism and attempting to flee, highlight a common human tendency to act without considering the ultimate consequences or accountability. Their plan to escape Hong Kong underscores a desire to avoid facing the results of their actions. The ancient wisdom reminds us that true security and purpose come from entrusting our...
reflection.zh: 这两名男子在被抓到破坏公物并试图逃跑时，凸显了一种常见的、不考虑最终后果或责任的行为模式。他们试图逃离香港的计划，表明了想要逃避承担其行为后果的愿望。古老的智慧提醒我们，真正的安全和目标来自于将我们的努力托付给更高的力量，而不是依赖我们自己的计划。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Manila exposes South China Sea note; Chinese coal mine farming plan: SCMP’s 7 highlights
title.zh: 马尼拉披露南海照会；中国煤矿耕种计划：SCMP本周七大看点

summary.en: This article presents seven selected news stories from Hong Kong, mainland China, the wider Asia region, and beyond that resonated with readers and illuminated topical issues. One of these stories involves Beijing accusing Philippine officials of 'grandstanding and lying' after Manila's defense secretary read aloud a...
summary.zh: 本文精选了本周来自香港、中国内地、亚洲地区及其他地方的七个新闻故事，这些故事引起了读者的共鸣，并阐明了热门议题。其中一个故事涉及北京指责菲律宾官员“哗众取宠和撒谎”，此前马尼拉国防部长公开宣读了一份中国外交官关于南海的照会。

body.en: We have selected seven stories from this week’s news across Hong Kong, mainland China, the wider Asia region and beyond that resonated with our readers and shed light on topical issues. If you would like to see more of our reporting, please consider subscribing. 1. Beijing tells Manila to ‘stop lying’ after minister exposes South China Sea note China has accused Philippine officials of “grandstanding and lying” after Manila’s defence secretary publicly read aloud a Chinese diplomat’s note on the...
body.zh: 我们从本周的新闻中精选了七个来自香港、中国大陆、整个亚洲地区及其他地区的故事，这些故事引起了我们的读者的共鸣，并阐明了热点问题。如果您想查看更多我们的报告，请考虑订阅。 1. 部长揭露南海照会后，北京要求马尼拉“停止撒谎”，在马尼拉国防部长公开宣读中国外交官关于南海问题的照会后，中国指责菲律宾官员“哗众取宠，撒谎”。

reflection.en: In the South China Sea dispute, a diplomatic note intended for private communication was publicly disclosed, escalating tensions. This situation underscores the challenge of navigating international relations, where even the revelation of sensitive communications can lead to accusations and further complicate efforts toward peaceful resolution. The pursuit...
reflection.zh: 在南海争端中，一份本应私下沟通的外交照会被公开披露，加剧了紧张局势。这种情况凸显了处理国际关系的挑战，即使是敏感信息的披露也可能导致指责，并使和平解决的努力更加复杂。追求和平需要谨慎处理信息并致力于对话，即使在分歧严重的情况下也是如此。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Cathay CEO sees great potential in AI scaling
title.zh: 国泰航空行政总裁看好人工智能的规模化应用潜力

summary.en: Cathay Pacific Airways CEO Ronald Lam stated that the airline sees significant potential in scaling up its use of artificial intelligence. The company currently operates over 120 large-scale AI models, with all office staff utilizing AI tools daily. AI usage has surged by 200% in the past year, and Lam emphasized that...
summary.zh: 国泰航空行政总裁林绍波表示，公司在扩大人工智能应用方面看到了巨大潜力。该公司目前已投入运营超过120个大型人工智能模型，所有办公室员工的日常工作都使用人工智能工具。过去一年，公司的人工智能使用量增长了200%。林绍波强调，人工智能旨在最大限度地减少重复性任务并协助人类员工，而非取代他们，同时需要在安全、可靠性和创新之间...

body.en: Cathay Pacific Airways chief executive Ronald Lam says he sees great potential for the airline to scale up its adoption of artificial intelligence. Speaking on RTHK’s "On Broadcast Drive" programme, he noted that the company already has more than 120 large-scale AI models in operation, with all office staff using AI tools in their daily work. “Over the past year, our company’s AI usage has increased by 200 percent. I see great potential in this field,” Lam said. “However, we still need to strike a balance between safety, reliability and innovation over AI development.” Lam stressed that AI is only used to minimise repetitive tasks and assist human workers, rather than replace them. On pilot recruitment and retention, he pointed out that the airline now employs around 3,800 pilots, over half of whom are locals. He stressed that Cathay's cadet pilot programme has been running for nearly four decades and has trained thousands of aviators, with 350 graduates currently flying as active pilots for the carrier. Lam added that pilot turnover and overall staff turnover remain very low. Looking ahead, the Cathay CEO emphasised that alongside hardware and software upgrades, the airline will invest heavily in improving service consistency, so as to ensure that passenger inconvenience is kept to a minimum even during severe weather disruptions. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 国泰航空首席执行官林绍波表示，他认为该航空公司在扩大人工智能应用方面具有巨大潜力。他在香港电台《广播之路》节目中表示，公司已有超过120个大型人工智能模型投入运行，所有办公室员工在日常工作中都使用人工智能工具。 “在过去的一年里，我们公司的人工智能使用量增加了 200%。我看到了这个领域的巨大潜力。”林说。 “但是，我们仍然需要在人工智能开发的安全性、可靠性和创新性之间取得平衡。”林强调，人工智能只是用来最大程度地减少重复性任务并协助人类工人，而不是取代他们。关于飞行员的招聘和保留，他指出，该航空公司目前雇用了约3,800名飞行员，其中一半以上是当地人。他强调，国泰学员飞行员计划已实施近四十年，培训了数千名飞行员，目前有350名毕业生在国泰航空担任现役飞行员。林补充说，飞行员流动率和整体员工流动率仍然很低。展望未来，国泰航空首席执行官强调，除了硬件和软件升级外，该航空公司还将大力投资提高服务一致性，以确保即使在恶劣天气干扰下，也将乘客的不便降至最低。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and adoption of artificial intelligence, as seen at Cathay Pacific, echo the ancient prophecy that 'knowledge will increase.' This technological surge offers immense potential for efficiency and assistance, yet it also calls for wisdom in balancing innovation with safety and reliability. As we embrace these powerful tools, may we seek...
reflection.zh: 国泰航空所展现的人工智能的快速发展和应用，呼应了古老的预言——“知识必然增长”。这种技术浪潮带来了提高效率和提供协助的巨大潜力，但也要求我们在创新与安全可靠之间寻求智慧的平衡。当我们拥抱这些强大的工具时，愿我们寻求分辨力，以善用它们，确保它们增强人类的能力而非削弱。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: New walkway 'to open up views of seawall’
title.zh: 新行人走道“将展现海堤景色”

summary.en: Ivan Ho, chairman of the Harbourfront Commission, stated on Friday that the construction of a new pedestrian walkway in Kennedy Town's praya would not harm the adjacent seawall. This assurance follows the Antiquities Advisory Board's decision to grant the seawall Grade 2 historical status the previous day. Ho...
summary.zh: 海滨事务委员会主席何德光周五表示，在卑路乍湾海滨兴建新的行人走道不会影响附近的海堤。此前一天，文物咨询委员会已将该海堤评为二级历史建筑。何德光在香港电台节目中说，当局在设计新走道时已考虑到海堤的历史价值。“当时考虑了很多因素，”他说。“我们希望设计能让市民从不同角度欣赏历史悠久的海堤。同时，当局也必须确保未来的施工不会...

body.en: Harbourfront Commission chairman Ivan Ho said on Friday that the construction of a new pedestrian walkway at the praya of Kennedy Town would not affect a seawall there. This came after the Antiquities Advisory Board granted a grade 2 historical status to the seawall a day earlier. Speaking on an RTHK programme, Ho said the authorities had taken the seawall’s historical value into consideration when designing the new walkway. “A lot of factors were considered at the time," he said. "We hope the design will allow people to appreciate the historic seawall from different angles. “Meanwhile, authorities also have to make sure the future construction work will not compromise the seawall’s stability.” Ho hopes the authorities can use technology to showcase the history of the praya as part of a working harbour. He called for more efforts to make the background and history of the seawall better known to the public. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 海滨委员会主席何君尧周五表示，在坚尼地城海旁兴建新行人道不会影响该处的海堤。此前一天，古物咨询委员会授予该海堤二级历史地位。何在香港电台节目中表示，当局在设计新步道时已考虑到海堤的历史价值。 “当时考虑了很多因素，”他说。 “我们希望这个设计能让人们从不同的角度欣赏历史悠久的海堤。同时，当局也必须确保未来的建设工作不会损害海堤的稳定性。”何希望当局能够利用技术来展示海堤作为工作港口的一部分的历史。他呼吁进一步努力让公众更多地了解海堤的背景和历史。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As new projects take shape, the careful balance between progress and preservation is key. The design of Kennedy Town's new walkway considers both the future enjoyment of the public and the historical significance of the seawall. This echoes the wisdom of committing our endeavors to divine guidance, trusting that our plans, when aligned with thoughtful...
reflection.zh: 随着新项目的成形，在进步与保护之间取得平衡至关重要。卑路乍湾新走道的规划，既考虑了公众未来的享用，也顾及了海堤的历史意义。这呼应了将我们的工作交托给神指引的智慧，相信当我们深思熟虑并尊重过往，我们的计划便能得以建立并成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: June 4 vigil leaders jailed for subversion
title.zh: 六四集會領袖因顛覆罪被判刑

summary.en: Three former leaders of the group that organized the June 4th vigils were sentenced in the High Court on Friday for subversion. Chow Hang-tung received seven years and three months, Lee Cheuk-yan seven years, and Albert Ho five years and two months. The Hong Kong Alliance was fined HK$1.5 million. The court found that...
summary.zh: 周五，高等法院就顛覆案判處了三個前支聯會領袖。周庭棟被判監七年零三個月，李卓人判監七年，何俊仁判監五年零兩個月。支聯會被罰款一百五十萬港元。法庭裁定，該組織在2020年7月實施《國家安全法》後，繼續推廣其議程，包括「結束一黨專政」。

body.en: The High Court on Friday sentenced three former leaders of the group behind the June 4th vigils in their subversion case. Chow Hang‑tung of the now‑defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China was imprisoned for seven years and three months. Lee Cheuk‑yan got a seven-year sentence, while Albert Ho was jailed for five years and two months. The alliance was fined HK$1.5 million. The court heard that the group continued to promote its agenda, including "end one‑party dictatorship" after the National Security Law (NSL) was implemented in July 2020. In sentencing, judges Alex Lee, Johnny Chan and Anna Lai found the incitement to subversion offence to be of a serious nature, even though there was no violence involved or any specific means of implementation or timetable was put forward to "end one-party dictatorship". The judges cited six reasons as to why the offence was deemed to be of a serious nature, among them the turbulent social atmosphere at the time, the continuation of the defendants' activities for as long as 14 months after the NSL's implementation, and their mobilising power and influence in Hong Kong. "The Court reiterated that the NSL had no retrospective effect and that the defendants were put on trial not because of their political ideology or their words and deeds before the NSL," they wrote. "They were convicted solely on the basis that they had committed acts in violation of the NSL during the charge period." Under the NSL, those who committed offences of a "serious nature" face five to 10 years in jail, whereas offences of a "minor nature" would lead to prison terms of less than five years. The judges said the three defendants had all served on the alliance's standing committee and "their culpability was essentially the same", and adopted seven years and six months’ imprisonment as the starting point. All three received a three-month sentence discount with the defence "having substantially admitted the prosecution case, thereby saving considerable trial time and public funds" as well as "the repeated postponements of the trial due to unforeseen circumstances which would have caused them a certain degree of psychological stress". Lee Cheuk‑yan and Ho each received an additional three-month discount for their long public service. Ho's sentence was further reduced by 22 months for his guilty plea after the committal proceedings. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 周五，高等法院对 6 月 4 日守夜活动背后的该组织的三名前领导人进行了颠覆罪判决。现已解散的香港爱国民主运动联盟成员周恒东被判入狱七年零三个月。李卓人被判入狱七年，何俊仁则被判入狱五年零两个月。该联盟被罚款150万港元。法庭获悉，该组织在2020年7月实施《国安法》后，继续推动其议程，包括“结束一党独裁”。法官在判刑时，认为煽动颠覆罪性质严重，尽管没有涉及暴力，也没有提出“结束一党独裁”的具体实施方式或时间表。法官列举了六大原因，包括当时的社会风气、被告在《国家安全法》实施后长达14个月的活动持续时间，以及他们在香港的动员力和影响力等六大理由。他们写道：“法院重申，国家安全法没有追溯力，被告受审并不是因为他们的政治意识形态或在国家安全法之前的言行。” “他们被定罪只是因为他们在指控期间犯下了违反国家安全法的行为。”根据《国家安全法》，犯下“性质严重”罪行的人将面临 5 至 10 年监禁，而犯下“轻微性质”罪行的人将被判处 5 年以下监禁。法官表示，三名被告均曾担任联盟常务委员会成员，“罪名基本相同”，并以七年零六个月监禁为起点。三人均获得三个月减刑，理由是辩方“实质上承认了检方的指控，从而节省了大量的审判时间和公共资金”，而且“由于不可预见的情况而多次推迟审判，会给他们带来一定程度的心理压力”。李卓人和何先生因长期担任公职而各获得三个月的额外折扣。何志平在羁押程序后因认罪而被进一步减刑 22 个月。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and other leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance for subversion raises profound questions about conscience and obedience. When laws compel actions or silence that violate deeply held convictions, the dilemma of whether to obey human authorities or a higher moral calling becomes acute. The apostles' declaration, 'We must obey God...
reflection.zh: 香港支聯會領袖周庭棟等人因顛覆罪被判刑，這引發了關於良心與順服的深刻問題。當法律強迫人們採取違背其堅定信念的行動或沉默時，服從人類權威還是更高的道德召喚的兩難局面變得尖銳。使徒們的宣告「我們必須服從雅偉，而不是人」在這樣的時刻迴響。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Hong Kong police arrest 2 tourists over graffiti on MTR Corp train carriages
title.zh: 香港警方逮捕两名游客，因其在港铁公司列车车厢上涂鸦

summary.en: Hong Kong police arrested two tourists at the airport on suspicion of criminal damage after they allegedly broke into an MTR Corporation depot in Chai Wan and spray-painted graffiti on the exterior of two carriages. The incident involved cutting through barbed wire to access the depot and defacing the trains.
summary.zh: 香港警方在机场逮捕了两名游客，怀疑他们犯有刑事损坏罪。据称，这两名男子闯入柴湾的一处港铁公司车厂，并在两节列车车厢外喷涂了涂鸦。事件涉及他们割断铁丝网进入车厂并破坏列车。

The force said on Thursday evening that it had received a report at about 2pm the previous day that the two men had forced their way into the depot by cutting sections of barbed wire at the top of its walls. They allegedly spray-painted each of the carriages with a...

The Bible calls us to approach all our tasks, whether grand or seemingly small, with diligence and integrity, as if serving a higher purpose. This principle encourages a mindset where even the maintenance and operation of public...

title.en: Kazakhstani firms eyeing Hong Kong, mainland China urged to take long-term view
title.zh: 哈萨克斯坦公司着眼香港、中国内地市场被敦促采取长远眼光

summary.en: Kazakhstan's businesses are advised by a managing director of the country's sovereign wealth fund to focus on long-term fundraising goals rather than short-term gains in Hong Kong and mainland China markets. The goal is to list state-owned rail operator Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (KTZ) in Hong Kong by year-end.

Saltanat Satzhan, managing director for development and privatisation at Samruk-Kazyna, said she also aimed to have state-owned rail operator Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (KTZ) listed in Hong Kong by the end of the year. KTZ, wholly owned by the government through the fund, has...

Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. This principle encourages diligence and faithfulness in our work, seeking His guidance for sustainable success rather...

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。
