title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists jailed for up to 7 years, 3 months for inciting subversion, group fined HK$1.5 million
title.zh: 香港天安门守夜活动人士因煽动颠覆国家政权罪被判监禁，最高可达7年3个月，团体被罚款150万港元

summary.en: Three activists who organized annual vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown have been sentenced to prison terms of up to seven years and three months for inciting subversion under the national security law. The sentences were handed down by designated judges at the West Kowloon Law Courts Building.
summary.zh: 三名曾组织纪念1989年天安门镇压事件年度守夜活动的人士，因在国安法下煽动颠覆国家政权罪被判处最高七年零三个月监禁。判决由西九龙法院大楼的指定法官作出。

body.en: Three activists who once organised annual vigils to mark the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown crackdown have been sentenced to up to seven years and three months in prison. The Tiananmen vigil in Victoria Park on June 4, 2018. Photo: Anthony Wallace/AFP. Appearing before a panel of designated judges at the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan, and Albert Ho were handed the jail terms for inciting subversion under the Beijing-imposed national security law. Lee received a jail sentence of seven years, Chow was jailed for seven years and three months and Ho – who pleaded guilty – received a sentence of five years and two months imprisonment. The Hong Kong Tiananmen crackdown vigil on June 4, 2019. Photo: Todd R. Darling/HKFP. The trio formerly led the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China , a now-defunct activist group that held annual vigils to remember the Tiananmen dead. The Alliance itself was handed a fine of HK$1.5 million on Friday, to be paid within three months. The Tiananmen crackdown occurred on June 4, 1989, ending months of student-led demonstrations in China. It is estimated that hundreds, perhaps thousands, died when the People’s Liberation Army cracked down on protesters in Beijing. A Correctional Services van outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, September 11, 2026, ahead of the sentencing of Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan, and Albert Ho. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The group held the mass candlelit vigils until the event was banned in 2020, with the government citing pandemic curbs, and again the following year. They voted to disband in September 2021. Friday’s ruling said that the present case did not involve violence or the threat of violence, “nor had the defendant put forward any specific means of implementation or timetable” to end one-party rule in mainland China – one of the Alliance’s central tenets. Nevertheless, the court still found that the offence was “of a serious nature.” That placed the defendants within the higher of the two sentencing bands under the Beijing-imposed national security law, it added. Police gathered outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, September 11, 2026 ahead of the sentencing of Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan, and Albert Ho. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to the ruling’s press summary, the court reiterated that the National Security Law (NSL) “had no retrospective effect” and that the trio were convicted solely on the basis that they had violated the legislation. But the judges also said that the court would consider the broader social context “as part of the overall background of the case.” Plus, they took into...
body.zh: 三名曾组织年度守夜活动纪念 1989 年天安门镇压事件的活动人士被判处最高七年零三个月的监禁。 2018 年 6 月 4 日在维多利亚公园举行的天安门守夜活动。照片：Anthony Wallace/法新社。周五，周恒东、李卓人和何俊仁在西九龙法院大楼的指定法官面前出庭，根据北京实施的国家安全法，因煽动颠覆罪被判入狱。李被判入狱七年，周被判入狱七年零三个月，而认罪的何被判入狱五年零两个月。 2019 年 6 月 4 日香港天安门镇压守夜活动。照片：Todd R. Darling/HKFP。这三人曾领导香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟，这是一个现已解散的活动组织，每年举行守夜活动以纪念天安门死难者。该联盟本身于周五被处以 150 万港元的罚款，并须在三个月内支付。天安门镇压发生于 1989 年 6 月 4 日，结束了中国学生领导的数月示威活动。据估计，中国人民解放军镇压北京抗议者时，有数百人甚至数千人死亡。 2026 年 9 月 11 日星期五，一辆惩教署货车停在西九龙法院大楼外，天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、李卓人和何俊仁即将被判刑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该组织举行了大规模的烛光守夜活动，直到 2020 年该活动因政府限制大流行而被禁止，并于次年再次举行。他们于 2021 年 9 月投票决定解散。周五的裁决称，本案不涉及暴力或暴力威胁，“被告也没有提出任何具体的实施方式或时间表”来结束中国大陆的一党统治——这是该联盟的核心原则之一。尽管如此，法院仍然认为该罪行“性质严重”。报告补充说，根据北京实施的国家安全法，这将被告置于两个量刑区间中较高的一个量刑区间内。 2026 年 9 月 11 日星期五，在对天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、李卓人和何俊仁宣判之前，警方聚集在西九龙法院大楼外。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据裁决的新闻摘要，法院重申，《国家安全法》“没有追溯力”，三人仅因违反该法而被定罪。但法官们也表示，法院将考虑更广泛的社会背景“作为案件整体背景的一部分”。另外，他们考虑到...

reflection.en: The sentencing of these activists underscores a profound tension between allegiance to the state and adherence to conscience. When laws compel actions or silence that violate deeply held beliefs, individuals face difficult choices about where ultimate loyalty lies. The verse reminds us that obedience to divine principles can sometimes necessitate civil...
reflection.zh: 对这些活动人士的判刑，凸显了国家法律与良心遵循之间的深刻张力。当法律迫使人们采取违背其坚定信念的行动或保持沉默时，个人将面临关于最终忠诚何处的艰难抉择。这节经文提醒我们，服从神圣原则有时可能需要公民不服从。

title.en: Suicide rate among children under 15 tripled last year, as researchers urge schools and media to do better
title.zh: 香港15岁以下儿童自杀率去年翻三倍，研究人员敦促学校和媒体做得更好

summary.en: A university research center has urged schools to strengthen mental health awareness among students after statistics revealed a rise in the suicide rate for children under 15 last year. While the overall suicide rate fell, the rate among young teens increased.
summary.zh: 一个大学研究中心敦促学校加强对学生的心理健康意识，此前有统计数据显示，去年15岁以下儿童的自杀率有所上升。尽管总体自杀率有所下降，但青少年自杀率却在同期上升。

body.en: A university research centre has urged schools to strengthen mental health awareness among students after statistics revealed a rise in the suicide rate for children under 15 last year. A man sits on a bench in Hong Kong. File photo: GovHK. The Hong Kong Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong announced the city’s latest suicide statistics on Thursday. While the overall suicide rate fell from 13.8 per 100,000 residents in 2024 to 13 per 100,000 residents in 2025, the suicide rate among young teens increased in the same period. 💡 If you are in need of support , please call: The Samaritans 2896 0000 (24-hour, multilingual), Suicide Prevention Centre 2382 0000 or the gov’ t mental health hotline on 18111. The Hong Kong Society of Counselling and Psychology provides a WhatsApp hotline in English and Chinese: 6218 1084. See also: HKFP’s mental health services guide. The suicide rate for those under 15 was 2.9 per 100,000 residents last year, up from 0.9 per 100,000 residents in 2024. The research centre said there were 15 known suicide cases among this age group last year. Among them were 14 males and one female. In 2024, there were six cases – one male and five females. Speaking at a press briefing on Thursday, researchers at the centre said schools should enhance mental health awareness and foster better peer relationships. Hong Kong’s cityscape. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The release of the statistics comes one week after the start of the new school year. Paul Yip, the centre’s founding director, said he hoped that teachers could support new students in their transition from primary to secondary school. “You have a whole year to teach. In these first two weeks, it’s important to give them time to build relationships,” he said in Cantonese. A majority of the students who died by suicide last year faced academic pressure and problems with peers, the centre added. Research also showed that most of the suicides occurred at home, and that all suicide notes and expressions of suicidal ideation were in “digital form.” Students in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In more than 30 per cent of the cases, the students were from Band A1 schools – the top tier of local secondary schools. The centre’s statistics for 2025 are still preliminary figures based on numbers from the Coroner’s Court, which takes time to determine the causes and circumstances of deaths. Media reporting The centre also looked at how local media report on suicide, citing the “Werther effect,” which suggests that vulnerable individuals may imitate suicide when media present it in a sensational or detailed manner. Researchers analysed 1,200 suicide-related news...
body.zh: 统计数据显示去年 15 岁以下儿童自杀率上升后，一所大学研究中心敦促学校加强学生的心理健康意识。香港，一名男子坐在长凳上。资料图片：香港政府一站通。香港大学香港赛马会自杀研究及预防中心周四公布了香港最新的自杀统计数据。虽然总体自杀率从 2024 年的每 10 万居民 13.8 人下降到 2025 年的每 10 万居民 13 人，但同期青少年的自杀率却有所上升。 💡 如果您需要支援，请致电：撒玛利亚会 2896 0000（24小时，多语种）、预防自杀中心 2382 0000 或政府心理健康热线 18111。香港辅导及心理学会提供中英文 WhatsApp 热线：6218 1084。另请参阅：HKFP 心理健康热线卫生服务指南。去年15岁以下人群的自杀率为每10万居民2.9人，而2024年为每10万居民0.9人。该研究中心表示，去年该年龄段已知的自杀案件有15起。其中，男性14名，女性1名。 2024 年，有 6 例病例——1 名男性和 5 名女性。该中心的研究人员在周四的新闻发布会上表示，学校应提高心理健康意识并培养更好的同伴关系。香港的城市景观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。统计数据是在新学年开始一周后发布的。该中心的创始主任叶保罗表示，他希望老师们能够支持新生从小学到中学的过渡。 “你有一整年的时间来教书。在前两周，给他们时间建立关系很重要，”他用粤语说。该中心补充说，去年自杀身亡的大多数学生都面临学业压力和与同龄人的问题。研究还表明，大多数自杀发生在家里，所有自杀笔记和自杀意念的表达都是“数字形式”。香港的学生。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在超过 30% 的案例中，学生来自 A1 级学校——当地顶级中学。该中心2025年的统计数据仍是基于验尸法庭数据的初步数据，确定死亡原因和情况需要时间。媒体报道 该中心还研究了当地媒体如何报道自杀，并引用了“维特效应”，即当媒体以耸人听闻或详细的方式报道自杀时，弱势群体可能会模仿自杀。研究人员分析了 1,200 条与自杀相关的新闻...

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong about the tripling of the suicide rate among children under 15 is a heartbreaking indicator of deep distress. In the face of such profound sorrow, Psalm 34:18 reminds us that Yahweh is near to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit. May we, as a community, extend compassion and support to those struggling,...
reflection.zh: 香港15岁以下儿童自杀率翻三倍的消息，令人心碎，这是深层痛苦的严峻信号。面对如此巨大的悲伤，诗篇34:18提醒我们，雅伟靠近心碎的人，拯救灵里忧伤的人。愿我们作为一个社群，向那些挣扎中的人伸出同情和支持之手，反映那临近受苦之人的神圣临在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: Nearly 40% of Hong Kong’s elderly face medium to extreme heat risk – Greenpeace
title.zh: 香港近四成老年人面临中度至极端高温风险——绿色和平

summary.en: A new study by Greenpeace reveals that almost 40% of Hong Kong's elderly population resides in areas categorized as having medium to high or high-extreme heat risk. The NGO assessed these risks by considering factors like temperature fluctuations, the concentration of senior citizens, and income levels, identifying...
summary.zh: 非政府组织绿色和平的一项新研究发现，香港近40%的老年人口居住在面临中度至高风险或高至极端高温风险的地区。该组织通过评估昼夜温差、老年人口密度和收入水平等因素来评估全港各区的极端高温风险，并将观塘、葵青、屯门和黄大仙列为风险最高的地区。这些地区均有大量旧楼宇，且低收入老年居民众多，其中许多人独居。

body.en: Nearly 40 per cent of Hong Kong’s elderly live in districts with medium to high or high-extreme heat risk, a new study has found. A subdivided unit in Kwun Tong, on February 8, 2025. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. NGO Greenpeace said on Thursday that it evaluated extreme heat risks in districts across the city by assessing factors such as day and night temperatures, concentrations of senior citizens, and income levels. Kwun Tong, Kwai Tsing, Tuen Mun, and Wong Tai Sin comprised the highest-risk areas, the NGO said. All four contain many old buildings as well as a high number of low-income elderly residents, some of whom live alone, the NGO said. The four districts only have one heat shelter each and these are located far from the areas where many elderly live. They also a lack outdoor green space, Greenpeace added. NGO Greenpeace’s heat map showing heat risks to the elderly across Hong Kong. Photo: Greenpeace. According to the group’s heat map, neighbourhoods with more greenery and country parks generally pose the lowest risk. On Hong Kong Island, Shek O, The Peak, and Pok Fu Lam were logged as low risk, while parts of Aberdeen and Eastern District were higher-risk. More extreme weather Hong Kong’s summer again set record high temperatures this year, with the mercury reaching 39.8 degrees Celsius in Sheung Shui in August. The official temperature at the Hong Kong Observatory also set a historical high that day. In June, the Observatory warned of more extreme weather in the coming year due to climate change and forecasts of a “super-strong El Niño event.” Ren Chao, a climate change expert at the University of Hong Kong’s architecture department who worked with Greenpeace, said the Hong Kong Observatory has predicted that the number of “hot nights” a year could reach 80 or more by 2040. The Observatory defines hot nights as ones when the minimum temperature is 28 degrees Celsius or above. Last year , there were 54 hot nights. A woman walks under an umbrella in Hong Kong on May 8, 2024. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Extreme heat risks vary across Hong Kong depending on neighbourhood planning. The government must act early to identify high-risk areas and deliver immediate interventions,” Ren said in a Chinese-language statement. See also: ‘Covered in bites’: Pests and extreme heat worsen health risks for Hong Kong’s homeless – NGO For example, authorities could consider opening additional heat shelters in new developments like the Northern Metropolis, she said, referring to the major government infrastructure project near the city’s border with mainland China. Greenpeace urged the government to announce measures relating to extreme heat in the Policy Address due to be delivered by the chief...
body.zh: 一项新研究发现，近 40% 的香港老年人居住在中度至高度或高度极端高温风险的地区。 2025 年 2 月 8 日，观塘的一个劏房单位。照片：James Lee/HKFP。非政府组织绿色和平组织周四表示，它通过评估昼夜气温、老年人集中度和收入水平等因素，评估了全市各地区的极端高温风险。该非政府组织表示，观塘、葵青、屯门和黄大仙是风险最高的地区。该非政府组织表示，这四个项目都包含许多旧建筑以及大量低收入老年居民，其中一些人独居。这四个区各只有一个避暑所，而且距离许多老年人居住的地区很远。绿色和平组织补充说，他们还缺乏户外绿地。非政府组织绿色和平组织的热图显示了香港老年人面临的高温风险。照片：绿色和平组织。根据该组织的热图，拥有更多绿化和郊野公园的社区通常面临的风险最低。在香港岛，石澳、山顶和薄扶林被列为低风险，而香港仔和东区的部分地区则为高风险。极端天气增多 香港今年夏季再次创下高温纪录，8月份上水气温达到39.8摄氏度。香港天文台的官方气温当天也创下历史新高。 6月，天文台警告称，由于气候变化，未来一年将出现更多极端天气，并预测将出现“超强厄尔尼诺事件”。与绿色和平合作的香港大学建筑系气候变化专家任超表示，香港天文台预测，到2040年，每年“热夜”的数量将达到80个或更多。天文台将热夜定义为最低气温在28摄氏度或以上的夜晚。去年，有 54 个炎热的夜晚。 2024 年 5 月 8 日，香港，一名妇女在雨伞下行走。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “香港各地的极端高温风险因社区规划而异。政府必须及早采取行动，识别高风险地区并立即采取干预措施，”任正非在一份中文声明中表示。另请参阅：“被叮咬”：害虫和极端高温加剧了香港无家可归者的健康风险 - 非政府组织 例如，她说，当局可以考虑在北方都市等新开发项目中开设更多避暑所，她指的是该市与中国大陆边境附近的主要政府基础设施项目。绿色和平组织敦促政府在行政长官发表的施政报告中宣布有关极端高温的措施。

reflection.en: This report from Hong Kong paints a stark picture of vulnerability, with nearly 40% of the elderly population facing significant heat risks in their neighborhoods. The study points to factors like older buildings and lower incomes exacerbating this danger, particularly for those living alone. It calls us to consider how we can advocate for and protect the...
reflection.zh: 香港的这项报告描绘了一幅严峻的脆弱景象，近40%的老年人口居住的社区面临着显著的高温风险。研究指出，老旧建筑和较低的收入等因素加剧了这种危险，特别是对于独居老人而言。这促使我们思考如何为我们中间最脆弱的群体发声并保护他们，确保他们的安全和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案件中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China. This charge falls under the national security law and carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment. Prosecutors allege Wong worked with another activist to...
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主活动人士黄之锋周三承认，他曾密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁。这项国安法指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检方指控黄之锋与另一位活动人士合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁或其他敌对措施。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to charges under Hong Kong's national security law. This situation highlights the tension between civic obedience and conscience, a theme echoed in Acts 5:29: "We must obey God rather than human beings." While the legal system determines guilt and punishment, the underlying question for many is how to navigate conflicting...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋已承认在香港国安法下被控罪名。这一情况凸显了公民服从与良知之间的紧张关系，这与《使徒行传》5章29节所呼应的主题：“我们必须顺从神，过于顺从人”不谋而合。虽然法律体系决定了罪与罚，但对许多人来说，根本问题在于当法律似乎要求违背根深蒂固的道德或精神信念的行为时，如何处理相互冲突的忠诚。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Indonesia seeks to bring back baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India
title.zh: 印尼寻求遣返据称被贩运至印度的幼年猩猩

summary.en: Indonesian authorities are working to repatriate five baby orangutans who were allegedly trafficked to India. The critically endangered animals were discovered motherless by rangers in a forest in India's eastern Odisha state, prompting a criminal investigation into suspected trafficking.
summary.zh: 印度东部奥里萨邦的巡逻人员在森林中发现了五只据称被贩运至印度的幼年猩猩，它们没有母亲。印尼当局正着手遣返这些动物，并已展开刑事调查。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Indonesian authorities are working to repatriate five baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India, where they were found motherless in a forest, Jakarta's forestry ministry told AFP on Friday.

The critically endangered animals were found Tuesday by rangers patrolling Balasore district in India's eastern Odisha state.

Authorities suspect the primates, known for their shaggy red fur, were trafficked into India, sparking a criminal investigation.

The youngsters, estimated to be about 1 1/2 years old, appeared healthy and were being cared for at a zoo after their rescue, the ministry said in a statement.

Orangutans in the wild are native only to Indonesia's Sumatra and Borneo, which it shares with Malaysia and Brunei.

The five infants appeared to be of Sumatran origin, the ministry said, and DNA tests will be used to confirm where they came from.

According to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), which lists Sumatran orangutans as critically endangered, the young of the species are weaned only at about 7 years of age.

The last estimate of the species' population size, in 2016, was just over 13,500.

The Indonesian government has requested that India hand over the apes, forestry ministry spokesman Ristianto Pribadi told AFP on Friday.

"The forestry ministry has begun communicating with the government of India through the Indian embassy in Jakarta," he said.

Jakarta has also been in touch with conservation NGOs to help rehabilitate the baby orangutans, the ministry statement added.

Sumatran orangutan population decline is blamed on habitat loss and fragmentation due to human encroachment, as well as illegal hunting.

The Tapanuli orangutan, another species native to Sumatra, is also classified as critically endangered, with fewer than 800 believed to be left in the wild.

Panut Hadisiswoyo, founder of the Orangutan Information Centre, an NGO, said it supported bringing the primates home.

"Repatriation should be the priority," he said. "In my opinion, the DNA tests can be done after repatriation."

Wild orangutans have been under pressure in recent weeks from forest fires that have plagued the region and consumed swaths of Borneo.

In Borneo's West Kalimantan province, at least 15 of the animals have been rescued from flames and haze since July, some stuck in plantations after fires cut off access to their forest home.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 雅加达林业部周五告诉法新社，印度尼西亚当局正在努力遣返五只据称被贩运到印度的小猩猩，它们在印度的森林中被发现失去了母亲。 周二，印度东部奥里萨邦巴拉索尔地区巡逻的护林员发现了这些极度濒危动物。 当局怀疑这些以蓬松的红色皮毛而闻名的灵长类动物被贩运到印度，引发了刑事调查。 该部在一份声明中表示，这些幼崽估计约为 1 1/2 岁，看上去很健康，获救后正在动物园接受照顾。 野生猩猩仅原产于印度尼西亚的苏门答腊岛和婆罗洲，与马来西亚和文莱共享。 该部表示，这五名婴儿似乎是苏门答腊岛血统，DNA 测试将用于确认他们来自哪里。 根据将苏门答腊猩猩列为极度濒危物种的国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 的说法，该物种的幼崽只有在 7 岁左右才会断奶。 2016 年对该物种种群规模的最新估计略高于 13,500 只。 林业部发言人里斯蒂安托·普里巴迪周五告诉法新社，印度尼西亚政府已要求印度交出这些类人猿。 “林业部已开始通过印度驻雅加达大使馆与印度政府进行沟通，”他说。 该部门的声明补充说，雅加达还与保护非政府组织保持联系，以帮助小猩猩康复。 苏门答腊猩猩数量下降被归咎于人类侵占和非法狩猎导致的栖息地丧失和破碎化。 另一种原产于苏门答腊岛的打巴努里猩猩也被列为极度濒危物种，据信野外生存数量不足 800 只。 非政府组织猩猩信息中心创始人帕努特·哈迪西斯沃约 (Panut Hadisiswoyo) 表示，该中心支持将灵长类动物带回家。 “遣返应该是首要任务，”他说。 “我认为，DNA检测可以在遣返后进行。” 最近几周，野生猩猩一直面临着困扰该地区并吞噬了婆罗洲大片地区的森林火灾的压力。 在婆罗洲的西加里曼丹省，自 7 月以来，至少有 15 只动物从火焰和雾霾中被救出，其中一些动物因大火切断了它们通往森林家园的通道而被困在种植园里。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The plight of these five young orangutans, found alone and allegedly trafficked, calls to mind the vulnerability of creatures who cannot advocate for themselves. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for everyone who is silenced. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy." May this effort...
reflection.zh: 这五只幼年猩猩的困境，它们被发现独自一人且据称遭到贩运，提醒我们那些无法为自己发声的生灵是多么脆弱。《箴言》31:8-9 提醒我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦无告的人伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判；要为困苦和贫穷的人维护权利。”愿遣返这些动物的努力能反映出更广泛地保护无声者的承诺。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Researchers eye AI revolution in natural disaster forecasts
title.zh: 研究人员关注人工智能革命在自然灾害预报中的应用

summary.en: Researchers in Switzerland are leveraging AI and vast NASA climate data, processed by powerful supercomputers, to revolutionize natural disaster forecasting, aiming to produce life-saving information with unprecedented speed and identify patterns previously unseen by scientists.
summary.zh: 瑞士的研究人员正在利用人工智能和海量的美国宇航局（NASA）气候数据，通过强大的超级计算机进行处理，以革新自然灾害的预报，目标是以前所未有的速度生成拯救生命的预警信息，并识别出科学家们以前未曾发现的模式。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A revolution in forecasting natural disasters is underway, say researchers in Switzerland who are training AI models using vast troves of NASA climate data to produce potentially lifesaving data at lightning speed.

They are feeding the NASA data archive into one of the world's most powerful supercomputers so artificial intelligence can speed up and expand vital weather and climate forecasting, and spot patterns scientists could not have seen.

AI models are increasingly used in weather and climate forecasting and for early detection of natural hazards .

As well as speed, they carry the promise of spotting previously imperceptible patterns in satellite and other data, potentially making it possible to flag disasters in advance, like Nepal's devastating flood, which last month left thousands dead or missing.

But training such AI models requires vast amounts of high-quality climate and Earth observation data, and significant computing power.

Researchers at Switzerland's Federal Institute of Technology Zurich (ETH) say they now have both, after copying around 100 petabytes of publicly available NASA data onto servers adjacent to one of the world's most powerful supercomputers, known as Alps.

"This is a huge scientific opportunity," said Thomas Schulthess, an ETH computational physics professor and head of the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) in the southern city of Lugano.

Standing in front of rows of what look like giant filing cabinets that contain Alps, he told AFP he was excited to have all of NASA's climate data plugged directly into the machine.

"It's really enabling scientists to do things we would not even have thought of before," he said.

It took approximately a year to copy the roughly 6 billion NASA files onto servers connected to the supercomputer, said Reto Knutti, a climate physics professor who heads ETH's Center for Climate Systems Modeling (C2SM).

That is equivalent to around 20 million feature-length films in terms of data volume, or around a million times the storage on a typical computer, he told AFP.

Now the researchers are using the mass of information to develop AI models that can speed up and expand vital weather and climate forecasting.

That is where the proximity to the massive computing power of Alps comes in, Schulthess said, nodding to the clusters of servers humming loudly just meters from the supercomputer.

"It matters whether you can move the data within a few seconds or whether you have to wait days for the data to come," he said.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 瑞士的研究人员表示，一场预测自然灾害的革命正在进行中，他们正在利用 NASA 的大量气候数据来训练人工智能模型，以闪电般的速度生成可能挽救生命的数据。 他们正在将美国宇航局的数据档案输入世界上最强大的超级计算机之一，以便人工智能可以加速和扩展重要的天气和气候预测，并发现科学家无法看到的模式。 人工智能模型越来越多地用于天气和气候预测以及自然灾害的早期发现。 除了速度之外，它们还有望发现卫星和其他数据中以前难以察觉的模式，从而有可能提前标记灾难，例如尼泊尔上个月发生的毁灭性洪水，造成数千人死亡或失踪。 但训练此类人工智能模型需要大量高质量的气候和地球观测数据以及强大的计算能力。 瑞士苏黎世联邦理工学院 (ETH) 的研究人员表示，在将大约 100 PB 的 NASA 公开数据复制到与世界上最强大的超级计算机之一 Alps 相邻的服务器上后，他们现在两者都具备了。 “这是一个巨大的科学机会，”瑞士联邦理工学院计算物理学教授、南部城市卢加诺瑞士国家超级计算中心（CSCS）负责人托马斯·舒尔泰斯（Thomas Schulthess）说。 他站在一排排看起来像是包含阿尔卑斯山的巨型文件柜前，他告诉法新社，他很高兴能将美国宇航局的所有气候数据直接插入机器中。 “这确实使科学家能够做我们以前从未想过的事情，”他说。 ETH 气候系统建模中心 (C2SM) 负责人、气候物理学教授雷托·克努蒂 (Reto Knutti) 表示，将大约 60 亿个 NASA 文件复制到与超级计算机相连的服务器上大约需要一年的时间。 他告诉法新社，就数据量而言，这相当于大约 2000 万部故事片长度的电影，或者是典型计算机上存储空间的大约一百万倍。 现在，研究人员正在利用大量信息来开发人工智能模型，以加速和扩展重要的天气和气候预测。 舒尔塞斯说，这就是靠近阿尔卑斯山的巨大计算能力的地方，他对距离超级计算机仅几米远的服务器集群点了点头。 “是否可以在几秒钟内移动数据，或者是否需要等待数天才能收到数据，这很重要，”他说。 新的人工智能生成的统计模型比传统的使用过程要快得多......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence in understanding complex climate data is a remarkable development. As Daniel prophesied, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This technological surge offers hope for better disaster preparedness, reminding us of the potential for human ingenuity when guided by a pursuit of understanding.
reflection.zh: 人工智能在理解复杂气候数据方面取得的飞速发展是一项了不起的成就。正如但以理所预言的，“必有多人来往奔走，知识也必增长”。这种技术浪潮为更好地防备灾害带来了希望，提醒我们人类的智慧在追求理解的指引下所能发挥的潜力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: El Niño likely to cause wetter and warmer-than-normal autumn
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺可能导致比往常更湿润和温暖的秋季

summary.en: The UK is set for a warmer and wetter-than-normal autumn, according to the latest forecasts from the Met Office, driven by a strengthening El Niño phenomenon. This could help areas suffering from drought but also increase the risk of flooding.
summary.zh: 根据英国气象局的最新预测，受不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象影响，英国今年秋季将比往常更温暖湿润。这可能有助于缓解干旱地区的状况，但也可能增加洪水风险。

body.en:
The UK is set for wetter and warmer-than-normal weather this autumn, driven by a strengthening El Niño, according to the latest forecasts from the Met Office.

The climate phenomenon - forecast to be the strongest in living memory - will influence a change to stormier conditions later this season.

Potential wetter weather will put areas of the UK gripped by drought on the road to recovery, but it could also bring an increased chance of flooding as a result.

An already warming climate, paired with unusually high sea temperatures around the UK, will also contribute to above-average temperatures.

A stormy season is forecast for the UK with the chances of wet and windy weather higher than normal, particularly from November.

"The latest seasonal forecasts suggest an increased likelihood of wetter than average conditions as we move through autumn, which would be consistent with the historical influence of El Niño events," Met Office Chief Meteorologist Ian Lisk said.

El Niño - or the warming of the tropical Pacific Ocean - is continuing to strengthen and is expected peak in November or December as a historic event.

"While this event may become one of the strongest El Niño events on record, that does not automatically mean more severe impacts for the UK," he added.

A wetter outlook for late autumn and into winter will bring some relief to parched regions for the UK.

While the weather has recently turned more unsettled, there has so far been no change to the drought status, according to the Environment Agency (EA) National Drought Group, which met on Thursday.

Helen Wakeham, Director of Water at the EA said "drought recovery is a very long process" and only over once reservoirs, rivers and groundwater supplies are back to normal.

While the rainfall will be welcome, it is possible the UK could experience another round of "weather whiplash" where the pattern moves from one extreme to another.

A similar scenario played out in 2025 when the UK experienced a summer of record-breaking heat followed by storms and floods in the autumn.

It comes after summer 2026 was provisionally declared the hottest on record , following five widespread heatwaves and 40 days of temperatures above 30C (86F).

While a warmer-than-normal autumn is is consistent with global warming trends, the higher-than-normal sea surface temperatures around the UK will also have an influence.

The series of extreme heatwaves since late spring resulted in marine heatwaves , where sea surface temperatures have risen up to 5C above normal.

Warmer seas around the UK tend to keep land temperatures higher than they would otherwise normally be.

While it is unlikely the UK will see any snowfall this autumn, it is still too early to say if the winter will be especially cold or snowy.

body.zh: 根据英国气象局的最新预测，受厄尔尼诺现象增强的影响，今年秋天英国的天气将比正常情况更加潮湿和温暖。 这种气候现象——预计将是人们记忆中最强烈的——将影响本季晚些时候暴风雨天气的变化。 潜在的潮湿天气将使英国遭受干旱的地区走上复苏之路，但也可能导致洪水发生的可能性增加。 已经变暖的气候，加上英国各地异常高的海水温度，也将导致气温高于平均水平。 预计英国将迎来暴风雨季节，出现潮湿和多风天气的可能性高于正常水平，特别是从 11 月开始。 英国气象局首席气象学家伊恩·利斯克（Ian Lisk）表示：“最新的季节性预测表明，随着秋季的到来，降雨量高于平均水平的可能性会增加，这与厄尔尼诺事件的历史影响是一致的。” 厄尔尼诺现象（即热带太平洋变暖）正在继续加强，预计将在 11 月或 12 月达到峰值，成为历史性事件。 “虽然这一事件可能成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件之一，但这并不自动意味着对英国的影响更严重，”他补充道。 深秋和冬季的湿润前景将为英国干旱地区带来一些缓解。 周四召开会议的环境署（EA）国家干旱小组表示，虽然最近天气变得更加不稳定，但干旱状况迄今为止没有任何变化。 EA 水务主管海伦·韦克汉姆 (Helen Wakeham) 表示，“干旱恢复是一个非常漫长的过程”，只有水库、河流和地下水供应恢复正常后才能恢复正常。 虽然降雨是受欢迎的，但英国可能会经历另一轮“天气鞭打”，模式从一个极端转向另一个极端。 2025 年也出现了类似的情况，当时英国经历了创纪录的夏季高温，随后在秋季发生了暴风雨和洪水。 在此之前，继五次大范围热浪和连续 40 天气温高于 30 摄氏度（86 华氏度）之后，2026 年夏季被临时宣布为有记录以来最热的夏季。 虽然秋季比正常温暖与全球变暖趋势一致，但英国周围高于正常的海面温度也会产生影响。 春末以来的一系列极端热浪导致海洋热浪，海面温度比正常水平高出5摄氏度。 英国周围温暖的海洋往往会使陆地温度高于正常水平。 虽然英国今年秋天不太可能下雪，但现在判断冬天是否会特别寒冷或下雪还为时过早。 厄尔尼诺现象...

reflection.en: The Met Office forecasts a warmer and wetter autumn for the UK, influenced by El Niño. While this may offer relief to drought-stricken areas, it also brings the potential for increased flooding. In times of environmental uncertainty and potential upheaval, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 英国气象局预测，受厄尔尼诺现象影响，英国今年秋季将比往常更温暖湿润。虽然这可能为干旱地区带来缓解，但也带来了洪水加剧的潜在风险。在环境不确定和潜在动荡的时期，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，神是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Species 'at risk of vanishing' from area of Wales' largest national park
title.zh: 威尔士最大国家公园一区域物种面临“消失风险”

summary.en: The National Trust has issued a warning that species in a valley within Eryri National Park are on the verge of extinction due to serious ecological decline. A new £1 million conservation scheme aims to restore over 4,000 acres of habitat.
summary.zh: 国家信托基金会警告称，位于埃里里国家公园（Eryri National Park）一山谷中的物种正濒临灭绝，该地区正面临严重的生态衰退。一项新的耗资100万英镑的保护计划旨在恢复该公园超过4000英亩的栖息地。

body.en:
Some of Wales' most endangered species are "at risk of vanishing" from an area of the country's largest national park, experts have warned.

The National Trust said Nant Ffrancon, a valley in Eryri National Park, was facing "serious ecological decline" with some species in danger of disappearing altogether, including the mountain blackbird and the mountain finch.

Now, a new £1m scheme is aiming to restore and conserve more than 4,000 acres of habitats at Eryri, also known as Snowdonia .

"We're in a very serious situation - we're in a nature emergency. There are so many species in this valley which are on the brink of extinction," said Simon Rogers from the National Trust.

From the high peaks of Cwm Idwal to the deep valleys of Dyffryn Ogwen, Nant Ffrancon is one of the most special and unique landscapes in Wales.

But experts say its habitat has deteriorated and some of Wales' most threatened species, including the ring ouzel bird, are in danger of disappearing altogether.

Now, a project led by the National Trust will work together with local communities, tenant farmers and volunteers to restore and protect 4,040 acres of habitats.

Rogers said there was a "unique variety of habitats" in the area and warned many species "really are on the brink".

"One of the ones we've chosen to look at particularly in this project is the ring ouzel - a bird that's red-listed," he explained.

"It's been in decline massively in the area and across the whole country, and this is one of the last strongholds for it.

"So we'll be looking at that little bird, understanding how they use the landscape here and doing our best to manage the land to ensure their survival for the future.

"There are a lot arctic alpine flowers that grow in Cwm Idwal as well, one of them being the Tufted Saxifrage, where there were only seven individuals at the start of the year - all of them growing here in Cwm Idwal.

"But with the drought we've had this year, only three have made it through the summer. That's three through the whole of Wales, so they're at a very real risk of extinction if we don't do something about it."

Another project which will benefit is Tlysau Mynydd Eryri (Mountain Jewels of Eryri), part of a conservation partnership led by Plantlife Cymru to protect the future of some of the rarest alpine plants in Wales.

Ecological surveys and regular monitoring will map the impact of the restoration work, using species such as the woodcock and otter, and plants including aspen and juniper to give an idea of the health of the valley.

The work will also build on innovative use of GPS livestock collars to manage grazing more precisely.

Cwm Idwal Partnership Officer Rhys Wheldon-Roberts said monitoring was "really important because it allows us to graze in the right areas at...
body.zh: 专家警告说，威尔士最大的国家公园的一些最濒危物种正面临“消失的危险”。 国家信托基金会表示，埃里里国家公园内的一个山谷南特弗兰孔正面临“严重的生态衰退”，一些物种面临完全消失的危险，包括山黑鸟和山雀。 现在，一项耗资 100 万英镑的新计划旨在恢复和保护 Eryri（也称为 Snowdonia）超过 4,000 英亩的栖息地。 “我们的处境非常严峻——我们正处于自然紧急状态。这个山谷中有很多物种正处于灭绝的边缘，”国家信托基金的西蒙·罗杰斯说。 从 Cwm Idwal 的高峰到 Dyffryn Ogwen 的深谷，南特弗兰孔 (Nant Ffrancon) 是威尔士最特殊、最独特的景观之一。 但专家表示，其栖息地已经恶化，威尔士一些最受威胁的物种，包括环乌泽尔鸟，正面临完全消失的危险。 现在，由国家信托基金会领导的一个项目将与当地社区、佃农和志愿者合作，恢复和保护 4,040 英亩的栖息地。 罗杰斯说，该地区有“独特的多种栖息地”，并警告许多物种“确实处于濒临灭绝的边缘”。 “我们在这个项目中选择特别关注的鸟类之一是环乌泽尔，一种被列入红色名单的鸟类，”他解释道。 “它在该地区和全国范围内都在大幅下降，这是它最后的据点之一。 “因此，我们将关注这只小鸟，了解它们如何利用这里的景观，并尽最大努力管理这片土地，以确保它们未来的生存。 “Cwm Idwal 也生长着许多北极高山花卉，其中之一是簇绒虎耳草，今年年初那里只有七株 - 它们都生长在 Cwm Idwal。 “但是由于今年的干旱，只有三个人度过了夏天。整个威尔士有三只，所以如果我们不采取措施，它们就面临着灭绝的危险。” 另一个受益的项目是 Tlysau Mynydd Eryri（Eryri 山宝石），该项目是 Plantlife Cymru 领导的保护伙伴关系的一部分，旨在保护威尔士一些最稀有的高山植物的未来。 生态调查和定期监测将利用山鹬和水獭等物种以及白杨和杜松等植物来绘制恢复工作的影响，以了解山谷的健康状况。 这项工作还将以 GPS 牲畜项圈的创新应用为基础，以更精确地管理放牧。 Cwm Idwal 合作伙伴官员 Rhys Wheldon-Roberts 表示，监测“非常重要，因为它使我们能够在适当的区域放牧......

reflection.en: The news from Eryri National Park is a stark reminder of our responsibility as stewards of creation. When species like the mountain blackbird and finch are threatened with extinction, it calls us to reflect on our role in preserving the natural world that belongs to Yahweh. This ecological crisis urges us to consider how we can actively participate in...
reflection.zh: 来自埃里里国家公园的消息，是对我们作为受造界管家责任的严峻提醒。当山地黑鸟和山雀等物种面临灭绝威胁时，它促使我们反思在保护属于雅伟的自然界中所扮演的角色。 这场生态危机敦促我们思考，如何能积极参与到恢复和保护工作中，认识到大地及其万物都是神圣的托付。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: DRC's cobalt exports contain unreported uranium—our study estimates the global nuclear risk
title.zh: 刚果（金）的钴出口含有未经申报的铀——我们的研究估计了全球核风险

summary.en: The southern region of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is known as the Copperbelt due to its rich copper and mineral deposits. Historically, this area was the primary source of uranium for the U.S. Manhattan Project, which developed the first nuclear weapons. Research indicates that current cobalt exports from...
summary.zh: 刚果（民主共和国）南部地区因其丰富的铜和其他矿产资源而被称为“铜带”。该地区曾是美国曼哈顿计划（研制第一批核武器的项目）的铀矿主要来源地。研究表明，刚果（金）铜带地区目前的钴出口中含有未经申报的铀，这可能带来全球性的核风险。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The southern region of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is known as the Copperbelt because of its rich deposits of copper and other minerals.

The area was the original source of uranium ore for the first nuclear weapons built by the U.S.'s Manhattan Project , which ran from 1942 to 1947. Two atomic bombs were then dropped on the Japanese cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945.

The Manhattan Project's main source of uranium was the Copperbelt's Shinkolobwe mine in southeastern DRC. It has been officially closed to excavation since 2004 .

However, our recent research shows that substantial unreported quantities of uranium are likely to be leaving the country today. I am a geologist with expertise in analyzing data on the chemical and mineral contents of rocks. I do most of my work using map views, taking in spatial data points—like regional cobalt statistics—and drawing conclusions.

Uranium and cobalt occur together in rock and respond the same way to chemical processing, so they are hard to separate.

From this, we were able to develop a single estimate of how much uranium is at stake when cobalt is mined and exported.

Very few data points about uranium concentrations in ores or the chemical steps used to prepare cobalt for shipment are publicly available. We reached our estimates by using geologic maps to model the likely uranium grades in cobalt ores.

We combined these grades with the amount of ore being processed at each facility in the Copperbelt and a model of uranium behavior during processing chemistry before shipment.

The end result links cobalt production to likely uranium export. Our calculations show that, in the most likely scenarios, 2,000–5,000 tonnes of natural uranium were exported from the DRC in cobalt-hydroxide shipments between 2000 and 2024.

Less than 10% of this material appears to have been publicly declared to the International Atomic Energy Agency . The agency is responsible for uranium accountancy and safeguards. Most of the material was exported to China, which dominates the global cobalt market.

This quantity of uranium could be processed into enough material for roughly 600–1,500 nuclear weapons, by our calculations. It could also fuel a standard light-water nuclear reactor for 10–25 years.

Our findings identify a substantial gap in nuclear accountancy and environmental oversight within a critical mineral supply chain. In the weeks following our study's publication in July 2026, the DRC launched a probe to test outgoing cobalt shipments for uranium content. It will also consult with the International Atomic Energy...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 刚果民主共和国（DRC）南部地区因其丰富的铜和其他矿产资源而被称为铜带。 该地区是美国曼哈顿计划（1942 年至 1947 年）建造的第一批核武器的铀矿石的原始来源。1945 年，两颗原子弹被投向日本广岛和长崎。 曼哈顿项目的主要铀来源是铜带省位于刚果民主共和国东南部的 Shinkolobwe 矿。自2004年以来，它已正式停止挖掘。 然而，我们最近的研究表明，大量未报告数量的铀今天可能会离开该国。我是一名地质学家，擅长分析岩石化学和矿物含量的数据。我的大部分工作都是使用地图视图进行的，获取空间数据点（例如区域钴统计数据）并得出结论。 铀和钴一起出现在岩石中，对化学处理的反应方式相同，因此它们很难分离。 由此，我们能够对钴开采和出口时所面临的铀风险进行单一估计。 关于矿石中铀浓度或用于制备钴运输的化学步骤的公开数据很少。我们通过使用地质图对钴矿石中可能的铀品位进行建模来得出我们的估计。 我们将这些品位与铜带各设施正在加工的矿石量以及装运前加工化学过程中的铀行为模型相结合。 最终结果将钴生产与可能的铀出口联系起来。我们的计算表明，在最有可能的情况下，2000 年至 2024 年间，刚果民主共和国以氢氧化钴形式出口了 2,000-5,000 吨天然铀。 这些材料中似乎只有不到 10% 已向国际原子能机构公开申报。该机构负责铀核算和保障。大部分材料出口到主导全球钴市场的中国。 根据我们的计算，这些铀可以加工成足够制造大约 600-1,500 件核武器的材料。它还可以为标准轻水核反应堆提供 10-25 年的燃料。 我们的研究结果表明，关键矿产供应链内的核会计和环境监督存在巨大差距。在我们的研究于 2026 年 7 月发表后的几周内，刚果民主共和国启动了一项调查，以测试出货的钴中的铀含量。它还将与国际原子能机构协商......

reflection.en: The news from the DRC's Copperbelt brings to light the complex and often hidden consequences of resource extraction. The presence of undeclared uranium in cobalt exports raises profound ethical questions about accountability, transparency, and the potential for harm. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that...
reflection.zh: 刚果（金）铜带地区的消息揭示了资源开采复杂且常常隐藏的后果。钴出口中含有未经申报的铀，这引发了关于问责、透明度以及潜在危害的深刻伦理问题。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与神同行，这些原则应指导国家和企业如何管理资源以及与弱势地区互动。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: London misperceptions: Study reveals what Britons get wrong

summary.en: A new study from King's College London reveals that the British public holds several misconceptions about London. Contrary to popular belief, London has one of the lowest violent crime rates in England and Wales, ranks highly globally, and contributes more in taxes than it receives in public spending. However, people...
summary.zh: 伦敦国王学院的一项新研究显示，英国公众对伦敦存在多项误解。与普遍看法相反，伦敦是英格兰和威尔士暴力犯罪率最低的地区之一，在全球排名中名列前茅，并且缴纳的税款超过了获得的公共支出。然而，公众高估了伦敦居民遭受犯罪的可能性，低估了首都的国际地位，并且几乎不知道它是公共财政的主要贡献者。

body.en: London has one of the lowest violent crime rates of any region in England and Wales, tops a global ranking of the best cities, and pays more in taxes than it receives back in public spending—but the public overestimates how likely Londoners are to become victims of crime, underestimates the capital's international standing, and has little idea it is the key contributor to public finances, according to a new study from the Policy Institute at King's College London.
body.zh: 伦敦是英格兰和威尔士暴力犯罪率最低的地区之一，在全球最佳城市排名中名列前茅，缴纳的税款高于公共支出——但伦敦国王学院政策研究所的一项新研究显示，公众高估了伦敦人成为犯罪受害者的可能性，低估了首都的国际地位，并且几乎不知道伦敦是公共财政的主要贡献者。

reflection.en: It's striking how easily our perceptions can become skewed, especially when bombarded with information that emphasizes the negative. This study shows a public that overestimates crime and underestimates London's standing. Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent. May we cultivate a discerning spirit, seeking out...
reflection.zh: 令人震惊的是，我们的看法多么容易变得扭曲，尤其是在充斥着强调负面信息的轰炸时。这项研究显示，公众高估了犯罪率，低估了伦敦的地位。腓立比书 4:8 呼吁我们将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事。愿我们培养辨别是非的精神，寻求准确的信息，并坚守那些能建立人心的真理，而不是恐惧或愤世嫉俗。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: English, but make it TikTok: How social media is reshaping language
title.zh: 英语，但要像TikTok一样：社交媒体如何重塑语言

summary.en: Everyday English words like 'give,' 'eat,' 'cook,' and 'serve' are taking on new meanings on platforms like TikTok. For instance, 'it's giving' is now used to describe the feeling or energy something creates, such as 'it's giving tree' for someone dressed in green and brown, or 'it's giving main character' for a...
summary.zh: 像“give”、“eat”、“cook”和“serve”这样的日常英语单词在TikTok等平台上有了新的含义。例如，“it's giving”现在被用来描述某事物所产生的感受、印象或能量，例如穿着绿色上衣和棕色裤子的人“it's giving tree”（像树一样），自信的人“it's giving main...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Give, eat, cook and serve are everyday English words. On TikTok, they're doing something different.

In its usual sense, "give" means transferring something from one person to another—a present, some advice or a piece of information. But on TikTok, "it's giving" has become a way to describe the feeling, impression or energy something creates.

A person wearing a green top and brown pants might be "giving tree," a confident person could be "giving main character" or an outfit might be "giving Regency era." In each case, the phrase means something like "it resembles," "it evokes" or "it has the feel of"—but without saying any of those things directly.

UNSW Sydney researcher Cathy Xu, from the School of Humanities & Languages, says this is more than a passing internet catchphrase. It is an example of English changing in real time.

"TikTok is accelerating language change because it used to take decades for new phrases and expressions to move into everyday use, but now you can see it happen in a couple of years," she says.

Xu is researching how TikTok users play with language and how new forms spread through the platform. Her study of "it's giving" shows users developing new ways to structure sentences and new meanings for familiar words.

"It has its own very sophisticated kind of syntactic structure," she says. "It didn't come out of nowhere. It has a natural derivation from an existing form."

The phrase probably developed from expressions such as "giving off a certain vibe." Over time, users dropped "off" and then "vibe," leaving the shorter form: "it's giving."

The result is a new use of the verb "give." In standard English, "give" often relates to a tangible object—as in "she gave him a present"—or describes delivering something, as in "she gave a speech."

The phrase can also appear as "it gives," "definitely giving" or simply "giving." It can mean that something resembles or evokes something else, but it can also work as a kind of conversational marker.

People now use "it's giving" beyond TikTok, including in podcasts, comedy and television.

"And, in fact, the phrase is now used in everyday conversation, especially among younger people," she says.

The spread of the expression is partly connected to the way TikTok serves up content to its 1.59 billion monthly users . Videos can reach large audiences within hours because of the platform's algorithm and default For You Page, which automatically plays videos without a user having to select anything.

"A video can go viral overnight, and language can be picked up by other users in their content quickly. Then...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： Give、eat、cook 和serve 是日常英语单词。在 TikTok 上，他们正在做一些不同的事情。 在通常意义上，“给予”意味着将某物从一个人转移给另一个人——一份礼物、一些建议或一条信息。但在 TikTok 上，“它正在给予”已经成为描述某物所创造的感觉、印象或能量的一种方式。 一个穿着绿色上衣和棕色裤子的人可能是“给予树”，一个自信的人可能是“给予主角”，或者一套服装可能是“给予摄政时代”。在每种情况下，这个短语的意思都是“它相似”、“它唤起”或“它有……的感觉”——但没有直接说任何这些东西。 新南威尔士大学悉尼分校人文与语言学院的研究员 Cathy Xu 表示，这不仅仅是一个流行的网络流行语。这是英语实时变化的一个例子。 她说：“TikTok 正在加速语言变革，因为过去新短语和表达方式需要几十年才能进入日常使用，但现在你可以看到这在几年内就发生了。” 徐正在研究 TikTok 用户如何玩弄语言以及新形式如何通过该平台传播。她对“它的给予”的研究表明，用户正在开发构建句子的新方法以及熟悉单词的新含义。 “它有自己非常复杂的句法结构，”她说。 “它不是凭空出现的。它是从现有形式自然衍生出来的。” 这个短语可能是从“散发出某种氛围”等表达方式发展而来的。随着时间的推移，用户放弃了“off”，然后是“vibe”，留下了较短的形式：“it's Give”。 结果是动词“give”的新用法。在标准英语中，“give”通常与有形的物体相关，例如“她给了他一份礼物”，或者描述传递某种东西，例如“她发表了演讲”。 该短语也可以显示为“它给予”、“绝对给予”或简单地“给予”。它可能意味着某事物类似于或唤起其他事物，但它也可以作为一种会话标记。 人们现在在 TikTok 之外使用“it's Give”，包括在播客、喜剧和电视中。 “事实上，这个短语现在已经在日常对话中使用，尤其是在年轻人中，”她说。 该表达方式的传播在一定程度上与 TikTok 向其 15.9 亿月用户提供内容的方式有关。由于平台的算法和默认的“为您推荐”页面，视频可以在数小时内吸引大量观众，该页面会自动播放视频，而无需用户进行任何选择。 “视频可以在一夜之间疯传，其他用户也可以很快学会其内容中的语言。然后……

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of language on platforms like TikTok demonstrates how quickly human knowledge and expression can change. As Daniel prophesied, in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This linguistic shift is a small echo of that larger phenomenon, showing how communication itself is constantly being reshaped.
reflection.zh: 像TikTok这样的平台上的语言的快速演变，展示了人类的知识和表达可以多么迅速地改变。正如但以理所预言的，在末世，“必有多人来往奔走，知识必然增长”。这种语言上的转变是更大现象的一个小小的回响，表明沟通本身正在不断被重塑。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Fast-growing money market funds linked to 'exuberant' equity markets and systemic risk
title.zh: 增长迅速的货币市场基金与“欣欣向荣”的股票市场和系统性风险相关联

summary.en: New academic research indicates that money market funds experiencing rapid growth during periods of soaring equity markets present a systemic risk to global financial systems. This finding may intensify concerns about the size and stability of private debt, especially given rising fears of a potential AI-driven bubble...
summary.zh: 新的学术研究表明，在股票市场飙升期间快速增长的货币市场基金（MMF）对全球金融系统构成系统性风险。这一发现可能会加剧对私人债务规模和稳定性的担忧，尤其是在人们日益担心股票市场可能出现人工智能驱动的泡沫的背景下。该研究分析了 2004 年至 2022 年间 3,568...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Money market funds (MMFs) that grow rapidly when equity markets are soaring pose a systemic risk to global financial systems, new academic research reveals.

The study may amplify concerns about the scale and security of private debt amid mounting fears of a possible AI bubble in equity markets.

After analyzing data on 3,568 U.S. dollar-denominated MMFs between 2004 and 2022, the authors concluded that the potential systemic risk of such funds depends less on size than on how quickly they have grown—particularly when financial markets are booming.

Money market funds are an increasingly important part of the nonbank financial system and play a major role in providing short-term financing to governments, banks and companies. The paper has just been published in the Journal of Banking & Finance .

The authors conclude that MMFs should be incorporated more explicitly into systemic-risk monitoring frameworks, particularly during periods of asset-price exuberance when rapid fund growth can become destabilizing.

Co-author Professor Giovanni Urga, director of the Centre for Econometric Analysis at Bayes Business School in London (formerly Cass), said, "Our analysis suggests that regulators and other policymakers need to look beyond banks and broad macroeconomic indicators when assessing systemic risk. The results demonstrate that the characteristics and behavior of individual nonbank financial institutions clearly influence how risk builds up and spreads through the financial system."

The authors speculate that the heightened systemic risk of fast-growing MMFs during equity bubbles may reflect investors reaching for yield amid an equity boom.

Urga said, "It is particularly striking that 'bigger' does not necessarily mean 'riskier': larger MMFs were generally associated with lower systemic risk in normal market conditions. However, that all changes dramatically during equity-market booms: Suddenly, rapid fund growth is associated with higher systemic risk."

At such times, a one-standard-deviation increase in fund-size growth is associated with an increase in systemic risk of 5.7 basis points.

Urga said, "Regulators and other policymakers should therefore see rapid expansion of nonbank financial institutions during asset-price booms as a red flag of possible emerging vulnerabilities."

The authors call for a more differentiated approach to supervision based on differing risk profiles. Government MMFs, for example, were associated with lower systemic risk than prime MMFs (which invest primarily in commercial paper and certificates of deposit). Similarly, offshore U.S. dollar...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 新的学术研究显示，在股市飙升时快速增长的货币市场基金（MMF）对全球金融体系构成系统性风险。 由于人们越来越担心股市可能出现人工智能泡沫，这项研究可能会加剧人们对私人债务规模和安全性的担忧。 在分析了 2004 年至 2022 年间 3,568 个以美元计价的货币市场基金的数据后，作者得出的结论是，此类基金的潜在系统性风险更多地取决于它们的增长速度，而不是规模——尤其是在金融市场蓬勃发展的情况下。 货币市场基金是非银行金融体系中日益重要的组成部分，在向政府、银行和企业提供短期融资方面发挥着重要作用。该论文刚刚发表在《银行与金融杂志》上。 作者的结论是，货币市场基金应该更明确地纳入系统性风险监测框架，特别是在资产价格繁荣时期，此时基金的快速增长可能会变得不稳定。 伦敦贝叶斯商学院（前身为卡斯商学院）计量经济分析中心主任乔瓦尼·乌尔加（Giovanni Urga）教授表示：“我们的分析表明，监管机构和其他政策制定者在评估系统性风险时，需要超越银行和广泛的宏观经济指标。研究结果表明，各个非银行金融机构的特征和行为明显影响风险如何在金融体系中积累和扩散。” 作者推测，股市泡沫期间快速增长的货币市场基金所带来的系统性风险加剧可能反映出投资者在股市繁荣期间追求收益。 Urga表示：“特别引人注目的是，‘规模更大’并不一定意味着‘风险更高’：在正常市场条件下，较大的货币市场基金通常与较低的系统性风险相关。然而，在股市繁荣期间，一切都发生了巨大变化：突然之间，基金的快速增长与较高的系统性风险相关。” 在这种情况下，基金规模增长每增加一个标准差，系统性风险就会增加 5.7 个基点。 Urga表示，“因此，监管机构和其他政策制定者应该将资产价格繁荣期间非银行金融机构的快速扩张视为可能出现的脆弱性的危险信号。” 作者呼吁根据不同的风险状况采取更加差异化的监管方法。例如，政府货币市场基金的系统风险低于优质货币市场基金（主要投资于商业票据和存款证）。同样，离岸美元...

reflection.en: This research points to a hidden danger in financial markets: the rapid, seemingly unchecked growth of certain funds can destabilize the entire system. Proverbs 11:1 warns that dishonest scales are an abomination to Yahweh, but He delights in fair weights. This principle extends to the integrity of financial systems, where rapid, potentially unsustainable...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了金融市场中一个隐藏的危险：某些基金的快速、看似不受控制的增长可能会破坏整个系统的稳定。《箴言》11:1 警告说，诡诈的天平是雅伟所憎恶的，但他喜爱公平的法码。这一原则延伸到金融系统的诚信，其中快速、可能不可持续的增长可能掩盖潜在的风险，最终伤害许多人。

title.en: The hunt for unknown life in New York City
title.zh: 纽约市未知生命的搜寻

summary.en: The article explores the surprising possibility of discovering entirely new animal species within the bustling environment of New York City, challenging the notion that undiscovered life is confined to remote locations.
summary.zh: 文章探讨了在美国最大的城市纽约市的繁华环境中发现全新动物物种的可能性，挑战了人们认为未被发现的生命仅限于偏远地区的观念。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The globe is full of unknown species. But is it really possible to find a completely new animal species in the middle of the largest city in the United States?

"People like to imagine that undiscovered species are only found in remote rainforests or the great ocean depths, but they can be found everywhere. Even in areas that are well studied, we continue to discover species that are new to science," says Emily Hartop.

Hartop is an entomologist at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology's natural history museum in Trondheim, the NTNU University Museum.

She is collaborating with multiple research partners—the American media outlet Vox, the Centre for Biodiversity Genomics at the University of Guelph in Canada, and the Prospect Park Alliance and Central Park Conservancy in New York—in the hunt for unknown life in the largest city in the United States. She feels confident that they will find something.

"It's highly likely. In my field, discovering new species is the rule rather than the exception," Hartop says.

"The reality is that the majority of Earth's animal species are still unknown to us humans. Scientists have formally named around 2 million species, but the actual number of species is perhaps 10 times higher," Hartop says.

You may have already guessed that Hartop isn't looking for unknown bear or gorilla species. We have—unfortunately, some might say—a pretty good grasp of them. Insects, on the other hand, constitute a large blank spot on the species map, especially those within the category of "dark taxa"—groups of organisms that are extremely species-rich but about which we know very little.

"A lot of dark taxa are small insects, mites and other organisms that receive little attention compared with more charismatic groups like mammals and bees. They are often both common and ecologically important, but we simply don't have enough specialists to get an overview of them."

You may be wondering how you can even begin to find unknown insects in the middle of a city. Well, it happens in several stages.

The hunt for unknown life in New York is being carried out by setting up tentlike insect traps—called Malaise traps—two of which have now been placed in Central Park and Prospect Park. Both are highly urban parks located in Manhattan and Brooklyn, respectively. The traps work by guiding insects into a container of ethanol, where they are killed and preserved.

Once a month, the collected insects are sent to the Centre for Biodiversity Genomics (CBG) in Canada. There, the genetic material of the insects in the traps is mapped using a method called DNA...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 地球上充满了未知的物种。但在美国最大的城市中心真的有可能找到一种全新的动物物种吗？ “人们喜欢想象未被发现的物种只在偏远的雨林或大海深处发现，但它们无处不在。即使在经过充分研究的地区，我们也不断发现科学上的新物种，”艾米丽·哈托普说。 哈托普是挪威科技大学特隆赫姆自然历史博物馆（NTNU 大学博物馆）的昆虫学家。 她正在与多个研究合作伙伴——美国媒体 Vox、加拿大圭尔夫大学生物多样性基因组学中心、纽约展望公园联盟和中央公园保护协会——合作，在美国最大的城市寻找未知生命。她相信他们会找到一些东西。 “这很有可能。在我的领域，发现新物种是规则而不是例外，”哈托普说。 “现实情况是，地球上的大多数动物物种对我们人类来说仍然是未知的。科学家们已经正式命名了大约 200 万种动物，但实际物种数量可能要多出 10 倍，”哈托普说。 您可能已经猜到哈托普并不是在寻找未知的熊或大猩猩物种。不幸的是，有些人可能会说，我们已经很好地掌握了它们。另一方面，昆虫在物种图谱上构成了一个巨大的空白点，尤其是那些属于“黑暗类群”类别的生物，这些生物体物种极其丰富，但我们对其知之甚少。 “许多暗类群都是小昆虫、螨虫和其他生物，与哺乳动物和蜜蜂等更具魅力的群体相比，它们很少受到关注。它们通常既常见又具有生态重要性，但我们根本没有足够的专家来全面了解它们。” 您可能想知道如何才能在城市中心找到未知的昆虫。嗯，它分几个阶段发生。 纽约正在通过设置帐篷状昆虫陷阱（称为“不适陷阱”）来寻找未知生命，其中两个现已放置在中央公园和展望公园。两者都是分别位于曼哈顿和布鲁克林的高度城市公园。这些陷阱的工作原理是将昆虫引导到装有乙醇的容器中，然后将它们杀死并保存起来。 收集到的昆虫每月一次被送往加拿大生物多样性基因组学中心（CBG）。在那里，陷阱中昆虫的遗传物质被使用一种称为 DNA 的方法绘制出来......

reflection.en: It is easy to assume that all life has been cataloged, especially in a place as familiar as a major city. Yet, as this story shows, the natural world continues to surprise us with hidden wonders. The Psalmist reminds us that the earth is full of God's riches, and even in our backyards, we can encounter the intricate design of creation, a testament to the...
reflection.zh: 人们很容易认为所有生命都已被记录在案，尤其是在像大城市这样熟悉的地方。然而，正如这个故事所示，自然界不断以隐藏的奇迹给我们带来惊喜。诗人提醒我们，地满了雅伟的丰富，即使在我们自己的后院，我们也能遇到受造界的精巧设计，这是造物主持久艺术性的证明。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New hurricane season record as 'historic' El Niño leaves Atlantic eerily quiet
title.zh: 创纪录的飓风季：历史性的厄尔尼诺现象导致大西洋异常平静

summary.en: The Atlantic hurricane season has reached its climatological peak, but a strong El Niño means no hurricanes have formed this year, setting a record for the latest date without a hurricane in the satellite era.
summary.zh: 大西洋飓风季已达到气候学上的高峰期，但强烈的厄尔尼诺现象意味着今年没有形成飓风，创下了卫星时代以来最晚无飓风的纪录。

body.en:
A new hurricane season record is likely to be set this week as a historic and still strengthening El Niño stifles tropical development in the Atlantic.

To date, no hurricanes have formed in the basin, despite this week marking the peak of the season on average - and there's no sign of development in the near future.

It means a new record is likely to be set for the latest date in the satellite era (1960s onward) without an Atlantic hurricane forming.

In an average season, there would have been eight named tropical storms and three hurricanes by this point.

This year, however, there have only been five tropical storms: Arthur, Bertha, Cristobal, Dolly and Edouard.

With few indications that there will be any development in the next week, this will mean the longest stretch into in a season where no hurricane has formed in the modern satellite era.

In the eastern Pacific, where El Nino tends to strengthen hurricane activity, it has been fairly active season so far.

There have been 13 named storms including five hurricanes, three of which were major.

This is close to the number that would typically develop in the whole of an average season.

The latest, major hurricane Lowell , hit Hawaii this week with damaging winds, flooding rain and high waves.

Forecasters predicted the Atlantic hurricane season would be quieter than average.

In May, the National Hurricane Center forecast a total of eight to 14 named storms, three to six of which would become hurricanes, including one to three major hurricanes.

While El Niño is the natural warming of the tropical Pacific, it can disrupt weather patterns around the globe.

As wind patterns shift during an El Niño, upper winds over the Atlantic increase and this leads to more wind shear, where wind changes rapidly with height.

Increased wind shear rips apart thunderstorms, preventing them from growing into tropical storms or hurricanes.

El Niño is already on track to be one of the strongest on record, expected to peak in November or December.

The National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration has said this El Niño will most likely be 'historic', exceeding the strength of previous El Niño events dating back to 1950.

Over the last week, dust and sand whipped up by winds in the Sahara have been transported thousands of miles from Africa.

When this dry, dusty layer of air is directed across the Atlantic, it prevents storms from growing.

It is expected that this will continue to cause quieter conditions over the next week at least.
body.zh: 由于历史性且仍在加强的厄尔尼诺现象抑制了大西洋的热带发展，本周可能会创下新的飓风季节记录。 迄今为止，该盆地还没有形成飓风，尽管本周标志着飓风季节的平均高峰，而且在不久的将来也没有发展的迹象。 这意味着卫星时代（20 世纪 60 年代以后）没有形成大西洋飓风的最晚日期可能会创下新纪录。 在平均季节，此时将会有八次命名的热带风暴和三场飓风。 然而，今年只有五场热带风暴：亚瑟、伯莎、克里斯托瓦尔、多莉和爱德华。 由于几乎没有迹象表明下周会有任何进展，这将意味着现代卫星时代没有飓风形成的季节中最长的一段时间。 在东太平洋，厄尔尼诺现象往往会加强飓风活动，到目前为止，这是一个相当活跃的季节。 已有 13 场命名风暴，其中包括 5 场飓风，其中 3 场为强飓风。 这接近于整个平均赛季通常会出现的数字。 最近的大型飓风洛厄尔本周袭击了夏威夷，带来了破坏性的大风、洪水和巨浪。 预报员预测大西洋飓风季节将比平均水平安静。 5月份，国家飓风中心总共预测了8到14个命名风暴，其中3到6个将成为飓风，其中包括1到3个大型飓风。 虽然厄尔尼诺现象是热带太平洋的自然变暖，但它会扰乱全球的天气模式。 在典型的飓风季节，大西洋上空的风会增加，这会导致更大的风切变，风随高度变化迅速。 增加的风切变会撕裂雷暴，防止它们发展成热带风暴或飓风。 厄尔尼诺现象已经成为有记录以来最强烈的现象之一，预计将在 11 月或 12 月达到顶峰。 美国国家海洋和大气管理局表示，这次厄尔尼诺现象很可能是“历史性的”，超过了自 1950 年以来历次厄尔尼诺事件的强度。 过去一周，撒哈拉大风卷起的灰尘和沙子已从非洲吹到数千英里之外。 当这层干燥、多尘的空气被引导穿过大西洋时，它可以防止风暴的发展。 预计至少在下周这将继续导致市场更加平静。

reflection.en: The natural world often displays a complexity and power that surpasses human prediction and control. The current quiet Atlantic hurricane season, driven by the El Niño phenomenon, is a reminder of the intricate systems governing our planet. It invites us to pause and marvel at the wisdom inherent in creation, recognizing that much of its operation remains a...
reflection.zh: 自然界常常展现出超越人类预测和控制的复杂性和力量。当前大西洋飓风季的平静，由厄尔尼诺现象驱动，提醒我们地球上存在着精密的运行系统。这邀请我们停下来，惊叹于受造之物固有的智慧，并认识到其运作的许多方面仍然是一个深刻的奥秘。

reflection.zh: 数十年来，人类一直在努力理解塑造宇宙的看不见的力量，试图揭示宇宙隐藏的结构。这种由观察和智慧驱动的持久探索，与古老的智慧不谋而合——即创造本身蕴含着深刻的教训。愿这一潜在的突破提醒我们，即使在最深的奥秘中，雅伟精妙的设计也通过耐心探索得以显现。

title.en: Drax ash mound extraction plan approved
title.zh: 德拉克斯灰堆提取计划获批

summary.en: Plans to extract and reuse millions of tonnes of ash from a mound next to Drax Power Station have been approved. The ash will be used in construction products, reducing the need for virgin materials, with extraction continuing until 2045 and restoration completed by 2055.
summary.zh: 德拉克斯发电站旁边一个灰堆的数百万吨灰烬的提取和再利用计划已获批准。这些灰烬将用于建筑产品，减少对原生材料的需求，提取工作将持续到2045年，修复工作将于2055年完成。

body.en:
Plans to extract up to 23.5 million tonnes of ash from a disposal site next to Drax Power Station have been approved.

The 161-hectare (398 acre) mound, immediately north-west of the power station near Selby, reaches up to 39 metres (128ft) and has been used for ash deposits from Drax since the 1970s.

The scheme would see ash recovered for use in construction products such as concrete, reducing the need for virgin aggregates, with extraction continuing until 2045 and restoration completed by 2055.

Although North Yorkshire Council approved the application by Drax Power Ltd, it imposed conditions on when the site could be worked following concerns from residents.

Objections from three people cited concerns about dust, noise, lighting, air pollution and the impact on the landscape.

Concerns were also raised about habitat loss, the scale and duration of the scheme, and the removal of screening that helps shield Drax Power Station from nearby communities, according to the Local Democracy Reporting Service .

Councillor Tim Thrall, from Barlow Parish Council, who spoke at the planning meeting, said in principle they had "no objection to the removal of the ash mound."

He added: "However, we do have a number of concerns about whether mitigation measures are enough to impact the quality of life of the residents of the village."

Another councillor Mark Crane, whose area includes Barlow, said proposals that the site was to operate 18 hours a day, from 06:00 until midnight, seven days a week excluding bank holidays, "blew his mind".

He added: "To expect them to accept that they can work from six in the morning till midnight every single day of the year is, I'm sorry, completely unreasonable."

The planning committee agreed the site could only be worked from 08:00 until 20:00, excluding Sundays and bank holidays.

The committee also agreed a condition to ensure that 65% of the ash was transported by rail with the remainder removed by road.

Council officers concluded that, subject to conditions, the development would not result in unacceptable impacts on residents, highways, ecology, air quality or the water environment.

The approval was also subject to a legal agreement that includes a £200,000 fund to help mitigate its impact on the surrounding landscape.
body.zh: 从 Drax 发电站旁边的处置场提取多达 2350 万吨灰烬的计划已获得批准。 这座占地 161 公顷（398 英亩）的土丘位于塞尔比附近发电站的西北部，高达 39 米（128 英尺），自 20 世纪 70 年代以来一直用于存放德拉克斯的火山灰。 该计划将回收灰烬用于混凝土等建筑产品，减少对原始骨料的需求，提取将持续到 2045 年，恢复工作将在 2055 年完成。 尽管北约克郡议会批准了德拉克斯电力有限公司的申请，但考虑到居民的担忧，它对该工地的施工时间施加了条件。 三人的反对理由是担心灰尘、噪音、照明、空气污染和对景观的影响。 据当地民主报告服务处称，人们还对栖息地丧失、该计划的规模和持续时间以及帮助德拉克斯发电站免受附近社区影响的屏蔽设施的拆除表示担忧。 巴洛教区议会议员蒂姆·萨尔在规划会议上发言，他表示原则上他们“不反对拆除灰堆”。 他补充道：“然而，我们确实对缓解措施是否足以影响该村居民的生活质量存在一些担忧。” 另一位议员马克·克兰 (Mark Crane) 所在的地区包括巴洛 (Barlow)，他表示，该站点每周 7 天（不包括银行假日）每天从 06:00 运营到午夜 18 小时的提议“让他大吃一惊”。 他补充道：“抱歉，期望他们接受一年中每一天都可以从早上六点工作到午夜，这是完全不合理的。” 规划委员会同意该工地只能在 08:00 至 20:00 期间施工，周日和银行假日除外。 委员会还同意一项条件，确保 65% 的火山灰通过铁路运输，其余部分通过公路清除。 市议会官员的结论是，在条件允许的情况下，开发项目不会对居民、高速公路、生态、空气质量或水环境造成不可接受的影响。 该批准还取决于一项法律协议，其中包括 20 万英镑的基金，以帮助减轻其对周围景观的影响。

reflection.en: This plan to repurpose millions of tonnes of ash from Drax Power Station into construction materials is a practical example of stewardship. It echoes the Genesis account where, after creation, Yahweh declared all that was made 'very good,' implying a mandate for wise use and care of the earth's resources.
reflection.zh: 这项将德拉克斯发电站数百万吨灰烬再利用于建筑材料的计划，是管理资源的一个实际范例。它呼应了《创世记》的记载，即在创造之后，雅伟宣告一切所造的“甚好”，这暗示了明智地使用和照管地球资源的使命。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: ‘One of the biggest discoveries in science’: have scientists found dark matter? – podcast
title.zh: “科学界最大的发现之一”：科学家们找到了暗物质吗？——播客

summary.en: For decades, physicists have been puzzled by the enigma of dark matter, which is thought to constitute 85% of the universe's matter but remains invisible and undetectable, known primarily through its gravitational influence. Now, scientists believe they may be closer to detecting it, a finding that could revolutionize...
summary.zh: 数十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质的谜团感到困惑。人们认为它构成了宇宙物质的85%，但它既看不见也无法被探测到，我们主要通过它对其他事物产生的引力效应来了解它。现在，科学家们认为他们可能更接近于探测到它了，这一发现可能会彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。

body.en: For decades physicists have been puzzling over the enigma of dark matter. We think it makes up 85% of the matter in the universe, but the mysterious substance cannot be seen or detected, and we know about it mainly through observations of the gravitational effects it has on other things. But now scientists believe they may be a step closer to detecting it. Science editor Ian Sample explains to Madeleine Finlay why, if confirmed, the finding could completely transform our understanding of the universe. And Dr Samuel Eriksen , senior research associate at the University of Bristol, and first author of the research paper, explains how the finding has been received in the physics community Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 几十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质之谜感到困惑。我们认为它构成了宇宙中85%的物质，但这种神秘物质是看不见或探测不到的，我们主要通过观察它对其他事物的引力效应来了解它。但现在科学家相信他们可能离检测到它又近了一步。 《科学》编辑伊恩·桑普勒 (Ian Sample) 向玛德琳·芬利 (Madeleine Finlay) 解释了为什么这一发现如果得到证实，将彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。布里斯托大学高级研究员、该研究论文的第一作者塞缪尔·埃里克森博士解释了物理学界如何接受这一发现支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

Job 12:7-9 reminds us that creation itself is a source of profound wisdom, inviting us to observe and learn from the intricate workings of the cosmos. May this potential discovery inspire awe and humility, reminding us of the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙充满了我们理解力所不及的奥秘，例如通过看不见的力量塑造星系的暗物质。约伯记12:7-9提醒我们，创造本身就是深刻智慧的源泉，邀请我们观察并学习宇宙错综复杂的运作。 愿这一潜在的发现能激发敬畏之心和谦卑感，提醒我们雅伟创造的浩瀚以及其中人类对知识的不懈追求。

title.en: August joint-hottest month on record as climate change and El Niño drive heat
title.zh: 八月是有记录以来最热的月份，气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧了高温

summary.en: August was the hottest month on record, tied with July 2023, due to the combined effects of climate change and the rising influence of El Niño. This pushed global temperatures 1.65C above pre-industrial levels, surpassing the critical 1.5C threshold.
summary.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务中心的数据，八月是有记录以来最热的月份，与2023年7月持平。这归因于气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象日益增长的影响。该月全球气温比工业化前水平高出1.65摄氏度，超过了1.5摄氏度的关键阈值。

body.en:
August was the joint-hottest month ever recorded, tying with July 2023, according to the EU's climate service.

The record was driven by a combination of climate change and the rising influence of El Niño, pushing heat into the atmosphere across the Pacific.

Temperatures for the month were 1.65C above pre-industrial levels - surpassing the critical 1.5C threshold agreed by countries to avoid the worst consequences of climate change.

While a single month above 1.5C does not mean it has been permanently crossed, it shows a trend towards breaching that limit.

The month also capped western Europe's warmest summer, with high temperatures pushing the season past the deadly heat of 2003.

Dr Samantha Burgess, strategic lead for climate at Copernicus, described August as "a remarkable month in the global climate record", and its impacts had been "increasingly being felt by communities, economies and ecosystems across the world".

The combination of record air temperatures, record ocean heat and Europe's exceptional summer showed how climate change was now driving extremes across "both the atmosphere and the oceans", she said.

UN climate chief Simon Stiell said the record clearly showed humanity's impact on the climate.

"The evidence is irrefutable: this is the spiralling price of humanity's fossil fuel addiction, and the global climate crisis it is fuelling," he said.

On top of the ongoing impact of the use of fossil fuels, the rise of a powerful El Niño is making matters worse, the researchers have said.

El Niño is a natural climate pattern in which a band of the eastern Pacific turns unusually warm, releasing vast amounts of stored ocean heat into the atmosphere and nudging global temperatures upwards for around a year.

The one currently being experienced is still strengthening and could become one of the most powerful on record, according to the Copernicus team.

The biggest impact of this natural phenomenon on global temperatures is expected to hit over the coming year, meaning the current run of records may have further to go.

That prospect follows a summer that drove western Europe to its warmest on record.

This was echoed in the UK, which had its hottest summer since records began in 1884 - a high mark the Met Office found had been made around 130 times more likely by human-caused climate change.

This figures carried "a very real human cost", said Dr Clair Barnes, an extreme weather researcher at Imperial College London.

The heat across the UK and Europe disrupted schools, strained hospitals, hit food production, fuelled fires and drought, and claiming "tens of thousands of lives", she said.

"Until we stop burning fossil fuels these records will continue to tumble, and the extremes will worsen faster than we are able to adapt. Crucially,...
body.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，8 月是有记录以来最热的月份，与 2023 年 7 月持平。 这一纪录是由气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象的影响不断加大共同推动的，厄尔尼诺现象将热量推入太平洋彼岸的大气中。 本月气温比工业化前水平高出 1.65 摄氏度，超过了各国为避免气候变化造成最严重后果而商定的 1.5 摄氏度临界阈值。 虽然单月气温高于 1.5 摄氏度并不意味着它已被永久突破，但它显示出突破该限制的趋势。 这个月也结束了西欧最温暖的夏季，高温使这个季节超越了 2003 年的酷热天气。 哥白尼气候战略主管萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士将八月描述为“全球气候记录中非凡的一个月”，其影响“越来越多地被世界各地的社区、经济和生态系统所感受到”。 她说，创纪录的气温、创纪录的海洋热量和欧洲异常的夏季结合在一起，表明气候变化正在如何推动“大气和海洋”出现极端现象。 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔表示，这一记录清楚地表明了人类对气候的影响。 他说：“证据是无可辩驳的：这就是人类对化石燃料成瘾的螺旋式上升的价格，以及它正在加剧的全球气候危机。” 研究人员表示，除了使用化石燃料造成的持续影响之外，强大的厄尔尼诺现象的兴起也使情况变得更糟。 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候模式，东太平洋的一段区域变得异常温暖，将大量储存的海洋热量释放到大气中，并推动全球气温在一年左右的时间里上升。 据哥白尼团队称，目前正在经历的这一事件仍在加强，并可能成为有记录以来最强大的之一。 这种自然现象对全球气温的最大影响预计将在明年出现，这意味着目前的记录可能还会进一步延续。 这一前景是在西欧经历了有记录以来最温暖的夏季之后发生的。 英国也出现了这种情况，该国正经历自 1884 年有记录以来最热的夏季——英国气象局发现，人为气候变化的可能性增加了约 130 倍。 伦敦帝国理工学院极端天气研究员克莱尔·巴恩斯博士说，这个数字带来了“非常真实的人力成本”。 她说，英国和欧洲各地的高温天气扰乱了学校，使医院不堪重负，影响了粮食生产，加剧了火灾和干旱，并夺去了“数万人的生命”。 “在我们停止燃烧化石燃料之前，这些记录将继续下降，极端情况的恶化速度将超过我们能够适应的速度。至关重要的是……

reflection.en: The Earth's systems, from the vast Pacific to atmospheric temperatures, operate with a complexity that points to the Creator's wisdom. As we witness record-breaking heat, it is a reminder of the intricate balance of creation and our responsibility to steward it well. May we seek to understand and care for this world, recognizing the profound wisdom woven...
reflection.zh: 地球的系统，从广阔的太平洋到大气温度，都以一种指向创造者智慧的复杂性运作着。当我们目睹创纪录的高温时，它提醒我们创造的精妙平衡以及我们管理它的责任。愿我们寻求理解和关爱这个世界，认识到它本身所编织的深刻智慧。

title.en: Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds
title.zh: 印尼古人类25000年前可能嚼食致幻坚果，研究发现

summary.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance, suggesting what may be the earliest known evidence of human drug-taking among ancient Indonesian foragers 25,000 years ago.

body.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago. Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析揭示了牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是人类吸毒的最早已知证据。 已知最早的人类吸毒证据可以追溯到古代印度尼西亚采集者，他们早在 25,000 年前就吸食了改变精神的坚果。对印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛的两具极其罕见的骨骼进行的分析显示，这些人的牙齿磨损严重，并且在剩余的牙齿中发现了精神活性物质的痕迹，这表明他们经常吮吸坚硬、磨蚀性的槟榔。继续阅读...

Job 12:7-9 speaks to this, urging us to ask the animals and birds, and to learn from the earth, for all of creation declares the wisdom of its Maker.
