title.en: Boy developed "toasted skin" condition from using a laptop every day
title.zh: 男孩因每天使用笔记本电脑而患上“烤肤”症

summary.en: Laptops typically do not reach temperatures high enough to cause burns, but they can still be physically harmful.
summary.zh: 笔记本电脑通常不会达到足以灼伤的温度，但它们仍然可能对身体造成伤害。

body.en: Fears that modern electronic devices may harm children are nothing new. Gadgets with screens of any size have long been allegedly melting, rotting, and/or corrupting the brains of youths for decades. However, a medical case report published this week offers a new and alarming way our digital doodads may cause physical harm. In BMJ Case Reports , two UK doctors, Mara Znagoveanu and Edward Artley, report the case of a boy who came to an emergency department with alarming marks on his abdomen. The marks were described as being in a patch about 15 centimeters (six inches) wide, made of flat, reddish-brown "interlacing lines forming irregular circles and a lace-like morphology." A picture of the marks is here . Mysterious marks The boy, whom they described only as being in "mid-childhood," was not in any pain, and the rash was not warm to the touch or tender. He and his parents said they couldn't think of any recent injuries or trauma that might explain the marks. He was otherwise healthy, hadn't recently been ill, and had no systemic symptoms, such as fever or fatigue. Everything about the boy's health, growth, and medical history looked normal. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 对现代电子设备可能伤害儿童的担忧并不是什么新鲜事。据称，几十年来，具有任何尺寸屏幕的小玩意一直在融化、腐烂和/或腐蚀年轻人的大脑。然而，本周发布的一份医疗案例报告提供了一种新的、令人震惊的方式，我们的数字小玩意可能会造成身体伤害。在《BMJ 病例报告》中，两位英国医生 Mara Znagoveanu 和 Edward Artley 报告了一名男孩的病例，该男孩的腹部出现令人震惊的痕迹，来到急诊室。这些痕迹被描述为宽约 15 厘米（六英寸）的斑块，由平坦的红棕色“交错线形成不规则的圆圈和花边状形态”组成。标记的图片在这里。神秘痕迹 这个男孩，他们只描述为“童年中期”，没有任何疼痛，皮疹摸起来不温暖也不柔软。他和他的父母说，他们想不出最近有什么受伤或创伤可以解释这些痕迹。他其他方面都很健康，最近没有生病，也没有发烧或疲劳等全身症状。男孩的健康、生长发育和病史一切看起来都很正常。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This medical report details a boy's skin condition, 'toasted skin syndrome,' caused by daily laptop use. It serves as a reminder that even seemingly benign technology can have unintended physical consequences. Psalm 139:14 marvels, 'I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.' This reminds us of...
reflection.zh: 这篇医学报告详细描述了一名男孩因每天使用笔记本电脑而患上“烤肤综合征”的皮肤病。这提醒我们，即使是看似无害的技术也可能带来意想不到的身体后果。 诗篇139:14惊叹道：“我要称谢你，因我被造，奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我深知的。”这提醒我们身体精妙的设计，以及它可能以我们未曾预料到的方式受到环境和习惯的影响。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: More Anthropic researchers warn of AI’s perils but Musk dismisses ‘psyop’
title.zh: 更多Anthropic研究人员警告人工智能的危险，马斯克称担忧是‘心理战’

summary.en: Insiders at the firm fear that technological advancement could lead to human extinction, while others dismiss these concerns as a 'setup.' Following a former Anthropic researcher's apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence, more researchers and staff members at the AI startup have publicly agreed and...
summary.zh: 公司内部人士担心技术进步可能导致人类灭绝，而其他人则称担忧是‘设局’。在一位前Anthropic研究员就人工智能发表末日论声明一天后，更多该AI初创公司的研究人员和员工公开表示赞同，并发布了他们自己的严峻警告。埃隆·马斯克和其他X（前身为Twitter）上的保守派人士则将这些担忧称为‘设局’和‘心理战’。

body.en: Insiders at the firm fear tech’s advancement could cause human extinction, while others are calling their declarations of concern a ‘setup’ A day after a former researcher at Anthropic made an apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence, more researchers and staff members at the AI startup publicly agreed with him and posted their own dire warnings. In response, Elon Musk and other conservative figures on X, formerly Twitter, called the chorus of concerns a “setup” and a “psyop”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司内部人士担心科技的进步可能会导致人类灭绝，而其他人则称其为“圈套”。在 Anthropic 的一位前研究员发表有关人工智能的世界末日声明后的第二天，这家人工智能初创公司的更多研究人员和工作人员公开同意他的观点，并发布了自己的可怕警告。作为回应，埃隆·马斯克和 X（前身为 Twitter）上的其他保守派人士将这种担忧称为“圈套”和“心理战”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence raises profound questions about humanity's trajectory. When the creators themselves voice fears of existential threats, it echoes the ancient story of Babel, where unchecked ambition and technological prowess led to confusion. This moment calls for humility and wisdom, seeking to align our creations with the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展引发了关于人类发展轨迹的深刻问题。当创造者本身就表达了对生存威胁的担忧时，这呼应了古老的巴别塔故事，当时不受约束的野心和技术实力导致了混乱。这一时刻呼唤谦卑和智慧，寻求将我们的创造物与所有人的福祉结合起来，而不是在不顾后果的情况下追求权力。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: LinkedIn beats "BrowserGate" lawsuits over scanning users' Chrome extensions
title.zh: 领英公司在关于扫描用户Chrome扩展程序的“浏览器门”诉讼中胜诉

summary.en: LinkedIn has successfully had two lawsuits dismissed that accused the company of scanning users' browser extensions. A judge ruled that the plaintiffs did not adequately allege that they had standing to sue, as they did not claim their extensions conveyed private information to LinkedIn.
summary.zh: 领英公司成功驳回了两起指控其扫描用户浏览器扩展程序的诉讼。一位法官裁定，原告未能充分证明他们有权提起诉讼，因为他们没有声称自己的扩展程序向领英传输了私人信息。

body.en: LinkedIn beat two lawsuits over its practice of scanning users’ browser extensions, with a judge granting the Microsoft subsidiary's motion to dismiss the cases. The users who sued LinkedIn failed to adequately allege that they have standing to sue because neither asserted that they "had browser extensions installed that conveyed private information to LinkedIn," ruled Judge Vince Chhabria in US District Court for the Northern District of California. In his ruling on Tuesday, Chhabria gave the plaintiffs leave to amend their complaints but said he doubts they can make a plausible case. "Given LinkedIn’s further arguments that users voluntarily download browser extensions, which by their nature intentionally expose data to websites, it seems unlikely that the plaintiffs will ever be able to allege a privacy violation, much less prevail at the end of the day," Chhabria wrote. California residents Nicholas Farrell and Jeff Ganan separately filed class actions against LinkedIn in April, seeking to represent themselves and other LinkedIn users. Ganan's attorney, J.R. Howell, said he is evaluating whether to bring the claims in a California state court, which has different requirements on standing, or to appeal the US district court ruling in the US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: LinkedIn 因其扫描用户浏览器扩展程序的行为而击败了两起诉讼，法官批准了微软子公司驳回案件的动议。美国加利福尼亚州北区地方法院法官文斯·查布里亚 (Vince Chhabria) 裁定，起诉 LinkedIn 的用户未能充分声称他们有资格提起诉讼，因为他们都没有声称自己“安装了向 LinkedIn 传送私人信息的浏览器扩展”。在周二的裁决中，查布里亚允许原告修改他们的申诉，但他表示他怀疑他们能否提出一个可信的案子。查布里亚写道：“鉴于 LinkedIn 进一步提出用户自愿下载浏览器扩展的论点，这些扩展本质上是有意向网站公开数据，原告似乎不太可能指控侵犯隐私，更不用说最终获胜了。”加州居民尼古拉斯·法雷尔 (Nicholas Farrell) 和杰夫·加南 (Jeff Ganan) 于 4 月份分别对 LinkedIn 提起集体诉讼，寻求代表自己和其他 LinkedIn 用户。加南的律师 J.R. 豪厄尔 (J.R. Howell) 表示，他正在评估是否向对诉讼资格有不同要求的加利福尼亚州法院提起诉讼，或者向美国第九巡回上诉法院对美国地方法院的裁决提出上诉。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In a world awash with data, the question of privacy is paramount. This ruling highlights the need for clear allegations of harm, reminding us that true understanding and justice require careful discernment and evidence, not just the assertion of potential misuse. As Proverbs 15:15 says, "The discerning heart seeks knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks...
reflection.zh: 在这个充斥着数据的世界里，隐私问题至关重要。这项裁决强调了提出明确损害指控的必要性，提醒我们真正的理解和正义需要仔细辨别和证据，而不仅仅是断言潜在的滥用。《箴言》15:15说：“通达人的心求知识，智慧人的耳寻求知识。”

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Europe will go it alone on Venus mission after NASA yanks radar instrument
title.zh: 欧洲在NASA退出雷达仪器后将独自执行金星任务

summary.en: Europe is forging ahead with its Envision mission to Venus, developing its own radar instrument after NASA withdrew its commitment to provide one. This independent approach will allow the European Space Agency to map Venus's surface with higher resolution than previous missions.
summary.zh: 在NASA退出提供关键雷达仪器后，欧洲正推进其金星探测任务“Envision”，并自行开发雷达仪器。这种独立的方式将使欧洲空间局能够以前所未有的高分辨率绘制金星表面地图。

body.en: The European Space Agency is moving "full steam ahead" with development of a robotic mission to Venus after NASA officials determined they were unlikely to fulfill a commitment to provide a US-built radar instrument for the spacecraft, the mission's project scientist said. The European orbiter, named Envision, will map the Venusian surface at 10 times higher resolution than the last radar mission sent to Venus by NASA in the 1990s. The planet is enshrouded in a blanket of thick clouds of sulfuric acid, rendering its mysterious surface unseen by optical cameras in orbit. Radar is the most effective way to penetrate the clouds of Venus to reveal the terrain below, and scientists will use Envision to look for signs of active volcanism. NASA and ESA signed a memorandum of understanding in 2024 outlining their partnership on Envision. NASA agreed to supply a US-made synthetic aperture radar instrument, Envision's primary means of mapping the surface of Venus, along with providing tracking and communications support through NASA's Deep Space Network. In exchange, ESA would include US researchers on Envision's science team. Europe would build the Envision spacecraft and the rest of its science instruments and provide the launch on an Ariane 6 rocket. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 该任务的项目科学家表示，在美国宇航局官员确定他们不太可能履行为航天器提供美国制造的雷达仪器的承诺后，欧洲航天局正在“全力推进”金星机器人任务的开发。名为 Envision 的欧洲轨道飞行器将以比 20 世纪 90 年代 NASA 发送到金星的最后一次雷达任务高 10 倍的分辨率绘制金星表面地图。这颗行星笼罩在一层厚厚的硫酸云中，轨道上的光学相机无法看到它神秘的表面。雷达是穿透金星云层以揭示金星下方地形的最有效方法，科学家将使用“远景”来寻找活跃火山活动的迹象。 NASA 和 ESA 于 2024 年签署了一份谅解备忘录，概述了双方在 Envision 上的合作伙伴关系。美国宇航局同意提供美国制造的合成孔径雷达仪器，这是远景公司绘制金星表面地图的主要手段，并通过美国宇航局的深空网络提供跟踪和通信支持。作为交换，欧空局将让美国研究人员加入远景科技的科学团队。欧洲将建造远景航天器及其其余科学仪器，并使用阿丽亚娜 6 号火箭进行发射。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to explore and understand the cosmos is a powerful impulse, often leading to ambitious, collaborative projects. When partnerships falter, as with the Envision mission losing NASA's radar instrument, the drive can shift towards independent or even competitive endeavors. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where a unified human ambition,...
reflection.zh: 人类探索和理解宇宙的冲动是强大的，常常促成宏伟的合作项目。当合作破裂时，就像“Envision”任务失去了NASA的雷达仪器一样，这种冲动可能会转向独立甚至竞争性的努力。这让人想起古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类统一的雄心壮志，尽管目标是触及天堂，但最终却被分散了。愿我们的科学探索永远伴随着谦卑，并认识到我们的局限性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Android can now securely migrate your logins between password managers
title.zh: Android 现在可以安全地在密码管理器之间迁移您的登录信息

summary.en: App support is slim right now, but Google says more are coming. As longer, more complex passwords have become a necessity, remembering all those strings of numbers, letters, and special characters has become nearly impossible. Password managers can solve that problem, but what happens when you want to move to a...
summary.zh: 目前应用程序支持有限，但谷歌表示未来会有更多支持。随着越来越长、越来越复杂的密码成为必需品，记住所有这些数字、字母和特殊字符的字符串已变得近乎不可能。密码管理器可以解决这个问题，但当你想要迁移到另一个登录信息管理器时会发生什么？当然，你可以手动将所有登录信息输入到一个新应用程序中，但现在 Android...

body.en: As longer, more complex passwords have become a necessity, remembering all those strings of numbers, letters, and special characters has become nearly impossible. Password managers can solve that problem, but what happens when you want to move to a different login organizer? Sure, you could manually type all your logins into a new app, but now Android can do that for you without the tedium. Google designed the new login transfer process to happen entirely on your phone, so you need the corresponding apps installed with your credentials synced. To start the move, you'll have to find the import option in the app you want to use. The location of that feature will vary, but in Google Password Manager (built into Android), it's near the top under the settings tab. The import option in Google Password Manager will plug in to the new migration system, while export still just creates an unencrypted CSV with your passwords that can be dumped into any app. It will be similar in other apps, so make sure to start the process in the app you want to use. Currently, this works in Google's app, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 随着更长、更复杂的密码成为必需，记住所有这些数字、字母和特殊字符字符串几乎变得不可能。密码管理器可以解决这个问题，但是当您想转移到不同的登录管理器时会发生什么？当然，您可以在新应用程序中手动输入所有登录信息，但现在 Android 可以为您做到这一点，而无需繁琐的操作。谷歌设计的新登录传输过程完全在您的手机上进行，因此您需要安装相应的应用程序并同步您的凭据。要开始移动，您必须在要使用的应用程序中找到导入选项。该功能的位置会有所不同，但在 Google 密码管理器（内置于 Android 中）中，它位于“设置”选项卡下的顶部附近。 Google 密码管理器中的导入选项将插入新的迁移系统，而导出仍然只是使用您的密码创建一个未加密的 CSV，可以将其转储到任何应用程序中。其他应用程序中的情况类似，因此请确保在您要使用的应用程序中启动该过程。目前，这适用于 Google 的应用程序、1Password、Bitwarden 和 Dashlane。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In our age of rapid technological advancement, the sheer volume of information and the complexity of digital life can feel overwhelming. This new Android feature addresses a practical need arising from this complexity, making digital management more accessible. It reminds us that as knowledge increases, so does our need for tools and wisdom to navigate it.
reflection.zh: 在我们技术飞速发展的时代，海量的信息和复杂的数字生活可能会让人感到不知所措。这项新的 Android 功能解决了由此产生的复杂性带来的实际需求，使数字管理更加便捷。它提醒我们，随着知识的增长，我们也需要工具和智慧来驾驭它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Panic builds over bankrupt Spirit’s looming data sale to Google
title.zh: 谷歌竞拍购买航空公司破产数据引发恐慌

summary.en: Google has won an auction to purchase a large volume of operational data from Spirit Airlines as part of its bankruptcy proceedings, a move that has caused alarm among those who developed the technology that generated the data.
summary.zh: 谷歌在精神航空公司（Spirit Airlines）的破产程序中赢得了一场拍卖，将购买该航空公司大量的运营数据，这一举动引起了开发了生成这些数据技术的相关人士的担忧。

body.en: Doug Kreuzkamp was shocked when news outlets reported that Google won an auction to buy a huge amount of operational data as part of Spirit Airlines’ bankruptcy proceedings. Kreuzkamp founded a startup called Springshot in 2011, which created a widely used proprietary platform that helps humans and AI systems improve airline efficiency and quickly solve logistics problems so flights can stay on time and airlines can operate as smoothly as possible. Hundreds of airports use it globally. Springshot powered Spirit’s technology stack for the last three years, right up to the “very last flight,” Kreuzkamp told Ars. Yet his company got no notice when Spirit prepared to auction off a massive dataset that he thinks likely improperly includes a substantial amount of data and intellectual property (IP) that Springshot owns—not Spirit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 当新闻媒体报道谷歌赢得拍卖并购买大量运营数据（作为精神航空公司破产程序的一部分）时，道格·克罗伊茨坎普 (Doug Kreuzkamp) 感到震惊。 Kreuzkamp 于 2011 年创立了一家名为 Springshot 的初创公司，该公司创建了一个广泛使用的专有平台，帮助人类和人工智能系统提高航空公司效率并快速解决物流问题，以便航班能够准点，航空公司能够尽可能顺利运营。全球数百个机场使用它。 Kreuzkamp 告诉 Ars，Springshot 在过去三年中为 Spirit 的技术堆栈提供了动力，直到“最后一次飞行”。然而，当 Spirit 准备拍卖大量数据集时，他的公司却没有注意到，他认为该数据集可能不恰当地包含了 Springshot 拥有的大量数据和知识产权 (IP)，而不是 Spirit。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The news that Google won an auction for Spirit Airlines' operational data during its bankruptcy proceedings raises concerns about how vast datasets, generated by complex systems, might be exploited. This echoes the ancient story of the Tower of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess, unchecked by divine wisdom, led to confusion and...
reflection.zh: 谷歌在精神航空公司破产程序中赢得其运营数据拍卖的消息，引发了人们对如何利用海量数据集的担忧。这与古代巴别塔的故事有相似之处，当时人类的野心和技术能力在没有神圣智慧的约束下，导致了混乱和分散。问题随之而来：我们是在构建服务于人类的数据和人工智能高塔，还是在冒着因无节制的野心而导致新一轮分散的风险？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: China’s Huawei branded a criminal enterprise as tech firm’s US trial opens
title.zh: 华为在美国被指控为犯罪企业，科技公司在美庭审开始

summary.en: The US trial against Chinese tech company Huawei has begun in Brooklyn federal court, with a prosecutor describing the firm as a criminal enterprise that engaged in theft and deception for two decades to dominate the telecommunications industry. The defense countered that the case is about competition, not conspiracy.
summary.zh: 中国科技公司华为在美国的庭审已在布鲁克林联邦法院开始，一位检察官称该公司为犯罪企业，在过去二十年里进行盗窃和欺骗以主导电信行业。辩方则反驳称此案关乎竞争，而非阴谋。

body.en: The defense says: ‘It’s about competition, not conspiracy’ A US prosecutor described China ’s Huawei as a criminal enterprise that stole from US companies to build its telecommunications empire, as ⁠the trial against the tech company kicked off in Brooklyn federal court on Wednesday. “Theft, lies, cover-up,” Taylor Stout, a trial attorney from the US Department of Justice, said in the government’s opening statement. “For 20 years, that’s how Huawei, a massive Chinese telecommunications company, victimized American companies ⁠and abused the American financial system, all ⁠in an effort to dominate the telecommunications ​industry around the world.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 辩方称：“这是竞争，而不是阴谋”周三，针对这家科技公司的审判在布鲁克林联邦法院开始，一名美国检察官将中国华为描述为一家犯罪企业，从美国公司窃取资金以建立其电信帝国。 “盗窃、谎言、掩盖，”美国司法部出庭律师泰勒·斯托特 (Taylor Stout) 在政府的开庭陈述中表示。 “20年来，华为这家大型中国电信公司就是这样迫害美国公司并滥用美国金融体系的，所有这一切都是为了主宰全球电信行业。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The opening statements in the Huawei trial paint a stark picture of alleged corporate malfeasance. The prosecution's accusations of 'theft, lies, and cover-up' echo the prophet Micah's call to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.' This highlights the enduring tension between ambition and integrity in the global marketplace.
reflection.zh: 华为案的开庭陈述描绘了一幅严峻的企业不当行为图景。控方的“盗窃、谎言和掩盖”指控，呼应了先知弥迦的呼吁：“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”这凸显了在全球市场中，野心与诚信之间永恒的张力。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: I turned off my algorithm for 24 hours. Is this how social media used to be?
title.zh: 我关闭了算法24小时。社交媒体是这样吗？

summary.en: An Australian journalist experimented with disabling Instagram's algorithm for 24 hours, seeking to experience social media as it might have been in 2012 before algorithmic curation dominated, where content was less driven by advertising and engagement metrics.
summary.zh: 一位澳大利亚记者尝试关闭了Instagram的算法24小时，试图体验2012年算法策展尚未主导互联网时的社交媒体，那时内容较少受广告和参与度指标驱动。

body.en: Thanks to a little-known feature in Instagram, I try to travel back to 2012 – before everything on the internet was an ad Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast I have a confession. I love my social media algorithm. It is a perfectly curated window into my insane and inquiring mind. It knows precisely which videos will tickle me and which memes will gently distract me from the slow collapse of humankind. On Tuesday the Australian government announced “world-leading” reforms that would force social media platforms to allow users to opt-out of algorithms, dubbed “my feed, my way” . On the same day, I was delighted to be confronted with a video on Instagram of a woman accidentally spilling a bucket of eels on a Chinese train. Dozens of eels slithered among the passengers, who appeared not as surprised as I would have expected. Continue reading...
body.zh: 感谢 Instagram 中一个鲜为人知的功能，我尝试回到 2012 年，那时互联网上的一切都是广告。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 我有一个坦白。我喜欢我的社交媒体算法。这是一扇精心策划的窗口，让我了解我疯狂而好奇的心灵。它准确地知道哪些视频会让我发痒，哪些模因会轻轻地分散我对人类缓慢崩溃的注意力。周二，澳大利亚政府宣布了“世界领先”的改革，将迫使社交媒体平台允许用户选择退出算法，即“我的提要，我的方式”。同一天，我很高兴在 Instagram 上看到一段视频，内容是一名妇女不小心将一桶鳗鱼洒在中国火车上。数十条鳗鱼在乘客中间爬行，乘客们似乎并不像我想象的那么惊讶。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age saturated with algorithmically-driven content, the author's experiment highlights a growing unease with the curated digital landscape. Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, and excellent, a practice that becomes challenging when our online spaces are designed to capture our attention through endless streams of often...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着算法驱动内容的时代，作者的实验凸显了人们对精心策划的数字景观日益增长的不安。腓立比书4:8呼吁我们将心思意念专注于真实、良善和美好的事物，当我们的网络空间被设计用来通过无休止的、常常肤浅或操纵性的内容来吸引我们的注意力时，这种实践变得充满挑战。这篇反思鼓励我们有意识地努力去寻找并专注于真正滋养心灵和精神的事物，即使在数字的喧嚣中。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: UK needs new laws for AI in healthcare, says watchdog
title.zh: 英国监管机构称医疗保健领域需要新的人工智能法律

summary.en: Britain's industry watchdog, the MHRA, has published 44 recommendations for updating policies as the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, including the NHS, is set to become routine. The agency emphasizes the need for new regulations to ensure patient trust and confidence.
summary.zh: 英国的行业监管机构药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）发布了44项政策更新建议，因为人工智能（AI）在医疗保健领域的应用，包括国民医疗服务体系（NHS），将变得司空见惯。该机构强调需要新的法规来确保患者的信任和信心。

body.en:
The UK needs new regulations for AI products used in the NHS and other healthcare settings, says Britain's industry watchdog.

The Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), which regulates all medical devices and licenses treatment drugs in the UK, has published 44 recommendations to update its policies as the use of AI in the sector rises.

The technology will soon be routinely used within the NHS, MHRA chief Lawrence Tallon told the BBC.

"What I would expect is that patients will... increasingly see AI as part of the way that normal NHS healthcare is delivered," he said.

"That should happen in a way that they can maintain their trust and their confidence in what's happening."

The report was compiled by an independent commission and involved input from more than 12,000 people including patients and clinicians.

"The medical devices regulatory framework predominantly dates from a period where we were thinking about things like hip replacements and knee replacements, or smaller things like stethoscopes and plasters," Tallon said.

He added while current guidelines may work for simple AI products trained to spot known symptoms on scans, for example, the rules do not apply to more complex models.

"Unlike most of the medical products we're used to regulating, these products continue to change after the point of authorization," he said.

"I don't think at this moment in time we can point to a single country, a single regulatory framework, and say that they have absolutely cracked it," he said.

AI note-takers known as scribes, which are powered by LLMs, are reportedly used by 40% of UK-based GPs to record consultations and generate reports.

But a recent study from the University of Edinburgh found patients could be less likely to share personal information such as substance abuse history if they knew the conversation was being processed by AI.

Professor Henrietta Hughes, a GP who was part of the report commission, said that many of her patients were happy for AI being used during their consultations, but some chose to opt out.

Prof Hughes acknowledged that the scribes could make mistakes in their notes but said it was the responsibility of doctors to correct them.

While currently AI is more likely to be used to assist with administrative tasks, or carry out symptom spotting overseen by a human expert, there is a lot of excitement about its potential in the health and medical research industries.

Professor Alastair Denniston, an ophthalmologist who also worked on the report, described the technology as "an exceptional opportunity" for healthcare which was "likely to rank alongside step-changes such as antibiotics and MRI".

In September Rene Haas, the boss of chip designer Arm, told the BBC he believed the tech would come up...
body.zh: 英国行业监管机构表示，英国需要对 NHS 和其他医疗保健机构中使用的人工智能产品制定新的法规。 随着人工智能在该行业使​​用的增加，负责监管英国所有医疗设备和治疗药物许可的药品和保健产品监管机构 (MHRA) 发布了 44 条建议来更新其政策。 MHRA 负责人劳伦斯·塔伦 (Lawrence Tallon) 告诉 BBC，这项技术很快将在 NHS 内常规使用。 他说：“我期望患者……越来越多地将人工智能视为 NHS 提供正常医疗服务方式的一部分。” “这应该以一种他们能够保持对正在发生的事情的信任和信心的方式发生。” 该报告由一个独立委员会编写，涉及包括患者和临床医生在内的 12,000 多人的意见。 塔隆说：“医疗器械监管框架主要可以追溯到我们考虑髋关节置换术和膝关节置换术或听诊器和膏药等较小事物的时期。” 他补充说，虽然当前的指南可能适用于经过训练以在扫描中发现已知症状的简单人工智能产品，但这些规则不适用于更复杂的模型。 “与我们习惯监管的大多数医疗产品不同，这些产品在授权后会继续发生变化，”他说。 他说：“我认为目前我们不能针对某个国家、某个监管框架就说他们已经完全破解了这个问题。” 据报道，40% 的英国全科医生使用由法学硕士提供支持的人工智能笔记记录器（抄写员）来记录咨询并生成报告。 但爱丁堡大学最近的一项研究发现，如果患者知道对话正在由人工智能处理，他们就不太可能分享药物滥用历史等个人信息。 报告委员会成员之一的全科医生 Henrietta Hughes 教授表示，她的许多患者对在咨询过程中使用人工智能感到高兴，但有些人选择退出。 休斯教授承认抄写员可能会在笔记中犯错误，但表示医生有责任纠正这些错误。 虽然目前人工智能更有可能用于协助管理任务，或在人类专家的监督下进行症状发现，但它在健康和医学研究行业的潜力令人兴奋。 参与该报告撰写的眼科医生阿拉斯泰尔·丹尼斯顿 (Alastair Denniston) 教授将这项技术描述为医疗保健领域的“一次绝佳机会”，“可能与抗生素和核磁共振等重大技术进步并驾齐驱”。 9 月，芯片设计公司 Arm 的老板雷内·哈斯 (Rene Haas) 告诉 BBC，他相信这项技术将会出现……

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare, the UK's MHRA is calling for updated regulations. This proactive approach, as highlighted by chief Lawrence Tallon, is crucial for maintaining public trust. It echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 27:12, which advises prudence and foresight when navigating new and potentially impactful...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能日益融入医疗保健领域，英国药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）呼吁更新相关法规。正如其负责人劳伦斯·塔隆所强调的，这种积极主动的方法对于维持公众信任至关重要。这呼应了箴言27:12的智慧，该经文建议在应对新的、可能产生重大影响的事态发展时要审慎和有远见。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title.zh: 谷歌选择芬兰作为其在欧洲的最大单笔投资

summary.en: The US tech giant announces a record €13bn investment in Finland, primarily for AI infrastructure, including three new data centers and an expansion of an existing site. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs and involves a 22-year agreement to purchase electricity from a nuclear power plant.
summary.zh: 这家美国科技巨头宣布了创纪录的130亿欧元投资芬兰，主要用于人工智能基础设施，包括三个新的数据中心和一个现有站点的扩建。该项目预计将创造数万个就业机会，并涉及一项为期22年的核电站电力购买协议。

body.en:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.

Earlier this year, Google's parent company Alphabet raised its global...
body.zh: 该公司宣布，谷歌将购买芬兰一座核电站最多一半的电力，作为该国人工智能基础设施创纪录的 130 亿欧元（110 亿英镑；150 亿美元）投资的一部分。 这家美国科技巨头表示，该计划将为三个新数据中心提供资金，扩建现有站点并支持能源项目，以满足日益增长的人工智能服务需求。 该公司周三表示：“这是谷歌在欧洲最大的单笔投资，证明了芬兰在负责任地建设人工智能基础设施方面的领导地位。” 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波在一份声明中表示：“谷歌的决定清楚地证明了我们的优势。” 作为交易的一部分，谷歌与芬兰公用事业公司 Fortum 签署了一份为期 22 年的合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多 50% 的电力。 本周早些时候，TikTok 宣布在芬兰投资 10 亿美元，在科沃拉建设一个新的数据中心，并指出该国“强大的数字基础设施、清洁能源组合、强大的数据治理和熟练的技术人才”。 芬兰因其凉爽的气候、充足的低碳电力和相对不拥堵的电网而成为数据中心的有吸引力的地点。较低的温度可以减少冷却装有计算机服务器的设施所需的能源。 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展推动了对庞大数据中心网络的需求，科技公司正在竞相确保电力供应。 据谷歌称，谷歌的投资预计将在建设期间支持超过 37,000 个就业岗位，并使芬兰的 GDP 每年增加 36 亿欧元。施工预计于 2027 年和 2028 年进行。 奥尔波补充道：“数据经济的价值远远超出了直接投资的范围，还可以刺激创新、研究和开发。” “深化我们与谷歌的合作将为双方带来持久的利益。” 谷歌将在卡亚尼、穆霍斯和瓦阿拉建立新的数据中心，同时扩大其在哈米纳的现有设施，该设施是谷歌于 2009 年改造前造纸厂后建立的。 该基础设施将帮助支持 AI 聊天机器人 Gemini 等产品，以及搜索、地图和 YouTube 等服务。 谷歌表示，这些投资还涵盖“清洁能源项目，以及支持当地生物多样性、教育、研究和劳动力发展的专用自然和社区基金”。 Alphabet 和谷歌总裁兼首席投资官露丝·波拉特 (Ruth Porat) 表示：“谷歌很自豪能够加深我们在芬兰的根基。” 她补充道：“这项投资凸显了谷歌致力于负责任地扩大我们的影响力，将我们的技术基础设施的扩张与新能源产能、电网增强和能源负担能力计划结合起来。” 今年早些时候，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 筹集了全球...

reflection.en: This significant investment by Google in Finland's technological future, particularly in AI infrastructure, highlights the human drive to build and innovate. It also points to the careful planning and long-term commitments required for such large-scale projects, echoing the principle of entrusting one's endeavors to a higher power for success.
reflection.zh: 谷歌在芬兰技术未来，特别是在人工智能基础设施方面的大笔投资，彰显了人类建设和创新的动力。这也表明了如此大规模项目所需的审慎规划和长期承诺，呼应了将自身事业托付于更高力量以求成功的原则。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Anthropic researcher believes more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
title.zh: Anthropic研究员认为人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率为10%以上

summary.en: A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned that AI is advancing so rapidly that he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it could pose an existential risk to humanity within the next decade, a concern echoed in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI safety.
summary.zh: 一家名为Anthropic的安全研究主管警告说，人工智能的进步速度如此之快，他认为在未来十年内，人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率超过10%。这一担忧与一系列日益严峻的人工智能安全警告相呼应。

body.en:
A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned AI is advancing so quickly he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

Evan Hubinger said in a post on X , external the risk from the models which currently exist was "low" but he was "worried" the technology might develop and improve itself soon to the point where it posed an existential risk to humanity.

He did not spell out how he thought AI systems could in future result in humans being wiped out.

But his comments are the latest in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI, with the debate shifting from whether it truly poses a risk to how big that risk is.

Hubinger's intervention was in response to another post on X , external from Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher who has just quit Anthropic and previously worked at OpenAI.

"These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources."

Dame Wendy Hall, a computer scientist who advises the UN on AI, told the BBC she was "shocked" by Hubinger and Coxon's social media posts.

She told the World at One on BBC Radio Four some of it could be "PR and marketing" however, as Anthropic and OpenAI raced towards highly anticipated stock market debuts.

But she added: "Why would someone want to say that? I would plead with investors not to invest in this company if that is their value system."

The resignation prompted Darren Jones, former chief secretary to the Treasury and chief secretary to Sir Keir Starmer, to write an open letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling for a new multinational treaty for the safe development of AI.

He told the BBC governments had to come together to "collaborate" about what a treaty based on the development of superintelligence should look like.

"Unless governments take these warnings seriously enough and step up to it, the pace of development could mean that we end up with problems before we've started to look at whether it is an issue for us or not," he said.

Separately, the Financial Times reported , external Anthropic withheld its latest model from the UK's AI Security Institute (AISI), one of the leading bodies in the world for assessing AI risk.

Anthropic has declined to comment on the posts by its employees or the situation with the AISI.

A Cabinet Office spokesperson did not comment on whether the latest model had been withheld from the AISI - instead saying it "continues to collaborate closely with industry partners, including Anthropic, to make models safer".

In his post, which has been viewed more than 10 million times, Hubinger said "we really do earnestly believe" AI poses a species-ending risk to humans.

"I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have...
body.zh: Anthropic 的一位顶级安全研究员警告说，人工智能的发展速度如此之快，他相信在未来十年内，它“可能杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%。 埃文·胡宾格（Evan Hubinger）在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，目前存在的模型的外部风险“很低”，但他“担心”该技术可能会很快发展和改进，从而对人类构成生存风险。 他没有详细说明他认为人工智能系统将来如何导致人类被消灭。 但他的言论是一系列关于人工智能日益严厉的警告中的最新一个，争论的焦点从人工智能是否真正构成风险转向风险有多大。 Hubinger 的干预是为了回应 X 上的另一篇帖子，该帖子来自 Jacob Coxon 外部，他是一位人工智能研究员，刚刚退出 Anthropic，之前在 OpenAI 工作。 “这些很快就会成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。” 为联合国人工智能提供建议的计算机科学家温迪·霍尔夫人 (Dame Wendy Hall) 告诉 BBC，她对胡宾格和考克森的社交媒体帖子感到“震惊”。 她在 BBC 广播四台的 World at One 节目中表示，其中一些可能是“公关和营销”，因为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正竞相在备受期待的股市首次亮相。 但她补充道：“为什么有人会这么说？我恳求投资者不要投资这家公司，如果这就是他们的价值体系。” 此次辞职促使前财政部首席秘书兼基尔·斯塔默爵士首席秘书达伦·琼斯（Darren Jones）向总理安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）写了一封公开信，呼吁制定一项新的跨国条约以促进人工智能的安全发展。 他告诉英国广播公司，各国政府必须齐心协力“合作”，以制定基于超级智能发展的条约。 他说：“除非各国政府足够认真地对待这些警告并采取行动，否则发展速度可能意味着我们在开始考虑这是否对我们来说是一个问题之前就遇到了问题。” 另外，据英国《金融时报》报道，外部 Anthropic 向英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 扣留了其最新模型，该研究所是世界上评估人工智能风险的领先机构之一。 Anthropic 拒绝对其员工的帖子或 AISI 的情况发表评论。 内阁办公室发言人没有就 AISI 是否扣留最新模型发表评论，而是表示“将继续与包括 Anthropic 在内的行业合作伙伴密切合作，以提高模型的安全性”。 胡宾格在他的帖子中表示，“我们确实真诚地相信”人工智能会给人类带来物种灭绝的风险，该帖子的浏览量已超过 1000 万次。 “我相信 Anthropic 正在尽最大努力，但我们还没有......

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by the researcher's stark warning, mirrors the biblical prophecy of increasing knowledge in the end times. While human ingenuity can achieve wonders, this verse reminds us that knowledge alone, without wisdom and ethical grounding, can lead down perilous paths. We are called to pursue...
reflection.zh: 研究人员对人工智能发出严峻警告，其进步速度之快恰如末世知识增长的预言。虽然人类的创造力能成就奇迹，但这节经文提醒我们，知识本身若无智慧和道德根基，可能引向危险的道路。我们蒙召要谦卑地追求理解，认识到自身远见的局限性，以及不受约束的技术野心可能带来的后果。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
title.zh: 白宫因版权担忧下架“叠叠墙”游戏

summary.en: The White House has removed a game from its website called 'Build The Wall,' which used a Tetris-style mechanic for players to stack blocks and 'protect the border.' This action was taken after The Tetris Company expressed concerns about copyright infringement, stating they were not involved with the game.
summary.zh: 白宫已从其网站上撤下一款名为“叠叠墙”的游戏，该游戏使用类似俄罗斯方块的机制让玩家堆叠方块以“保护边境”。此前，俄罗斯方块公司对版权侵权表示担忧，并声明他们并未参与该游戏的开发。

body.en:
The White House has taken down a Tetris-style game on its website called "Build The Wall", days after The Tetris Company raised concerns over its use of the game's likeness.

The game, which saw players stack blocks to build a wall to "protect the border" is one of five arcade games which have appeared on the White House website.

On 4 September the official Tetris account on X posted , external the firm was "not involved in the creation" of the game and it took "copyright infringement very seriously".

The White House has not responded to requests for comment from the BBC or given an official reason for the takedown.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and building people together, not dividing them," the firm said in its initial response to the game.

"To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

The Tetris Company has had previous success in suing firms for infringing on its copyright - settling for an undisclosed fee with the makers of the iPhone game Mino in 2012, which it claimed stole the look and feel of the block-builder.

Four other arcade games still remain on the mini-game section of the White House website.

"Flappy Bill", a clone of the 2013 viral hit Flappy Bird sees players fly a bald eagle and dodging monuments from the National Mall.

Meanwhile in Rio Run, players must "patrol the line along the river", with gameplay reminiscent of the classic phone game Snake.

When players run into the edge of the map, a "Deported" number shows how many people the player was able to catch.

The games have drawn criticism from politicians, with Connecticut Democratic state senator Matt Lesser tweeting , external : "Heating oil is near an all-time high but hey you can play Border Tsar Tom Homan in a video game".

The arcade section is just one example of how the Trump administration has increasingly incorporated video game culture into its political messaging on social media.

In October 2025, the official White House X account drew criticism for posting an AI-generated picture of President Trump , external in a suit from the video game Halo.

Meanwhile on 6 March it posted a video which mixed footage of US military strikes in Iran with film and TV clips, as well a clip from Halo's protagonist Master Chief saying "finishing this fight".

The post was condemned by the Master Chief voice actor Steve Downes in a now-deleted tweet which called for "the producers of this disgusting and juvenile war porn" to remove his voice from the video.

The Pokémon Company International also criticised the White House's use of its imagery in March, when it included a tiny version of the popular character Pikachu in a meme posted online with the phrase "Make America Great Again".
