body.zh: 白宫在其网站上下架了一款名为“Build The Wall”的俄罗斯方块风格游戏，几天前俄罗斯方块公司对其使用该游戏的相似性表示担忧。 这款游戏要求玩家堆叠积木来建造一堵墙以“保护边境”，这是白宫网站上出现的五款街机游戏之一。 9 月 4 日，X 上的俄罗斯方块官方账户对外发布消息称，该公司“没有参与游戏的创作”，并且“非常严肃地对待侵犯版权”。 白宫尚未回应 BBC 的置评请求，也没有给出删除的官方理由。 该公司在对该游戏的最初回应中表示：“在俄罗斯方块，我们相信联系的力量，并将人们团结在一起，而不是分裂他们。” “致我们世界各地的粉丝：我们爱你们，我们看到你们，我们很感激你们来到我们的社区。” 俄罗斯方块公司此前曾成功起诉侵犯其版权的公司，并于 2012 年与 iPhone 游戏 Mino 的制造商达成和解，并支付了一笔未公开的费用，该公司声称这款游戏窃取了积木游戏的外观和感觉。 其他四款街机游戏仍然保留在白宫网站的迷你游戏部分。 《Flappy Bill》是 2013 年热门游戏《Flappy Bird》的翻版，游戏中玩家驾驶一只秃鹰，躲避国家广场上的纪念碑。 与此同时，在《Rio Run》中，玩家必须“沿河巡逻”，其玩法让人想起经典手机游戏《贪吃蛇》。 当玩家跑到地图边缘时，“驱逐”数字会显示玩家能够抓住多少人。 这些游戏引起了政界人士的批评，康涅狄格州民主党州参议员马特·莱瑟(Matt Lesser)在推特上对外表示：“取暖油接近历史最高水平，但嘿，你可以在电子游戏中扮演边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼(Tom Homan)”。 街机部分只是特朗普政府如何越来越多地将视频游戏文化纳入其社交媒体政治信息的一个例子。 2025 年 10 月，White House X 官方账户因发布人工智能生成的特朗普总统照片而受到批评，照片中穿着电子游戏《光环》中的套装。 与此同时，3月6日，它发布了一段视频，将美国对伊朗的军事打击镜头与电影和电视剪辑混合在一起，以及《光环》主角士官长说“结束这场战斗”的剪辑。 士官长配音演员史蒂夫·唐斯（Steve Downes）在一条现已删除的推文中谴责了这篇帖子，呼吁“这部恶心的青少年战争色情片的制作者”从视频中删除他的声音。 神奇宝贝国际公司还批评了白宫在三月份使用其图像的行为，当时该公司在网上发布的一条表情包中加入了流行角色皮卡丘的小版本，并附有“让美国再次伟大”的短语。 报名参加我们的...

reflection.en: The game's premise, to 'build a wall' using a familiar stacking mechanic, inadvertently echoed the ancient story of Babel. There, human ambition to construct a unified monument led to divine intervention and linguistic division. This story reminds us that even in digital play, our attempts to build barriers can reflect a deeper human impulse toward...
reflection.zh: 这款游戏以“建造一堵墙”为主题，并采用了熟悉的堆叠机制，无意中呼应了古代巴别塔的故事。在那里，人类建造统一纪念碑的野心导致了神的干预和语言的分裂。这个故事提醒我们，即使在数字游戏中，我们试图建造障碍物的行为也可能反映出一种更深层的人类分裂冲动，而非连接。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Can mining gold be sustainable?
title.zh: 淘金可以可持续吗？

summary.en: In Madre de Dios, Peru, gold mining is a major source of livelihood for thousands, but it also causes significant environmental damage to the Amazon through mercury pollution and deforestation. A project in La Pampa is experimenting with mercury-free technologies to produce 'clean gold,' facing challenges like...
summary.zh: 在秘鲁的 Madre de Dios，淘金是数千人重要的生计来源，但它也通过汞污染和森林砍伐对亚马逊造成了严重的环境破坏。La Pampa 的一个项目正在试验无汞技术以生产“清洁黄金”，但面临暴力、非正规经济和政府支持不足等挑战。

body.en: In Madre de Dios, Peru, gold mining is deeply intertwined with the lives and livelihoods of thousands of people. But the industry is also leaving a heavy mark on the Amazon, with mercury pollution and deforestation reshaping one of the world’s most biodiverse forests. In La Pampa, an area known for gold mining, a formalized artisanal mining operation is attempting to find a different path. By using mercury-free technologies, the project aims to show that small-scale mining can produce “clean gold.” But making that transition is far from simple. The operation faces violence, informal economies, bureaucratic obstacles and limited government support. Through the stories of miners, workers and local businesses, the film looks at the challenges of moving toward more responsible mining in a region where environmental protection and economic survival are deeply connected. This video is supported by the Amazon Film Grant, as part of the One World Media Fellowship.This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在秘鲁马德雷德迪奥斯，金矿开采与成千上万人的生活和生计紧密相连。但该行业也给亚马逊留下了沉重的印记，汞污染和森林砍伐重塑了世界上生物多样性最丰富的森林之一。在以金矿开采闻名的拉潘帕地区，正规化的手工采矿作业正在试图寻找一条不同的道路。通过使用无汞技术，该项目旨在证明小规模采矿可以生产“清洁黄金”。但实现这一转变远非简单。该行动面临暴力、非正规经济、官僚障碍和有限的政府支持。影片通过矿工、工人和当地企业的故事，探讨了在环境保护和经济生存紧密相连的地区迈向更负责任的采矿业所面临的挑战。该视频由亚马逊电影补助金支持，作为同一个世界媒体奖学金的一部分。本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The pursuit of gold in Peru's Madre de Dios region has led to the degradation of the Amazon, a vital part of God's creation. This story calls us to consider how our economic activities impact the natural world, reminding us of our responsibility to be stewards of the earth. May we seek ways to live and work that honor and preserve the beauty and...
reflection.zh: 在秘鲁 Madre de Dios 地区对黄金的追求导致了亚马逊的退化，这是上帝创造物的重要组成部分。这个故事促使我们思考我们的经济活动如何影响自然世界，提醒我们有责任成为地球的管家。愿我们寻求以荣耀和保护创造之美和生物多样性的方式生活和工作。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Week in wildlife: a sea turtle hatchling, baby orangutans and flying ibises
title.zh: 本周野生动物：海龟幼崽、红毛猩猩宝宝和飞翔的朱鹭

summary.en: This week’s best wildlife photographs from around the world.
summary.zh: 本周来自世界各地的最佳野生动物照片。

reflection.en: The sheer diversity and intricate beauty of the natural world, from sea turtle hatchlings to flying ibises, serve as a constant testament to the Creator. Each creature, in its unique form and function, reveals something of Yahweh's power and divine character, inviting us to marvel at His handiwork. Even when we cannot see Him directly, the created order...
reflection.zh: 从海龟幼崽到飞翔的朱鹭，大自然千姿百态、精妙绝伦的美丽，不断地见证着创造主。每一个生物，以其独特的形态和功能，都揭示了雅伟的部分大能和神圣品格，邀请我们惊叹于祂的杰作。 即使我们无法直接看见祂，受造界也雄辩地诉说着。周围的世界并非偶然，而是那位慈爱且能力无限的上帝，其精心设计和奇妙的表达。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: More and more animals are moving into our homes as theirs get chopped down and dug up | First Dog on the Moon
title.zh: 随着家园被砍伐和挖掘，越来越多的动物搬进我们的家园 | 第一次狗在月球上

summary.en: The echidna in the pantry, the koala in the boudoir, the skink in the sink. All true! This cartoon illustrates the increasing overlap between wildlife habitats and human living spaces, as animals are displaced by development.
summary.zh: 橱柜里的针鼹，卧室里的考拉，水槽里的石龙子。都是真的！这幅漫画描绘了野生动物栖息地与人类生活空间日益重叠的景象，因为动物们因开发而被驱赶。

reflection.en: As human development encroaches on natural habitats, creatures like echidnas and koalas are finding their way into our homes. This phenomenon, while disruptive, is a stark reminder of the rich biodiversity Yahweh has created and the delicate balance of ecosystems that are now under pressure. It calls us to consider our role as stewards of creation.
reflection.zh: 随着人类开发活动侵占自然栖息地，针鼹和考拉等生物正闯入我们的家园。这种现象虽然令人不安，却也鲜明地提醒我们雅伟所创造的丰富生物多样性，以及如今承受压力的脆弱生态平衡。它呼唤我们反思作为受造界管家所扮演的角色。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Homes for sale in a national park in England – in pictures
title.zh: 英格兰国家公园内的待售房屋——图集

summary.en: From an energy-efficient bungalow in the South Downs to a historic chapel in Northumberland.
summary.zh: 从南唐斯一栋节能环保的平房到诺森伯兰一处历史悠久的教堂。

reflection.en: This collection of images showcases homes nestled within England's national parks, reminding us that these beautiful landscapes are entrusted to human care. As stewards, we are called to manage these resources responsibly, recognizing that their ultimate ownership rests with the Creator.
reflection.zh: 这组图片展示了坐落于英格兰国家公园内的房屋，提醒我们这些美丽的风景被托付给人类照管。作为管家，我们被呼召要负责任地管理这些资源，认识到它们最终的所有权属于创造主。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Iceland to submit bill that could ban whaling in its waters
title.zh: 冰岛将提交禁止在其水域捕鲸的法案

summary.en: Iceland is set to introduce legislation in February 2027 that could permanently prohibit whaling within its territorial waters. This move would leave Norway and Japan as the only nations permitting commercial whaling. The practice has faced intense scrutiny since a 2023 report revealed that harpooned whales can take...
summary.zh: 冰岛将于2027年2月提交一项法案，可能永久禁止在其领海内捕鲸。此举将使挪威和日本成为仅有的两个允许商业捕鲸的国家。自2023年一份政府委托报告发现被鱼叉刺中的鲸鱼需要长达两小时才能死亡以来，捕鲸行为一直受到严格审查，该报告导致当年捕鲸活动被暂时中止。

body.en: The country is one of just three that still permits commercial whaling, while its government has faced mounting pressure to ban the practice Iceland will submit a bill in February 2027 which could permanently ban whaling in its waters, a move that would leave Norway and Japan as the only two countries to permit commercial whaling. Whaling in Iceland has been put under intense scrutiny since a government-commissioned report was published in 2023 that found harpooned whales took two hours to die. The report led to a temporary suspension of the hunt that year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该国是仍然允许商业捕鲸的三个国家之一，而其政府面临着越来越大的禁止这种做法的压力。冰岛将于 2027 年 2 月提交一项法案，该法案可能永久禁止在其水域内捕鲸，此举将使挪威和日本成为仅有的两个允许商业捕鲸的国家。自 2023 年政府委托发布的一份报告发现鲸鱼被鱼叉刺中两小时后死亡以来，冰岛的捕鲸活动一直受到严格审查。该报告导致当年的狩猎活动暂时停止。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Iceland's potential ban on whaling, spurred by reports of prolonged suffering for harpooned whales, reflects a growing global conscience regarding animal welfare. This action echoes the call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,' extending compassion to creatures who endure immense pain.
reflection.zh: 冰岛可能禁止捕鲸，这源于关于被鱼叉刺中的鲸鱼遭受长期痛苦的报告，这反映了全球日益增长的对动物福利的关注。这一行动呼应了为“不能自己说话的人说话”的呼召，将同情心延伸到承受巨大痛苦的生灵。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tasmanian devils lived alongside humans in Pilbara for millennia, Juukan Gorge fossils reveal
title.zh: 塔斯马尼亚恶魔与人类在皮尔巴拉地区共同生活了数千年，朱坎峡谷化石揭示

summary.en: Fossils unearthed at Juukan Gorge, ranging from 7,000 to 46,000 years old, reveal that Tasmanian devils coexisted with humans in Western Australia's Pilbara region for tens of thousands of years. Evidence suggests these marsupials, now only found in Tasmania, may have become reliant on humans for scavenging, having...
summary.zh: 在朱坎峡谷出土的化石显示，塔斯马尼亚恶魔在西澳大利亚皮尔巴拉地区与人类共同生活了数万年，这些化石的年代从7000年到46000年前不等。证据表明，这些如今仅存于塔斯马尼亚的有袋类动物可能曾依赖人类的 the scavenging，它们在大约3200年前在澳大利亚大陆灭绝。

body.en: Researchers find fossils ranging from 7,000 years to 46,000 years old showing evidence that devils may have become reliant on humans for scavenging Tasmanian devils lived alongside humans in Western Australia’s Pilbara region for tens of thousands of years, according to fossils uncovered at Juukan Gorge. These squat and sable marsupials, now restricted to Tasmania, were once abundant right across Australia, becoming extinct on the mainland about 3,200 years ago. Continue reading...
body.zh: 根据在尤坎峡谷发现的化石，研究人员发现了距今 7,000 年前到 46,000 年前的化石，这些证据表明袋獾可能已经开始依赖人类来捕食，塔斯马尼亚袋獾在西澳大利亚皮尔巴拉地区与人类一起生活了数万年。这些矮胖和黑貂有袋动物现在仅限于塔斯马尼亚岛，它们曾经在澳大利亚各地大量存在，但大约 3,200 年前在大陆灭绝。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Juukan Gorge fossils offer a glimpse into a deep past, revealing the ancient coexistence of humans and Tasmanian devils. This discovery reminds us that the Earth holds countless stories within its layers, waiting to be uncovered through patient observation and scientific inquiry. Such findings invite wonder at the intricate tapestry of life and the...
reflection.zh: 朱坎峡谷的化石让我们得以一窥遥远的过去，揭示了人类与塔斯马尼亚恶魔古老的共存。这一发现提醒我们，大地在其层层叠叠的岩石中蕴藏着无数的故事，等待着通过耐心观察和科学探索而被揭开。这些发现引人对生命错综复杂的织锦以及创造本身所蕴含的智慧发出赞叹。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Javan rhinos survive eruption in Indonesia, but single habitat leaves species vulnerable
title.zh: 爪哇犀牛在印尼喷发中幸存，但单一栖息地使该物种易受攻击

summary.en: Indonesia’s critically endangered Javan rhinos appear to be safe despite an ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau near their last remaining habitat, conservation authorities said. Ardi Andono, head of Ujung Kulon National Park, home to the world’s only wild population of Javan rhinoceros (Rhinoceros sondaicus), said...
summary.zh: 印尼极度濒危的爪哇犀牛在附近的安纳克喀拉喀托火山持续喷发的情况下似乎安然无恙，这是它们仅存的栖息地。爪哇犀牛（Rhinoceros sondaicus）是世界上唯一野外种群的所在地，乌戎库隆国家公园的负责人 Ardi Andono 于 9 月 7 日表示，犀牛的栖息地受到 9 月 4...

body.en: Indonesia’s critically endangered Javan rhinos appear to be safe despite an ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau near their last remaining habitat, conservation authorities said. Ardi Andono, head of Ujung Kulon National Park, home to the world’s only wild population of Javan rhinos (Rhinoceros sondaicus), said on Sept. 7 that the rhinos’ habitat had been minimally affected by vibrations and noise from Anak Krakatau, which began erupting on Sept. 4. Mount Anak Krakatau, an active volcanic island in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra, lies about 50 kilometers (30 miles) from the park on Java’s southwestern tip, and its recent eruption sent ash across parts of both islands, disrupting air travel and prompting some schools and fishing activities to halt. “The Javan rhinos remained safe and still appear normal,” Ardi told Mongabay in a WhatsApp message, adding that his park rangers continue to stand on guard. A female calf of the Javan rhinoceros with her mother. Image courtesy of the Indonesian Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The number of Javan rhinos remaining in the wild is disputed. Save the Rhino, a conservation group, estimates there are about 50, while Indonesia’s forestry ministry puts the population at 87 to 100. The government’s figures have previously faced scrutiny after a 2023 investigation by Indonesian environmental group Auriga Nusantara found that rhinos not seen by camera traps for years, including some later confirmed dead, were still included in official counts. The discrepancy is significant because the species is confined to Ujung Kulon…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 保护当局表示，尽管印度尼西亚极度濒危的爪哇犀牛最后的栖息地附近阿纳克喀拉喀托火山正在喷发，但它们似乎是安全的。乌戎库隆国家公园 (Ujung Kulon National Park) 是世界上唯一的野生爪哇犀牛 (Rhinoceros sondaicus) 的栖息地，乌戎库隆国家公园 (Ujung Kulon National Park) 的负责人阿迪·安多诺 (Ardi Andono) 9 月 7 日表示，犀牛栖息地受到 9 月 4 日开始喷发的阿纳克喀拉喀托火山 (Anak Krakatau) 振动和噪音的影响很小。距离爪哇岛西南端公园 50 公里（31 英里），火山最近的喷发使火山灰席卷了两个岛屿的部分地区，扰乱了航空旅行，并导致一些学校和捕鱼活动停止。阿尔迪在 WhatsApp 消息中告诉 Mongabay：“爪哇犀牛仍然安全，而且看起来仍然正常。”他补充说，他的公园护林员继续保持警惕。一只母爪哇犀牛和她的母亲。图片由环境和林业部提供。野生爪哇犀牛的数量存在争议。保护组织“拯救犀牛”估计数量约为 50 头，而印度尼西亚林业部估计其数量为 87 至 100 头。印尼环保组织 Auriga Nusantara 2023 年的一项调查发现，多年来没有被摄像机捕捉到的犀牛（包括一些后来确认死亡的犀牛）仍然被纳入官方统计数字，政府的数字此前曾受到审查。这种差异很显着，因为该物种仅限于乌戎库隆国家公园……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: Even as Mount Anak Krakatau erupts nearby, the Javan rhinos in Ujung Kulon National Park have, for now, been spared the worst. This precarious survival, with their entire species confined to one vulnerable habitat, echoes the ancient cry for refuge. In times of natural upheaval and existential threat, we too can find solace in the One who is our...
reflection.zh: 即使附近的安纳克喀拉喀托火山正在喷发，乌戎库隆国家公园的爪哇犀牛目前也已幸免于难。这种岌岌可危的生存状况，整个物种仅限于一个脆弱的栖息地，呼应了古老的避难呼求。在自然动荡和生存威胁的时刻，我们也能在那位时刻帮助我们的神那里找到安慰。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Court rules residents of a US city don’t have a constitutional right to lead-free water
title.zh: 法院裁定美国一城市居民无权获得无铅饮用水

summary.en: A U.S. federal court has ruled that residents of Jackson, Mississippi, do not possess a constitutional right to lead-free drinking water or truthful information from public officials. The case involved allegations that the city provided contaminated water and then misled residents about its safety.
summary.zh: 美国一家联邦法院裁定，密西西比州杰克逊市的居民无权获得无铅饮用水或来自政府官员的真实信息。此案涉及居民指控该市提供了受污染的水，随后又就其安全性误导居民。

body.en: A U.S. federal court recently ruled that residents of Jackson, Mississippi, don’t have a constitutional right to truthful information from public officials, nor the right to municipal drinking water that is free of lead, a neurotoxin. “The Constitution does not provide redress for every governmental wrongdoing,” Judge Kurt D. Engelhardt of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, who was appointed by U.S. President Donald Trump, wrote in the majority opinion. The case was brought by a group of Jackson residents in 2022 who alleged that the city allowed lead to enter the municipal water system and then lied to residents saying the water was safe, though they knew it was not. “Knowing what is in our water is fundamental to protecting public health,” Caroline Leary, general counsel at the U.S.-based nonprofit Environmental Working Group, told Mongabay by email. Jackson is home to roughly 150,000 people. Nearly a quarter of them are children under 18 who are particularly vulnerable to the potentially life-long toxic impacts of lead exposure including seizures, lowered IQ, impaired brain development and even death. The plaintiffs alleged that several of their children have been diagnosed with lead poisoning and now require special educational, medical, sociological, occupational and disability services. The plaintiffs also argued that exposure to contaminated water and the failure to be informed about the risks violated their 14th amendment due process right to bodily integrity. A November 2025 ruling by a three-judge panel of the Fifth U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals allowed…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 美国联邦法院最近裁定，密西西比州杰克逊市的居民没有宪法赋予的从公职人员处获得真实信息的权利，也没有获得不含铅（一种神经毒素）的市政饮用水的权利。 “宪法并没有为政府的每一项不当行为提供补救措施，”由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普任命的美国第五巡回上诉法院法官库尔特·D·恩格尔哈特在多数意见中写道。该案由一群杰克逊居民于 2022 年提起，他们声称该市允许铅进入市政供水系统，然后向居民撒谎说水是安全的，尽管他们知道事实并非如此。 “了解水中的成分对于保护公众健康至关重要，”美国非营利环境工作组总法律顾问卡罗琳·利里 (Caroline Leary) 通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。杰克逊居住着大约 150,000 人。其中近四分之一是 18 岁以下的儿童，他们特别容易受到铅接触带来的潜在终生毒性影响，包括癫痫发作、智商降低、大脑发育受损甚至死亡。原告声称，他们的几个孩子被诊断出铅中毒，现在需要特殊教育、医疗、社会学、职业和残疾服务。原告还辩称，接触受污染的水和未告知风险违反了第 14 条修正案中关于身体完整性的正当程序权。美国第五巡回上诉法院的三名法官小组于 2025 年 11 月做出的​​裁决允许……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The court's decision in Jackson, Mississippi, leaves residents without a guaranteed right to safe water or honest communication from their leaders. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless words, urging us to seek justice, show mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that seem absent in this legal outcome.
reflection.zh: 美国密西西比州杰克逊市的法院判决，使得居民在获得安全饮用水或政府官员的诚实沟通方面，没有宪法保障的权利。这一情况令人想起先知弥迦永恒的话语，他敦促我们要寻求公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行——这些原则似乎在这项法律裁决中缺失了。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Japan deploys equipment to Indonesia’s Borneo to help fight wildfires causing toxic haze
title.zh: 日本向印尼婆罗洲部署设备以帮助扑灭造成有毒烟雾的野火

summary.en: A Japanese military transport ship arrived in Borneo on Thursday as part of a disaster relief mission to help fight wildfires in Indonesia. These fires are causing a toxic haze that affects people's health in other countries. Japan deployed 300 crew members, the landing ship JS Kunisaki, and three CH-47 helicopters....
summary.zh: 周四，一艘日本军用运输船抵达婆罗洲，作为一项救灾任务的一部分，以帮助扑灭印尼的野火。这些火灾造成了有毒烟雾，影响了其他国家人民的健康。日本部署了300名船员、登陆舰“国崎号”和三架CH-47直升机。这标志着日本自卫队首次在海外执行灭火任务。

body.en: MEMPAWAH, Indonesia (AP) — A Japanese military transport ship docked on the island of Borneo on Thursday as part of a disaster relief mission to help fight wildfires in Indonesia that are causing a toxic haze impacting people’s health in other countries. Japan deployed 300 crew members, landing ship JS Kunisaki and three CH-47 helicopters, which arrived in Kalimantan on the island of Borneo. The mission in Indonesia marked the first known overseas firefighting operation carried out by the Japan Self-Defense Forces, or JSDF. “To this end, we will learn from the Indonesian military’s operational experience and work in coordination and cooperation with them, striving to ensure that the Indonesian people can lead stable lives as soon as possible,” Col. Syunji Nakahara, the commander of the disaster relief activities, said at a port in Mempawah district. Japan and Indonesia have been also increasingly strengthening their military cooperation ties, with the two sides discussing the Japanese sale of its used destroyers. Indonesia has been plagued by forest and land fires for decades, but an intensifying El Niño pattern this year and a prolonged dry season worsened the impact of the fires. Toxic haze and smoke have caused a health crisis in neighboring countries. The smoke has drifted as far as the Philippines, more than 800 kilometers (500 miles) away, and breached Malaysia’s emergency-level threshold for air pollution, forcing authorities to declare an emergency last week in a town in Sarawak state on Borneo. The air pollution has also affected several areas on the island of Sumatra, forcing…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚曼帕瓦（美联社）——周四，一艘日本军用运输船停靠在婆罗洲岛，这是一项救灾任务的一部分，目的是帮助扑灭印度尼西亚的野火，这场野火造成的有毒雾霾影响了其他国家的人们的健康。日本部署了300名船员、JS国东登陆舰和三架CH-47直升机，抵达婆罗洲岛加里曼丹。印度尼西亚的这次任务标志着日本自卫队（JSDF）执行的首次海外消防行动。 “为此，我们将学习印尼军方的行动经验，并与他们协调配合，努力确保印尼人民尽快过上稳定的生活，”救灾活动指挥官中原俊二上校在曼帕瓦区的一个港口表示。日本和印度尼西亚也日益加强军事合作关系，双方讨论了日本出售其二手驱逐舰的问题。印度尼西亚几十年来一直受到森林和土地火灾的困扰，但今年厄尔尼诺现象的加剧和旱季的延长加剧了火灾的影响。有毒雾霾和烟雾已在邻国造成健康危机。烟雾飘到了800多公里（500英里）外的菲律宾，并突破了马来西亚空气污染的紧急级别阈值，迫使当局上周宣布婆罗洲沙捞越州的一个城镇进入紧急状态。空气污染还影响了苏门答腊岛的多个地区，迫使……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The arrival of Japanese aid in Indonesia to combat devastating wildfires highlights a global responsibility for environmental stewardship. The toxic haze from these fires affects health far beyond borders, reminding us that the well-being of creation is interconnected. May this cooperative effort bring relief and healing to the land and its people.
reflection.zh: 日本援助抵达印尼以扑灭毁灭性的野火，这凸显了全球对环境管理的责任。这些火灾产生的有毒烟雾影响范围远远超出国界，提醒我们受造物的福祉是相互关联的。愿此次合作努力为这片土地及其人民带来缓解和治愈。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Amazon Fund grantees fear a new funding freeze after Brazil’s election
title.zh: 亚马逊基金受益者担心巴西大选后资金再次冻结

summary.en: The Amazon Fund has been instrumental in Brazil achieving a decade-low in deforestation. However, conservationists are concerned that a change in government following the election could lead to a significant reversal of environmental policies and a halt in funding.
summary.zh: 亚马逊基金在帮助巴西实现十年内森林砍伐率最低方面发挥了重要作用。然而，环保主义者担心大选后的政府更迭可能导致环境政策的重大 U ターン，并停止相关资金的拨付。

body.en: In 2018, the Amazon Fund chose to support a project in the Brazilian Amazon helping 614 families engaged in babassu coconut breaking in 11 traditional communities. Encroached on by soy farming and cattle ranching, the families in the state of Tocantins would receive financial support to keep producing oil, flour and handicrafts from this unique Amazonian fruit while reinforcing their role as guardians of the forest. But the promise was short-lived. Jair Bolsonaro took office as Brazil’s president in January 2019, and immediately set his far-right agenda to work dismantling the country’s environmental frameworks and freezing the Amazon Fund’s contributions. The fund was created in 2008, with initial donations from Norway and Germany to reward Brazil for its success in reducing Amazonian deforestation. Over the last 18 years, it has benefited 288,000 people and supported 144 projects in forest restoration, sustainable production, firefighting, inspections and monitoring of environmental crimes, and Indigenous issues. “It is one of the world’s leading funds for investing in projects that protect the rainforest,” said Rayandra Araújo, climate policy specialist at Talanoa, a Brazilian climate think tank. When Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva replaced Bolsonaro, returning to the presidency in January 2023, he revived the Amazon Fund’s operations. The babassu coconut breaker project, led by the group Alternatives for Small-Scale Farming in Tocantins (APA-TO), was again considered and began implementation in April 2026. “The project was on hold for almost 10 years,” says Selma Yuki Ishii, the project coordinator and technical director at APA-TO. With Lula,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 2018年，亚马逊基金选择支持巴西亚马逊地区的一个项目，帮助11个传统社区的614个家庭从事巴巴苏椰子的开发。托坎廷斯州的家庭受到大豆种植和养牛业的侵占，将获得财政支持，继续用这种独特的亚马逊水果生产石油、面粉和手工艺品，同时加强他们作为森林守护者的作用。但这个承诺是短暂的。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 于 2019 年 1 月就任巴西总统，并立即制定了极右翼议程，致力于拆除该国的环境框架并冻结亚马逊基金的捐款。该基金成立于 2008 年，最初由挪威和德国捐款，用于奖励巴西在减少亚马逊森林砍伐方面取得的成功。过去18年来，它已使288,000人受益，并支持了144个项目，涉及森林恢复、可持续生产、消防、环境犯罪检查和监测以及原住民问题。巴西气候智库塔拉诺阿的气候政策专家 Rayandra Araújo 表示：“它是世界领先的雨林保护项目投资基金之一。”当路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦 (Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva) 接替博尔索纳罗于 2023 年 1 月重新担任总统时，他恢复了亚马逊基金的运营。由托坎廷斯小规模农业替代方案组织 (APA-TO) 领导的巴巴苏椰子破碎机项目再次得到考虑，并于 2026 年 4 月开始实施。APA-TO 的项目协调员兼技术总监 Selma Yuki Ishii 表示：“该项目被搁置了近 10 年。”与卢拉，……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Amazon Fund's success in reducing deforestation over ten years is a testament to dedicated efforts. Yet, the prospect of a policy reversal following Brazil's election raises concerns for conservationists and the 614 families who benefited from its support. This situation underscores the fragility of progress when leadership priorities shift away from...
reflection.zh: 亚马逊基金在十年内减少森林砍伐的成功是其不懈努力的证明。然而，巴西大选后政策可能发生 U ターン的前景，令环保人士和曾受益于该基金的 614 个家庭感到担忧。这种情况凸显了当领导层的优先事项偏离管理地球时，进展是多么脆弱。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: NHS reports busiest ever summer as heatwaves drive up hospital admissions
title.zh: 英国国民保健署报告夏季最繁忙，热浪导致住院人数增加

summary.en: Record demand for A&E units, ambulance services, and NHS 111 indicates that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on health, according to experts. The NHS experienced its most intense strain ever during the summer's five heatwaves, with warnings that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on human...
summary.zh: 根据专家的说法，急诊室、救护车服务和NHS 111的创纪录需求表明，极端高温正对健康产生前所未有的影响。在夏季的五次热浪期间，英国国民保健署（NHS）承受了有史以来最严重的压力，并有警告称极端高温正对人类健康产生前所未有的影响。英格兰的急诊室、救护车服务和NHS...

body.en: Record demand for A&E units, ambulance services and NHS 111 shows extreme heat having unprecedented impact on health, experts say The NHS came under its most intense strain ever as a result of the summer’s five heatwaves, amid warnings that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on human health. A&E units, ambulance services and the NHS 111 telephone advice line all experienced record demand for their services in England in June, July and August as Britain experienced record temperatures. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对急症室、救护车服务和 NHS 111 的创纪录需求表明，极端高温对健康产生了前所未有的影响。专家表示，由于夏季的五次热浪，国民医疗服务体系 (NHS) 承受了有史以来最严重的压力，同时警告极端高温对人类健康产生了前所未有的影响。 6 月、7 月和 8 月，英国经历创纪录的气温，急症室、救护车服务和 NHS 111 电话咨询热线的服务需求均创历史新高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The intense summer heatwaves pushed the NHS to its breaking point, with record demand on emergency services. This immense strain speaks to a collective exhaustion, a feeling of being overwhelmed by the elements. Yet, even in such times of depletion, the promise remains that those who wait upon Yahweh will find their strength renewed, able to soar on wings...
reflection.zh: 夏季的极端热浪使英国国民保健署（NHS）不堪重负，急诊服务需求创下历史新高。这种巨大的压力反映了一种集体的疲惫感，一种被自然界压垮的感觉。然而，即使在如此耗竭的时刻，仍然有应许：那等候雅伟的，必得着力量更新，能如鹰展翅上腾，准备好面对接下来的挑战。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Flamingo Revolution: The Albanians protesting to bring down the elites – video
title.zh: 火烈鸟革命：阿尔巴尼亚人抗议推翻精英——视频

summary.en: Thousands of protesters are flooding the streets of Tirana in the biggest unrest Albania has seen since the collapse of communism. It began as the “flamingo revolution”, sparked by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump’s plans for a luxury mega-resort on a public nature reserve island. But the protests have since grown into...
summary.zh: 数千名抗议者涌入地拉那街头，这是自共产主义垮台以来阿尔巴尼亚发生的最大规模的动荡。最初被称为“火烈鸟革命”，起因是贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普计划在公共自然保护岛上开发豪华大型度假村。但抗议活动随后演变成对总理埃迪·拉马政府的更广泛挑战，该政府被指控将阿尔巴尼亚海岸线卖给精英阶层。马修·卡塞尔前往阿尔巴尼亚，观察一个...

body.en: Thousands of protesters are flooding the streets of Tirana in the biggest unrest Albania has seen since the collapse of communism. It began as the “flamingo revolution”, sparked by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump’s plans for a luxury mega-resort on a public nature reserve island. But the protests have since grown into a wider challenge to Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government, which is accused of selling off Albania’s coastline to the elites. Matthew Cassel travels to Albania to see how an environmental fight over one island has escalated into a political battle over the country’s future. Continue reading...
body.zh: 数千名抗议者涌上地拉那街头，这是阿尔巴尼亚自共产主义崩溃以来最大规模的骚乱。它始于“火烈鸟革命”，由贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普在公共自然保护区岛上建造豪华大型度假村的计划引发。但抗议活动此后已发展成为对总理埃迪·拉马政府的更广泛挑战，该政府被指控将阿尔巴尼亚的海岸线出卖给精英。马修·卡塞尔前往阿尔巴尼亚，了解围绕一个岛屿的环境斗争如何升级为影响该国未来的政治斗争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The "flamingo revolution" in Albania shows how environmental concerns can ignite broader calls for justice and accountability. When public lands and natural beauty are threatened by elite interests, ordinary citizens can find their voice. May we, like these protesters, demand that justice and righteousness flow like a never-ending stream, shaping the future...
reflection.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚的“火烈鸟革命”表明，环境问题如何能点燃更广泛的对公正和问责的呼声。当公共土地和自然美景受到精英利益的威胁时，普通公民可以发出自己的声音。愿我们像这些抗议者一样，要求公正和公义如江河滔滔，塑造我们社区和国家的未来。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Sargassum Superbloom: Seaweed Scourge or Ecological Boon?
title.zh: 马尾藻超量繁殖：海藻灾害还是生态福音？

summary.en: A massive bloom of sargassum seaweed, stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, is inundating beaches and harming coastal wildlife. However, scientists have found that this floating algae supports a diverse array of marine life, leading some to advocate for its protection.
summary.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾的大规模马尾藻繁殖，正淹没海滩并危害沿海野生动物。然而，科学家发现这种漂浮的海藻支撑着各种各样的海洋生物，这使得一些人开始呼吁保护它。

body.en:
Stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, a massive bloom of sargassum seaweed is swamping beaches and killing coastal wildlife. But scientists have discovered the floating algae also shelters a vast array of ocean creatures, and some are now calling for its protection.

Many of America’s favorite beaches in Florida and the Caribbean have been piled high with foul-smelling seaweed again this summer, often in record amounts. What disappointed tourists may not know is that the inundations, which also smother coral reefs, mangroves, and seagrasses, are just the most visible sign of a vast new marine ecosystem — an expanse of floating sargassum that since 2011 has seemingly come from nowhere to spread in a 5,500-mile-long belt from Mexico to West Africa and Florida to Brazil.

The dense mats of offshore weed grow up to 20 feet thick, and this summer reached a record weight of 38 million metric tons — more than the total weight of all Americans.

The seaweed scourge is wrecking coastal economies in countries heavily dependent on tourism and fishing. The coastlines of 30 countries across the Caribbean and beyond are being visited by the brown mats piling up on beaches, where the weed decomposes, releasing gases such as hydrogen sulfide, with its distinctive rotten-egg smell, and ammonia, which trigger asthma attacks and exacerbate other respiratory conditions. Thousands of victims have been reported by doctors in the Caribbean, especially among workers clearing beaches.

The weed also blocks water intakes and prevents fishers from taking their boats to sea, as well as clogging their nets, engines, and propellers. It has caused mass deaths of marine life on coastlines, while preventing sea turtles from laying their eggs on beaches and blocking hatchlings trying to return to the ocean. The weed also accumulates heavy metals such as arsenic, which leaches out as the weed decomposes on land and can poison water supplies.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

But, while acknowledging its onshore harms, some researchers are now recognizing the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt as a significant new habitat for marine life in the open ocean, and a valuable carbon sink for the planet. According to Jonathan Jung, a marine ecologist at the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry in Mainz, Germany, the weed and its growing army of inhabitants now form “the largest interconnected floating biome on Earth.”

Sargassum seaweed in the Atlantic was once mostly confined to the Sargasso Sea, an area of sluggish waters off Bermuda largely cut off from the rest of the ocean by rotating ocean currents. It has been well-known to mariners since Christopher Columbus reported sailing through “so much grass that it looked like the...
body.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾，大量的马尾藻海藻正在淹没海滩并杀死沿海野生动物。但科学家发现，这些漂浮的藻类也为大量海洋生物提供了庇护，一些海洋生物现在呼吁保护它们。 今年夏天，美国佛罗里达州和加勒比海地区许多最受欢迎的海滩再次堆满了恶臭的海藻，数量往往达到创纪录的水平。失望的游客可能不知道的是，洪水也淹没了珊瑚礁、红树林和海草，而这只是一个巨大的新海洋生态系统最明显的标志——自 2011 年以来，一大片漂浮的马尾藻似乎不知从何而来，在从墨西哥到西非、从佛罗里达到巴西的 5,500 英里长的带上蔓延。 近海杂草丛生，厚度可达 20 英尺，今年夏天的重量达到创纪录的 3800 万吨——超过了所有美国人的总重量。 海藻祸害正在破坏严重依赖旅游业和渔业的国家的沿海经济。加勒比海及其他地区30个国家的海岸线正被堆积在海滩上的棕色垫子所覆盖，这些杂草在海滩上分解，释放出硫化氢等气体，具有独特的臭鸡蛋味，还有氨气，会引发哮喘发作并加剧其他呼吸道疾病。加勒比地区的医生报告了数千人的受害者，特别是清理海滩的工人。 这种杂草还会阻塞进水口，阻止渔民将船出海，并堵塞渔网、发动机和螺旋桨。它导致海岸线海洋生物大量死亡，同时阻止海龟在海滩上产卵，并阻止试图返回海洋的幼龟。这种杂草还会积累砷等重金属，当杂草在陆地上分解时，砷会渗出，污染水源。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 但是，在承认其陆上危害的同时，一些研究人员现在认识到大大西洋马尾藻带是公海海洋生物的重要新栖息地，也是地球宝贵的碳汇。德国美因茨马克斯·普朗克化学研究所的海洋生态学家乔纳森·荣格表示，这种杂草及其不断增长的居民大军现在形成了“地球上最大的相互关联的漂浮生物群落”。 大西洋中的马尾藻海藻曾经主要局限于马尾藻海，这是百慕大附近的一个缓慢水域，由于旋转洋流，基本上与海洋其他部分隔绝。自从克里斯托弗·哥伦布报道航行穿过“如此多的草，看起来就像……”以来，它就为水手们所熟知。

reflection.en: The vast expanse of sargassum seaweed, initially seen as a scourge, is revealing itself as a complex ecosystem teeming with life. This reminds us that even in what appears problematic, Yahweh's intricate design is at work, with creation itself bearing witness to His wisdom and power. As Romans 1:20 says, His invisible attributes are clearly perceived, being...
reflection.zh: 最初被视为灾难的马尾藻大片海藻，正逐渐显露出其作为复杂生态系统的面貌，其中充满了生命。这提醒我们，即使在看似有问题的事物中，雅伟精妙的设计也在运作，而祂的创造本身就见证了祂的智慧与大能。正如罗马书1:20所说，祂的永恒大能和神性，自从创造世界以来，藉着所造之物就可以晓得。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Country diary: A little garden mystery – why are the wood mice hoarding opium seeds? | Susie White
title.zh: 乡村日记：花园里的小谜团——为什么野老鼠要囤积罂粟籽？| 苏西·怀特

summary.en: Allendale, Northumberland: My late-flowering poppies have lit up the garden, and it’s not only me who’s taken an interest The opium poppies have now set seed, their leaves rattling like crisp packets, the vents beneath their pod lids open for the seeds to be scattered. Dotted...
summary.zh: 阿伦代尔，诺森伯兰郡：我园中晚开的罂粟花点亮了花园，而我对它们产生了兴趣，这并非我一人。如今，鸦片罂粟已结籽，叶子像塑料包装袋一样沙沙作响，荚盖下的开口散播着种子。在我的花坛中，在菜园里增添了高度， असतातferum...

body.en: Allendale, Northumberland: My late-flowering poppies have lit up the garden, and it’s not only me who’s taken an interest The opium poppies have now set seed, their leaves rattling like crisp packets, the vents beneath their pod lids open for the seeds to be scattered. Dotted throughout my flower borders, adding stature to the vegetable garden, Papaver somniferum is the breadseed poppy, its large, floppy petals unpredictable in colour: pale lilac, purple, pink or sometimes with fringed petals. The unexpected brings a freedom and a randomness to the garden. Those blue-grey seeds are sprinkled on bagels and bread, baked into cakes or ground as a thickener for curries, adding protein, plant fats and trace elements such as manganese. But in its unripe state this is the plant that gives opium, a two-sided drug, both medicinal and destructive as a sedative – its specific name somniferum means sleep-bringing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 诺森伯兰郡艾伦代尔：我的晚花罂粟照亮了花园，不仅仅是我感兴趣。罂粟现在已经结了种子，它们的叶子像薯片包一样嘎嘎作响，豆荚盖下面的通风口打开，让种子散落。罂粟（Papaver somniferum）点缀在我的花坛上，为菜园增添了姿彩，它是面包籽罂粟，它大而松软的花瓣颜色难以预测：淡紫丁香、紫色、粉红色或有时带有流苏花瓣。意想不到的事情给花园带来了自由和随意性。这些蓝灰色的种子撒在百吉饼和面包上，烘烤成蛋糕或磨碎作为咖喱的增稠剂，添加蛋白质、植物脂肪和锰等微量元素。但在未成熟的状态下，这种植物会产生鸦片，鸦片是一种双向药物，既具有药用性，又具有破坏性的镇静作用——它的具体名称“somniferum”的意思是“带来睡眠”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The garden, a small ecosystem, reveals the intricate workings of creation. Even the seemingly simple act of mice hoarding seeds points to a larger, interconnected web of life. All of creation, in its beauty and its cycles, groans and waits, a testament to its inherent design and its longing for completion.
reflection.zh: 花园，一个微小的生态系统，揭示了造物精妙的运作。即使是老鼠囤积种子的看似简单的行为，也指向一个更大、相互关联的生命网络。万物，在其美丽和循环中，一同叹息等待，证明了其固有的设计和对圆满的渴望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Chinese Industry Is Starting to Wean Off Fossil Fuels
title.zh: 中国工业开始摆脱化石燃料

summary.en: According to a new analysis, China's industrial sector is showing signs of moving away from fossil fuels by several key indicators. This includes new clean power generation exceeding demand growth and a decline in coal output, with several provinces experiencing reduced coal generation or a significant slowdown in its...
summary.zh: 根据一项新分析，中国工业部门正通过几个关键指标显示出摆脱化石燃料的迹象。这包括新的清洁能源发电量超过了需求增长，以及煤炭产量下降，其中一些省份的煤炭发电量正在减少或增长显著放缓。此外，工厂在工业过程中越来越多地采用非化石燃料替代品。

body.en:
By several measures, Chinese industry is becoming less dependent on fossil fuels, according to a new analysis.

New clean power more than met the growth in demand across China last year, leading to a small decline in coal output, according to think tank Ember. Analysts identified eight provinces where coal generation is now seeing declines, including industrial centers such as Hunan and Shandong, and it named another nine provinces where the growth of coal generation has slowed substantially.

On top of declines in coal power, factories are moving away from using fossil fuels for industrial processes. Textile plants may use gas boilers to generate heat for dyeing fabrics, for instance, while food producers may use gas ovens for cooking. But increasingly such processes are being electrified.

In eight of 11 industrial sectors — including textiles, food, pharmaceuticals, and machinery — fossil fuel use has already peaked, the analysis found. The declines come even as China’s industrial output continues to grow.

“The clean electricity system is gaining both strength and scope, and the fossil fuel system is already registering the shift,” said Muyi Yang, a senior analyst at Ember. “You can see fossil fuel use flattening out, sector by sector and province by province.”
body.zh: 一项新的分析显示，通过多项措施，中国工业正在摆脱化石燃料。 据智库 Ember 称，去年新增的清洁能源远远满足了中国各地的需求增长，导致煤炭产量小幅下降。分析师确定了煤炭发电量目前出现下降的八个省份，其中包括湖南和山东等工业中心，并指出了另外九个煤炭发电量增长大幅放缓的省份。 除了煤炭发电量下降之外，工厂正在逐渐不再使用化石燃料进行工业生产。例如，纺织厂可能使用燃气锅炉产生热量来染色织物，而食品生产商可能使用燃气烤箱进行烹饪，但此类过程越来越多地电气化。 分析发现，在 11 个工业部门中，有 8 个部门——包括纺织、食品、制药和机械——化石燃料的使用已经达到顶峰。尽管中国的工业产值持续增长，但经济仍出现下降。 Ember 高级分析师 Muyi Yang 表示：“清洁电力系统的强度和范围都在增强，而化石燃料系统也已经发生了这种转变。” “你可以看到化石燃料的使用逐个部门、逐个省份趋于平缓。”

reflection.en: The news that China's industry is shifting away from fossil fuels offers a hopeful sign for environmental stewardship. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' This transition, driven by innovation and necessity, can be seen as a step toward honoring the created order.
reflection.zh: 中国工业正转向摆脱化石燃料的消息，为环境管理带来了希望的迹象。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视一切所造之物并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这一由创新和需求驱动的转变，可以看作是迈向尊重受造秩序的一步。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Nearly Half of Farmers Globally Poisoned by Pesticides Each Year
title.zh: 全球近半数农民每年遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study has found that nearly half of the world's farmers, estimated at 402 to 433 million individuals annually, suffer from unintentional acute pesticide poisoning. This represents approximately 46% of the global farming population of 934 million.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，全球近一半的农民，估计每年有4.02亿至4.33亿人，遭受意外的急性农药中毒。这占全球9.34亿农民人口的约46%。

body.en:
This article was originally published by The Guardian and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found.

Using publicly available data from 2006 to 2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network, found there to be an estimated 402 to 433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year.

Based on a worldwide farming population of 934 million, this means approximately 46 percent of farmers are being poisoned every year. The greatest estimated number of poisonings was in South Asia, followed by Southeast Asia and East Africa.

The overall highest national incidence of poisoning was in Burkina Faso in West Africa, where nearly 84 percent of farmers and farm workers were reported to have experienced poisoning.

The study, published in the journal Frontiers in Public Health , also found that an estimated 11,000 deaths occur every year due to pesticide poisoning, with nearly 60 percent of these in India.

Jayakumar Chelaton, the executive director of Pesticide Action Network India, said the research exposed a “crisis that can no longer be ignored.”

The authors of the study are calling for “immediate action,” including the implementation of a U.N. recommendation to phase out highly hazardous pesticides.

The study states that despite global efforts to highlight the dangers, pesticide use has continued to grow steadily, with 3.8 million metric tons used in 2023, a doubling since 1990.

Sheila Willis, the head of international programs at Pesticide Action Network U.K., said: “Now that the scale of suffering has been revealed, farmers must be supported to access safer alternatives to protect their health and that of their families.”

The study did not consider the impact of pesticide exposure on the estimated 84 million children working in agriculture and did not look at the long-term health impacts, with acute pesticide poisoning defined in the study as any illness or health effect experienced a short time after exposure.

Génon Jensen, the executive director of the Health and Environment Alliance, said: “We are extremely concerned about the devastating health impacts from pesticide poisonings — both the acute impacts mentioned in this study but also chronic exposures that farm workers and communities suffer.”

Hélène Nicora, the director general of Parkinson’s Europe, said there was also “overwhelming evidence” to suggest that Parkinson’s was an environmentally driven disease, with growing evidence linking pesticide exposure to the development of Parkinson’s.

Parkinson’s disease is a progressive disorder in which parts of the brain become damaged over time, affecting...
body.zh: 本文最初由《卫报》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 一项研究发现，世界上每年有近一半的农民遭受农药中毒。 这项受农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 402 至 4.33 亿起农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。 根据全球 9.34 亿农业人口，这意味着每年约有 46% 的农民遭受中毒。据估计，中毒人数最多的是南亚，其次是东南亚和东非。 全国中毒发生率最高的是西非的布基纳法索，据报道该国近 84% 的农民和农场工人曾经历过中毒。 这项发表在《公共卫生前沿》杂志上的研究还发现，估计每年有 11,000 人因农药中毒死亡，其中近 60% 发生在印度。 印度农药行动网络执行董事贾古玛·切拉顿表示，这项研究暴露了一场“不能再忽视的危机”。 该研究的作者呼吁“立即采取行动”，包括实施联合国逐步淘汰高危险农药的建议。 该研究指出，尽管全球努力强调其危险，但农药的使用量仍在稳步增长，2023 年使用量为 380 万吨，比 1990 年翻了一番。 英国农药行动网络国际项目负责人希拉·威利斯表示：“既然苦难的规模已经暴露，必须支持农民获得更安全的替代方案，以保护他们及其家人的健康。” 该研究没有考虑农药接触对大约 8400 万从事农业工作的儿童的影响，也没有考虑长期健康影响，研究中将急性农药中毒定义为接触农药后短时间内出现的任何疾病或健康影响。 健康与环境联盟执行董事杰农·延森 (Génon Jensen) 表示：“我们非常担心农药中毒对健康造成的破坏性影响——既包括本研究中提到的急性影响，也包括农场工人和社区遭受的长期接触。” 帕金森病欧洲分会总干事海伦·尼科拉表示，还有“压倒性的证据”表明帕金森病是一种环境驱动的疾病，越来越多的证据表明接触农药与帕金森病的发生有关。 帕金森病是一种进行性疾病，随着时间的推移，大脑的某些部分会受到损害，影响...

reflection.en: The sheer scale of this crisis—nearly half a billion farmers poisoned annually—speaks to the profound challenges in our relationship with the earth and its resources. It is a stark reminder that our stewardship of creation, intended to be wise and life-giving, has led to widespread harm. May we seek wisdom to heal the land and protect those who cultivate it.
reflection.zh: 每年近五亿农民遭受农药中毒的危机规模之大，凸显了我们与大地及其资源关系中的严峻挑战。这有力地提醒我们，我们本应明智且赋予生命的管家职分，却导致了广泛的伤害。愿我们寻求智慧来医治大地，并保护那些耕种它的人们。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Satellite Images of Penguin Droppings Reveal Impact of Antarctic Warming
title.zh: 卫星图像上的企鹅粪便揭示南极变暖的影响

summary.en: Satellite images of penguin droppings, visible from space due to their sheer volume, are being used by scientists to study the diets and environmental responses of Antarctic penguins over 30 years. Analysis of guano color shifts in Adélie penguins provides insights into dietary changes linked to warming trends, and...
summary.zh: 由于数量巨大以至于从太空中可见，企鹅粪便的卫星图像正被科学家用来研究南极企鹅30年来的饮食和环境响应。对阿德利企鹅粪便颜色变化的分析为了解与变暖趋势相关的饮食变化提供了见解，而其独特的条带甚至帮助发现了新的帝企鹅种群。

body.en:
Penguin colonies are so large that their masses of excrement can be seen from space, offering scientists a useful means of studying the Antarctic birds. An analysis of 30 years of satellite images of penguin guano shows how the birds’ diets are shifting in response to warming.

Penguin droppings not only amass in huge volumes, but also stand out clearly against the white snow blanketing most of Antarctica. In 2024, scientists discovered four new colonies of emperor penguins by scanning satellite imagery for the signature brown streak left by their excrement.

For the new study, scientists analyzed subtle shifts in the color of Adélie penguin guano to track changes in their diet. First, they collected samples of guano and analyzed their color and contents, which allowed them to infer what penguins were eating by studying satellite imagery. Diets rich in krill — tiny, shrimplike crustaceans — lent guano a pink color.

Scanning roughly 4,000 images gathered between 1984 and 2013, scientists found that when sea ice is abundant, penguins eat more fish, and when sea ice is scarce, they rely more on krill.

With warming, sea ice is declining , hitting its lowest mark ever in 2023. And that is a problem for penguin chicks, which are typically heavier when fed fish than when fed krill, and are more likely to survive until adulthood. The new study , published in Current Biology , finds that in places where penguins are eating fewer fish, their numbers are dropping.

“Adélie penguins are an iconic species breeding all around the continent of Antarctica,” said coauthor Michael Polito, an ocean scientist at the University of California, Santa Cruz. “They act as a ‘canary in the coal mine,’ and our study illustrates how recent warming has disrupted the Antarctic marine food web they rely on to the detriment of many of their populations.”

Warming is not the only challenge facing penguins. At the same time that the loss of sea ice is cutting off access to fish, industrial supertrawlers are vacuuming up thousands of tons of Antarctic krill each year to feed a global market for dietary supplements and animal feed.

Scientists say both the retreat of sea ice and the loss of krill are driving declines of emperor penguins, which were listed as endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature earlier this year. A recent study found that krill fishery managers are not accounting for the compounding effects that krill fishing and warming are having on penguins.
body.zh: 企鹅群如此之大，以至于从太空中都可以看到它们大量的排泄物，这为科学家们提供了研究南极鸟类的有用手段。对 30 年来企鹅粪便卫星图像的分析显示了鸟类的饮食如何因气候变暖而发生变化。 企鹅的粪便不仅大量堆积，而且在覆盖南极洲大部分地区的白雪衬托下也显得格外引人注目。 2024 年，科学家通过扫描卫星图像寻找帝企鹅粪便留下的标志性棕色条纹，发现了四个新的帝企鹅群落。 在这项新研究中，科学家分析了阿德利企鹅鸟粪颜色的微妙变化，以追踪它们饮食的变化。首先，他们收集了鸟粪样本并分析了它们的颜色和含量，这使他们能够通过研究卫星图像来推断企鹅在吃什么。富含磷虾（一种微小的、像虾一样的甲壳类动物）的饮食使鸟粪呈粉红色。 科学家扫描了 1984 年至 2013 年间收集的大约 4000 张图像，发现当海冰丰富时，企鹅会吃更多的鱼，而当海冰稀缺时，它们会更多地依赖磷虾。 随着气候变暖，海冰正在减少，并在 2023 年达到有史以来的最低水平。这对企鹅幼崽来说是一个问题，它们在喂鱼时通常比喂磷虾时更重，并且更有可能存活到成年。这项发表在《当代生物学》上的新研究发现，在企鹅吃鱼较少的地方，它们的数量正在下降。 “阿德利企鹅是在南极大陆各地繁殖的标志性物种，”合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的海洋科学家迈克尔·波利托说。 “它们就像‘煤矿里的金丝雀’，我们的研究说明了最近的变暖如何扰乱了它们所依赖的南极海洋食物网，从而损害了它们的许多种群。” 变暖并不是企鹅面临的唯一挑战。与此同时，海冰的消失导致鱼类的获取途径被切断，工业超级拖网渔船每年捕捞数千吨南极磷虾，以满足全球膳食补充剂和动物饲料市场的需求。 科学家表示，海冰消退和磷虾减少正在导致帝企鹅数量减少，帝企鹅今年早些时候被国际自然保护联盟列为濒危物种。最近的一项研究发现，磷虾渔业管理者没有考虑磷虾捕捞和气候变暖对企鹅产生的复合影响。

reflection.en: The vastness of creation, even down to the droppings of penguins, holds clues to understanding Yahweh's intricate world. These observations, made possible by technology, allow us to see how environmental changes impact even the most remote ecosystems, reminding us of the interconnectedness of life and the wisdom inherent in Yahweh's design.
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的创造，甚至小到企鹅的粪便，都蕴含着理解雅伟精妙世界的线索。这些由科技带来的观测，使我们能够看到环境变化如何影响最偏远的生态系统，提醒我们生命的相互关联以及雅伟设计中固有的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

Fifty-nine years ago, friends Roger Patterson and Robert Gimlin visited the Six Rivers National Forest in Northern California and claimed to have an encounter with a Sasquatch . The minute-long film they shot of the alleged Bigfoot has been a source of worldwide fascination ever since, undergoing endless attempts to authenticate or discredit it.

The ongoing interest in both Bigfoot and the Patterson-Gimlin film was fully evident earlier this year when the Sasquatch documentary “ Capturing Bigfoot ” premiered before a sold-out crowd at SXSW in Austin, Texas. The screening electrified Bigfoot enthusiasts with its revelations and sparked new conversations about the myths behind both the Sasquatch and the Patterson-Gimlin footage, but there was no way to see the movie after that initial premiere — until now. Related Stories Cannes 2026 Movies Sold: Sumerian Buys ‘Low Expectations’ Starring Indie Singer Girl in Red ‘Arrested Memory’ Review: Sabu Plays Amnesia for Gentle Comedy

XYZ Films will release “Capturing Bigfoot” in New York, Los Angeles, and other select cities nationwide on October 20, otherwise known as National Bigfoot Day. The film will also be available for a limited time to rent or buy exclusively on Prime Video in the U.S. and Canada that same day. It’s the first opportunity to see the movie since its initial premiere, as the filmmakers opted to hold it back from other festivals to preserve the mystery of the never-before-seen footage featured in it and allow audiences to experience the movie’s surprises at the same moment.

The idea is to give audiences an opportunity to experience the film communally, mirroring how Roger Patterson screened the original Patterson-Gimlin film across the country. That footage effectively went “viral” before the digital age and grossed over $5M in the US box office (adjusted for inflation). For the upcoming theatrical screenings, there will be heightened security to protect the integrity of this newly discovered footage with recording and digital devices strictly prohibited.

“Capturing Bigfoot” follows the story of Roger Patterson’s pursuit of Bigfoot, who on October 20, 1967, captured 59 seconds of film showing a creature (dubbed “Patty”) walking through the woods of Northern California — footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. When a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe five decades later blows the...
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 五十九年前，朋友罗杰·帕特森和罗伯特·吉姆林参观了北加州的六河国家森林，并声称遇到了大脚野人。他们拍摄的这部长达一分钟的关于所谓的大脚怪的电影从此成为全世界关注的焦点，人们不断地尝试验证或怀疑它的真实性。 今年早些时候，当大脚野人纪录片《捕捉大脚怪》在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的 SXSW 上首映时，观众对大脚怪和帕特森-吉姆林电影的持续兴趣就得到了充分体现。这次放映让大脚怪爱好者们兴奋不已，并引发了关于大脚野人和帕特森-吉姆林镜头背后的神话的新对话，但在首映后，直到现在，还没有办法观看这部电影。相关故事 2026 年戛纳电影已售：Sumerian 购买了由独立歌手红衣女孩主演的《低期望》《被逮捕的记忆》评论：萨布在轻喜剧中扮演失忆症 XYZ Films 将于 10 月 20 日（又称“国家大脚怪日”）在纽约、洛杉矶和全国其他选定城市上映《捕捉大脚怪》。该影片当天还将在美国和加拿大的 Prime Video 上限时独家出租或购买。这是自首映以来第一次有机会观看这部电影，因为电影制片人选择将其推迟到其他电影节，以保留其中从未见过的镜头的神秘面纱，并让观众同时体验电影的惊喜。 这样做的目的是让观众有机会共同体验这部电影，模仿罗杰·帕特森在全国放映帕特森-吉姆林原创电影的方式。在数字时代之前，这段视频实际上已经“疯传”，美国票房总收入超过 500 万美元（根据通货膨胀调整）。对于即将到来的影院放映，将加强安全措施，以保护这一新发现的镜头的完整性，并严格禁止使用录音和数字设备。 《捕捉大脚怪》讲述了罗杰·帕特森 (Roger Patterson) 追捕大脚怪的故事，罗杰·帕特森于 1967 年 10 月 20 日拍摄了一段 59 秒的影片，展示了一种生物（被称为“帕蒂”）穿过北加州树林的画面，这段镜头成为历史上分析和争论最多的镜头。五年后，当在保险箱中发现的一卷 16 毫米胶卷炸毁了......

reflection.en: The enduring fascination with the Patterson-Gimlin film, now explored in the documentary 'Capturing Bigfoot,' highlights humanity's persistent quest to understand the unknown. As knowledge and technology advance, mysteries like the Sasquatch continue to draw our attention, prompting deeper investigation and debate.

summary.en: A disquieting documentary, produced by The Guardian and shown at the Venice film festival, features anonymous Israeli intelligence personnel discussing the concept of 'Naza'—a calculated number of projected civilian deaths from military strikes, referred to euphemistically as collateral damage. The film explores the...
summary.zh: 一部在威尼斯电影节展映、由《卫报》制作的令人不安的纪录片，采访了匿名的以色列情报人员，他们讨论了“Naza”的概念——这是军事打击中预期的平民死亡人数的计算数字，被委婉地称为附带损害。该片探讨了人工智能和有问题的情报单位的使用，并将其与越南战争时期的“战果统计”相提并论。

body.en: Venice film festival: Under the cover of night, anonymous personnel discuss AI, error rates and problematic intelligence units in a documentary produced by the Guardian Here is a disquieting documentary about what Israel’s military chiefs in Gaza reputedly call “Naza”, meaning civilian collateral damage – itself a queasy euphemism. The calculated “Naza” number is the amount of projected civilian deaths from each military strike, and perhaps it will come to have the same connotations as the US military term “body count” during Vietnam. The directors are Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, two of the film-makers behind No Other Land , which was about attacks by the Israel Defense Forces on Palestinian West Bank villages. NAZA is executive produced by Jonathan Glazer and James Wilson and appears under the production auspices of the Guardian, in which some of the stories have already appeared. There are flaws: interviews were conducted on the condition of anonymity, but if no-one can be persuaded to put their name and face to their words (and of course it is terribly dangerous) then the impact of this as testimony is lessened. But even so, the film is casting a chilling light on what is happening now in Gaza. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：在夜幕的掩护下，匿名人员在《卫报》制作的一部纪录片中讨论了人工智能、错误率和有问题的情报单位。这是一部令人不安的纪录片，讲述了以色列在加沙的军事首领所谓的“纳扎”，意思是平民的附带损害——这本身就是一种令人不安的委婉说法。计算出的“纳扎”数字是每次军事打击预计造成的平民死亡人数，也许它与越南战争期间美军术语“死亡人数”具有相同的含义。导演是尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor)，他们是《无他之地》(No Other Land) 的两位电影制作人，该片讲述了以色列国防军对巴勒斯坦西岸村庄的袭击。 《娜扎》由乔纳森·格雷泽和詹姆斯·威尔逊担任执行制片，并在《卫报》的制作赞助下播出，其中一些故事已经出现在《卫报》中。也有缺陷：采访是在匿名的情况下进行的，但如果没有人能被说服说出自己的名字和面孔（当然这是非常危险的），那么作为证词的影响就会减弱。但即便如此，这部电影还是给加沙目前正在发生的事情带来了令人不寒而栗的曙光。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary exposes a chilling calculus where human lives are reduced to numbers, raising profound questions about accountability and the ethical implications of warfare. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.' May we reflect on how systems of conflict can obscure our shared humanity and the urgent need...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了一种令人不寒而栗的计算方式，将人的生命简化为数字，引发了关于问责制和战争伦理影响的深刻问题。《弥迦书》6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。愿我们反思冲突的体系如何能模糊我们共同的人性，以及对公义和怜悯的迫切需要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘NAZA’ Review: The Israeli Directors of ‘No Other Land’ Illuminate the Mechanics of Genocide in Another Essential Documentary
title.zh: 《NAZA》评论：以色列导演《别无他地》在另一部重要纪录片中揭示种族灭绝的机制

summary.en: Rooftop interviews in Tel Aviv reveal horrifying details about AI-assisted massacres, as exposed in the documentary 'NAZA'.
summary.zh: 在特拉维夫的屋顶采访中，揭露了关于人工智能辅助屠杀的可怕细节，正如纪录片《NAZA》所揭示的那样。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

A documentary exposing the brutal machinery of modern genocide, “ NAZA ” gets its name from a euphemistic acronym casually employed by Israeli intelligence. It refers to the number of civilians designated “Nezek Agavi” or collateral damage in an air strike — which is to say, before an air strike. The title is also an onomatopoeia: the film may be journalistic in origin, but its cinematic effects are downright nauseating . Over a mere 80 minutes filmed on rooftops in Tel Aviv, the Israeli half of the collective behind West Bank land-grab doc “ No Other Land ” — directors Rachel Szor and Yuval Abraham — interview anonymous IDF sources who detail their methodology in drawings and words. Their silences, however, are just as revealing. Related Stories No One Knows Better Than Filmmaker Scott Waugh Why Authenticity Is the Ultimate Special Effect Zach Cregger Weighs in on the Physical Media Debate Ahead of Sony’s ‘Resident Evil’

Jumping between archival clips, shots of modern infrastructure, and sit-downs with a mammoth 24 different whistleblowers, “NAZA” builds on existing reporting by The Guardian, +972 Magazine and Local Call. Some of this was carried out by Abraham himself, who plays the role of chief interrogator here, sitting opposite each source in profile in the dead of night. His face (and his furor at what he’s told) are dimly lit, while his sources are in complete shadow to protect their identities. The camera, however, seldom strays from their outlines, practically turning these people into human-shaped voids — a murkiness matched by eerie mechanical rumblings all around.

“You can see the city, but the city can’t see you,” one subject observes about their makeshift, open air studio. This subterfuge makes sense, since what these people reveal implicates their superiors. However, it also equals tacit admission of their own hand in mass murder. And yet, their reasons for speaking out aren’t as straightforward as a heavy conscience. Untangling their motives might just be the most harrowing thing about the movie — second, of course, to the killings they describe.

The interviews in “NAZA” bear a striking resemblance to those in Joshua Oppenheimer’s “ The Look of Silence, ” about the perpetrators of Indonesia’s 1960s politicide, when millions sympathetic to communism were put to death. Much like in that documentary —...
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 《NAZA》是一部揭露现代种族灭绝残酷机制的纪录片，它的名字来源于以色列情报机构随意使用的委婉缩写词。它指的是在空袭中被指定为“Nezek Agavi”或附带损害的平民数量——也就是说，在空袭之前。片名也是一个拟声词：这部电影可能起源于新闻报道，但其电影效果却令人恶心。在特拉维夫的屋顶上拍摄的短短 80 分钟内，西岸土地掠夺纪录片《No Other Land》背后的以色列人——导演雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 和尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham)——采访了以色列国防军的匿名消息人士，他们用图画和文字详细介绍了他们的方法。然而，他们的沉默也同样能说明问题。相关故事 没有人比电影制作人斯科特·沃 (Scott Waugh) 更了解为什么真实性是终极特效 扎克·克雷格 (Zach Cregger) 在索尼《生化危机》之前参与了实体媒体辩论 《NAZA》以《卫报》、+972 杂志和 Local Call 的现有报道为基础，在档案剪辑、现代基础设施镜头以及与 24 名不同举报人的坐下来之间跳跃。其中一些是由亚伯拉罕本人执行的，他在这里扮演主要审讯者的角色，在夜深人静时坐在每个消息来源的对面。他的脸（以及他对他所说的话的愤怒）光线昏暗，而他的消息来源则完全处于阴影中以保护他们的身份。然而，镜头很少偏离他们的轮廓，几乎把这些人变成了人形的虚空——一种黑暗，与周围怪异的机械隆隆声相匹配。 “你可以看到城市，但城市看不到你，”一位受试者在谈到他们临时搭建的露天工作室时说道。这种诡计是有道理的，因为这些人透露的内容暗示了他们的上级。然而，这也等于默认了他们自己参与了大屠杀。然而，他们发声的原因并不像沉重的良心那么简单。弄清楚他们的动机可能是这部电影中最令人痛苦的事情——当然，仅次于他们所描述的杀戮。 《NAZA》中的采访与约书亚·奥本海默 (Joshua Oppenheimer) 的《沉默的表情》中的采访极为相似，该书讲述了 1960 年代印度尼西亚政治屠杀的肇事者，当时数百万同情共产主义的人被处决。就像那部纪录片一样——...

reflection.en: The documentary 'NAZA' uses the term 'NAZA' as a euphemism for civilian casualties, highlighting the chilling detachment with which horrific violence is described. This detachment can be a step towards normalizing evil. The call to 'overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21) challenges us to confront such realities not with further violence or indifference,...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》使用“NAZA”一词作为平民伤亡的委婉语，突显了对可怕暴力描述的令人不寒而栗的疏离感。这种疏离感可能成为使邪恶常态化的一步。《罗马书》12:21呼吁“以善胜恶”，挑战我们不仅要以暴力或冷漠来面对这些现实，更要致力于真相和恢复性正义，无论这条道路多么艰难。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: ‘Who do you really believe?’: the true crime fans who became a part of the story
title.zh: “你到底相信谁？”：成为故事一部分的真实犯罪迷

summary.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that the woman accused of murder is innocent. A man and a woman were murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly fell on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family...
summary.zh: 在HBO引人入胜的新纪录片系列《一个杀人故事》中，一对热心的夫妇坚信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。2002年的一天晚上，一男一女在堪萨斯州托皮卡家中被谋杀。嫌疑很快落在了受害男子的前妻 Dana Chandler...

body.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 HBO 扣人心弦的新纪录片《杀手故事》中，一对斗志昂扬的夫妇确信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。 2002 年，一名男子和一名女子在黑暗的掩护下，在堪萨斯州托皮卡的卧室里被冷血谋杀。嫌疑人很快就落到了该男子的前妻达纳·钱德勒的身上，家人和法医证据都将她描绘成嫉妒型的人。但当时的县检察官拒绝提出指控，很大程度上是因为没有任何证据显示钱德勒在犯罪现场。直到任命了一位出于政治动机的检察官，并且哥伦比亚广播公司的 48 小时频道播出了 2009 年的报道，重述了此案之后，钱德勒才于 2011 年因两项预谋一级谋杀罪被捕，并在次年被连续判处无期徒刑。毫无疑问：这个故事是热门副本。如果一对真正的犯罪爱好者组成的夫妻团队没有相信真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外，那么钱德勒的定罪很可能标志着一个结论。 “还有很多问题没有解决，”电影制片人马修·加尔金说。 “但是，当你开始揭开犯罪本身的真相时，为了让她成功完成这件事，有很多障碍需要跨越，还有很高的门槛需要克服。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary series delves into the complexities of true crime, where a couple's conviction of innocence challenges the initial accusations. It reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and not settling for the first or loudest narrative. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, stating that 'The first person to speak in a lawsuit seems right, until someone...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片系列深入探讨了真实犯罪的复杂性，其中一对夫妇坚信某女子无辜，这挑战了最初的指控。它提醒我们寻求真相的重要性，不要满足于第一个或最响亮的声音。箴言18:17对此有所阐述，‘在讼事上先开口的，似乎都有理；但邻 Comes，就审问他。’

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective incel id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，她是一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，也是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜线婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人的长达四个小时的史诗般的研究中，她是一位引人入胜的专家证人：出生于南非的亿万富翁，是一个过于自大、脾气暴躁的亿万富豪、冒牌的梦想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX火箭飞船、民族国家军事能力越来越依赖的星链卫星、塑造了数十亿集体非自愿群体的X（以前的推特）和每天都有庞大服务器群的GrokAI吞噬海洋宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary probes the immense power and influence of Elon Musk, a figure who wields vast technological control. The narrative describes him as an 'ersatz visionary,' suggesting a disconnect between his ambition and true wisdom. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess sought to reach the heavens,...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了埃隆·马斯克——这位拥有巨大技术控制权的人物——的巨大权力和影响力。叙述将他描述为一位“伪造的远见者”，暗示了他的野心与真正的智慧之间存在脱节。这让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心和技术实力试图触及天堂，最终导致了混乱和分裂。

summary.zh: 导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找两位过着与世隔绝生活的兄弟，他们在超现实的纪录片中展现出奇特的智慧。这部由一头被屠宰的公牛旁白的非凡电影，走了一条不寻常的道路，记录了一对捷克双胞胎兄弟的日常生活。弗兰蒂谢克和奥德雷·克利希克兄弟俩在舒马瓦山脉的一间小屋里，正慢慢走向疯狂——或者说接近开悟。导演米罗·雷莫以阿莱什·帕兰关...

body.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在这部超现实的纪录片中，导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找充满堂吉诃德式智慧的两兄弟过着与世隔绝的生活。这部非凡的影片由一头被宰杀的公牛讲述，采取了一条人迹罕至的道路，描绘了一对捷克双胞胎的日常生活，远离传统路线。弗兰蒂谢克和昂德热·克利希克在苏马瓦山的一间小屋里慢慢发疯——或者可能接近启蒙，导演米罗·雷莫根据阿莱什·帕兰写的关于兄弟俩的短篇小说，有效地屈服于盛行的小屋热——不仅怂恿这些长胡子的人争吵和疯狂的哲学思考，还用自己的寓言和超现实主义。截至 60 日，“Franta”和“Ondra”仍在南迪（Nandy）的帮助下耕种他们的小农场，南迪是一头叛变的公牛，被错误地选为役畜。在闲暇时间，她们会喝酒、开玩笑、争吵，哀叹自己与异性交往的前景不佳，并在史诗般的扳手腕比赛中发泄情绪。尽管弗兰塔在锯木厂事故中失去了一条手臂，但通常胜利者都是弗兰塔。他还具有他那直率的兄弟所没有的不切实际的性格。他像彩旗一样将诗意的溪流抛向空中，祝愿“所有有意识的生物都快乐”，他也在建造自己的达芬奇式永久飞行器。 “你对我的永生体的厌恶有点烦人，”他告诉愤怒的昂德拉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the lives of two brothers living in isolation, questioning whether their path leads to madness or enlightenment. It reminds us that each life, however unconventional, is a unique creation. We are all fearfully and wonderfully made, with paths and wisdom that may not fit societal norms but are part of a divine design.
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了两位隐居兄弟的生活，质疑他们的道路是通向疯狂还是开悟。它提醒我们，每一个生命，无论多么不寻常，都是独特的创造。我们都是被雅伟用奇妙的方式造的，我们的道路和智慧或许不符合社会规范，但却是神圣设计的一部分。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger review - emotional documentary glosses over the hard stuff
title.zh: Oasis：不再愤怒回顾 - 情感纪录片忽略了艰难的部分

summary.en: The film captures the euphoria of Oasis' comeback, but fails to explore the story of their reunion.
summary.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了Oasis乐队重组后的狂喜，但未能深入探讨他们重聚的故事。

body.en:
"The little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away," says Noel Gallagher of reconciling with his brother, Liam.

The scene comes towards the end of Don't Look Back In Anger, a sentimental and affectionate portrait of the band's comeback tour in 2025. But it's about as deep as we get into the band's 15-year hiatus.

In an opening montage, we hear how Oasis conquered the world in the 1990s with hits like Wonderwall and Roll With It. As their fame grew, so did the brothers' animosity, until the party came to an abrupt halt backstage at a gig in Paris in 2009.

Fan shot footage shows the promoter on stage, informing the crowd that the concert is cancelled following "a huge fight together in the dressing room".

"The band doesn't exist any more," he announces, sounding more irritated than sad.

According to Scottish singer Amy McDonald, who was also on the line-up, the altercation was seismic. "Liam smashed Noel's guitar, huuuge fight!" she tweeted from backstage.

The film, however, never tells us what was said. Nobody explains the fall-out. We don't find out who instigated the rapprochement, nor do we hear how it affected their family.

Instead, we cut to rehearsals for the comeback tour, with a caption informing us the brothers "didn't speak for 15 years", and an implication that all the wounds have been miraculously healed.

Tantalisingly, the first song they practice is Columbia - a fan favourite that never made the tour's setlist - but there's a tension in the room.

The band, under Noel's instruction, is piecing together the setlist. Liam won't arrive until later in the process, and no-one's sure which Liam they'll get.

When he arrives, he seems fantastically grumpy, complaining about the sound-proofing panels that have been placed in front of Joey Waronker's drums.

But when he steps up to the mic, the band relax. Guitarist Bonehead - who's strategically placed between Liam and Noel - beams from ear to ear.

A couple of hours later, still in the middle of a song, Liam waves goodbye and casually strolls out of the rehearsal space.

"If you're not on it, chaos can ensue," he says, adding that he's given up cigarettes and alcohol (the intoxicants, not the song) for the duration of the tour.

Liam's newfound professionalism is probably the biggest revelation in the documentary, scripted by Peaky Blinders' creator Steven Knight, and shot by directors Dylan Southern and Will Lovelace.

To their presumable dismay, there are no scenes of the singer quitting the tour to go house-hunting , external ; throwing snooker balls at Blur , external ; or starting a fight on a cross-channel ferry .

Instead, they complete rehearsals without incident and rock up to Cardiff's Principality Stadium for their public reunion.

As the big moment...
body.zh: “曾经让我们彼此烦恼的小事都消失了，”诺埃尔·加拉格尔在谈到与弟弟利亚姆和解时说道。 这一场景出现在《Don’t Look Back In Anger》的结尾处，这是对乐队 2025 年回归巡演的感伤和深情的描绘。但这与我们进入乐队 15 年的停顿一样深。 在开场蒙太奇中，我们了解到 Oasis 如何在 20 世纪 90 年代凭借《Wonderwall》和《Roll With It》等热门歌曲征服世界。随着他们的名气越来越大，兄弟俩的仇恨也越来越大，直到 2009 年巴黎一场演出的后台派对突然停止。 粉丝拍摄的镜头显示，发起人在舞台上，通知观众，在“更衣室里发生了一场激烈的争斗”后，音乐会被取消。 “乐队已经不存在了，”他宣布，听起来更多的是恼怒而不是悲伤。 据也在场的苏格兰歌手艾米·麦克唐纳 (Amy McDonald) 表示，这场争吵是令人震惊的。 “利亚姆砸碎了诺埃尔的吉他，打架！”她在后台发推文。 然而，这部电影从未告诉我们所说的内容。没有人解释后果。我们不知道是谁促成了和解，也不知道这对他们的家庭有何影响。 相反，我们切入了复出巡演的排练，字幕告诉我们兄弟俩“15年没有说话了”，并暗示所有的伤口都奇迹般地痊愈了。 令人着迷的是，他们练习的第一首歌是《Columbia》——这是一首深受粉丝喜爱的歌曲，但从未出现在巡演的歌单中——但房间里却充满了紧张气氛。 乐队在诺埃尔的指导下正在拼凑歌单。利亚姆要到这个过程的后期才会到达，而且没有人确定他们会得到哪一个利亚姆。 当他到达时，他似乎脾气暴躁，抱怨乔伊·沃龙克鼓前面的隔音板。 但当他走到麦克风前时，乐队放松了。吉他手 Bonehead - 战略性地位于 Liam 和 Noel 之间 - 笑容满面。 几个小时后，利亚姆还在唱着歌，挥手告别，漫不经心地走出排练场。 “如果你不参加，混乱就会随之而来，”他说，并补充说他在巡演期间戒掉了香烟和酒精（麻醉品，而不是歌曲）。 利亚姆新发现的专业精神可能是这部纪录片中最大的启示，这部纪录片由《浴血黑帮》的创作者史蒂文·奈特编写剧本，由导演迪伦·萨瑟恩和威尔·洛夫莱斯拍摄。 令他们沮丧的是，没有歌手退出巡演去外部找房的场景；将斯诺克球扔到 Blur 外部；或者在跨海峡渡轮上打架。 相反，他们顺利地完成了排练，并在卡迪夫公国体育场举行了公开重聚。 作为重要时刻...

reflection.en: Noel Gallagher's comment that "the little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away" speaks to a reconciliation that, while welcome, feels superficial. The documentary, by glossing over the "hard stuff" of their 15-year hiatus, misses an opportunity to explore how true healing and reconciliation occur, not just the absence of...
reflection.zh: 诺埃尔·加拉格尔说“那些曾经让我们互相恼怒的小事都消失了”，这番话暗示了一种和解，虽然值得欢迎，但感觉有些肤浅。这部纪录片在略过他们15年休眠期的“艰难部分”时，错失了一个探讨真正治愈与和解如何发生的机会，而不仅仅是烦恼的消失。它提醒我们，克服过去的伤害需要的不只是恢复正常；它呼唤我们积极地选择良善，以对抗过往冲突留下的痕迹。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。
